@@ -0,0 +1,318 @@
+package sticker
+
+import (
+	"strings"
+	"time"
+
+	db "github.com/YourTongji/YourTJ-Hub/apps/gooseforum/app/bundles/connect/dbconnect"
+	"gorm.io/gorm"
+	"gorm.io/gorm/clause"
+)
+
+// PackMarket marks stickers materialized from an external market pack. They
+// are shared assets like official stickers but appear only through published
+// packs, so the official directory and admin library never list them.
+const PackMarket = "market"
+
+// Market pack import states. A pack becomes selectable only after an
+// administrator publishes it; the state reports what the server holds locally.
+const (
+	MarketStatusNew       = "new"
+	MarketStatusQueued    = "queued"
+	MarketStatusImporting = "importing"
+	MarketStatusReady     = "ready"
+	MarketStatusPartial   = "partial"
+	MarketStatusFailed    = "failed"
+)
+
+// MarketTopic is an upstream category snapshot. It only groups packs for
+// browsing and never grants visibility on its own.
+type MarketTopic struct {
+	Id         uint64    `gorm:"primaryKey;column:id;autoIncrement;not null;"`
+	Source     string    `gorm:"column:source;type:varchar(32);not null;uniqueIndex:idx_sticker_market_topic,priority:1;"`
+	UpstreamID string    `gorm:"column:upstream_id;type:varchar(64);not null;uniqueIndex:idx_sticker_market_topic,priority:2;"`
+	Label      string    `gorm:"column:label;type:varchar(64);not null;default:'';"`
+	SortOrder  int       `gorm:"column:sort_order;not null;default:0;"`
+	UpdatedAt  time.Time `gorm:"column:updated_at;autoUpdateTime;"`
+}
+
+func (MarketTopic) TableName() string { return "sticker_market_topics" }
+
+// MarketPack is one upstream sticker group plus local import and publication
+// state. Upstream identifiers stay separate from the local id so a changed
+// upstream catalog cannot rename or merge local packs.
+type MarketPack struct {
+	Id            uint64 `gorm:"primaryKey;column:id;autoIncrement;not null;" json:"id"`
+	Source        string `gorm:"column:source;type:varchar(32);not null;uniqueIndex:idx_sticker_market_pack,priority:1;" json:"source"`
+	UpstreamID    string `gorm:"column:upstream_id;type:varchar(128);not null;uniqueIndex:idx_sticker_market_pack,priority:2;" json:"upstreamId"`
+	Name          string `gorm:"column:name;type:varchar(128);not null;default:'';" json:"name"`
+	Topic         string `gorm:"column:topic;type:varchar(64);not null;default:'';index;" json:"topic"`
+	UpstreamCount int    `gorm:"column:upstream_count;not null;default:0;" json:"upstreamCount"`
+	UpstreamOrder int    `gorm:"column:upstream_order;not null;default:0;" json:"upstreamOrder"`
+	Archived      bool   `gorm:"column:archived;not null;default:false;" json:"archived"`
+	Missing       bool   `gorm:"column:missing;not null;default:false;" json:"missing"`
+	Status        string `gorm:"column:status;type:varchar(16);not null;default:'new';index;" json:"status"`
+	Published     bool   `gorm:"column:published;not null;default:false;index;" json:"published"`
+	SortOrder     int    `gorm:"column:sort_order;not null;default:0;" json:"sortOrder"`
+	ItemCount     int    `gorm:"column:item_count;not null;default:0;" json:"itemCount"`
+	FailedCount   int    `gorm:"column:failed_count;not null;default:0;" json:"failedCount"`
+	// ImportTotal is the item count of the latest import run; ItemCount plus
+	// FailedCount reach it as the run progresses.
+	ImportTotal    int    `gorm:"column:import_total;not null;default:0;" json:"importTotal"`
+	LastError      string `gorm:"column:last_error;type:varchar(64);not null;default:'';" json:"lastError"`
+	CoverStickerID uint64 `gorm:"column:cover_sticker_id;not null;default:0;" json:"coverStickerId"`
+	// IconURL/IconText are the upstream catalog cover. IconFile is the locally
+	// stored thumbnail of it that administrators see before import; members
+	// only ever see the cover of an imported sticker.
+	IconURL    string     `gorm:"column:icon_url;type:varchar(512);not null;default:'';" json:"iconUrl"`
+	IconText   string     `gorm:"column:icon_text;type:varchar(64);not null;default:'';" json:"iconText"`
+	IconFile   string     `gorm:"column:icon_file;type:varchar(128);not null;default:'';" json:"iconFile"`
+	SyncedAt   time.Time  `gorm:"column:synced_at;" json:"syncedAt"`
+	ImportedAt *time.Time `gorm:"column:imported_at;" json:"importedAt"`
+	CreatedAt  time.Time  `gorm:"column:created_at;autoCreateTime;<-:create;" json:"createdAt"`
+	UpdatedAt  time.Time  `gorm:"column:updated_at;autoUpdateTime;" json:"updatedAt"`
+}
+
+func (MarketPack) TableName() string { return "sticker_market_packs" }
+
+// MarketItem maps one upstream sticker to the local sticker asset that holds
+// its downloaded bytes. A failed item keeps StickerID 0 and a stable reason.
+type MarketItem struct {
+	PackID     uint64    `gorm:"primaryKey;autoIncrement:false;column:pack_id;"`
+	UpstreamID string    `gorm:"primaryKey;column:upstream_id;type:varchar(128);"`
+	StickerID  uint64    `gorm:"column:sticker_id;not null;default:0;index;"`
+	SortOrder  int       `gorm:"column:sort_order;not null;default:0;"`
+	Error      string    `gorm:"column:error;type:varchar(32);not null;default:'';"`
+	UpdatedAt  time.Time `gorm:"column:updated_at;autoUpdateTime;"`
+}
+
+func (MarketItem) TableName() string { return "sticker_market_items" }
+
+// PackSubscription is private account state, written under the same per-account
+// library lock as personal stickers. Removing it never touches shared assets.
+type PackSubscription struct {
+	UserID    uint64    `gorm:"primaryKey;autoIncrement:false;column:user_id;"`
+	PackID    uint64    `gorm:"primaryKey;autoIncrement:false;column:pack_id;index;"`
+	SortOrder int       `gorm:"column:sort_order;not null;default:0;"`
+	CreatedAt time.Time `gorm:"column:created_at;autoCreateTime;<-:create;"`
+}
+
+func (PackSubscription) TableName() string { return "user_sticker_packs" }
+
+func marketDB() *gorm.DB { return db.Connect() }
+
+// UpsertMarketTopicsTx replaces label/order for every listed topic.
+func UpsertMarketTopicsTx(tx *gorm.DB, topics []MarketTopic) error {
+	if len(topics) == 0 {
+		return nil
+	}
+	return tx.Clauses(clause.OnConflict{
+		Columns:   []clause.Column{{Name: "source"}, {Name: "upstream_id"}},
+		DoUpdates: clause.AssignmentColumns([]string{"label", "sort_order", "updated_at"}),
+	}).Create(&topics).Error
+}
+
+// UpsertMarketPacksTx refreshes upstream metadata only. Local import and
+// publication state survive every catalog refresh; a changed upstream icon
+// drops the stored thumbnail so the next preview fetches the new one.
+func UpsertMarketPacksTx(tx *gorm.DB, packs []MarketPack) error {
+	if len(packs) == 0 {
+		return nil
+	}
+	updates := clause.AssignmentColumns([]string{"name", "topic", "icon_url", "icon_text", "upstream_count", "upstream_order", "archived", "missing", "synced_at", "updated_at"})
+	// SET expressions read the row before the update, so this compares the old icon.
+	updates = append(updates, clause.Assignment{Column: clause.Column{Name: "icon_file"}, Value: gorm.Expr(
+		"CASE WHEN sticker_market_packs.icon_url = excluded.icon_url THEN sticker_market_packs.icon_file ELSE '' END")})
+	return tx.Clauses(clause.OnConflict{
+		Columns:   []clause.Column{{Name: "source"}, {Name: "upstream_id"}},
+		DoUpdates: updates,
+	}).CreateInBatches(&packs, 200).Error
+}
+
+// MarkMissingMarketPacksTx flags packs the latest complete catalog no longer lists.
+func MarkMissingMarketPacksTx(tx *gorm.DB, source string, syncedBefore time.Time) (int64, error) {
+	result := tx.Model(&MarketPack{}).Where("source = ? AND synced_at < ? AND missing = ?", source, syncedBefore, false).Update("missing", true)
+	return result.RowsAffected, result.Error
+}
+
+// MarketTopics lists one source's topics, or every source's when source is empty.
+func MarketTopics(source string) ([]MarketTopic, error) {
+	rows := make([]MarketTopic, 0)
+	conn := marketDB()
+	if source != "" {
+		conn = conn.Where("source = ?", source)
+	}
+	err := conn.Order("sort_order ASC").Order("id ASC").Find(&rows).Error
+	return rows, err
+}
+
+// MarketTopicByLabelTx finds one source's topic by its label.
+func MarketTopicByLabelTx(tx *gorm.DB, source, label string) (MarketTopic, error) {
+	var row MarketTopic
+	err := tx.Where("source = ? AND label = ?", source, label).First(&row).Error
+	return row, err
+}
+
+func CreateMarketTopicTx(tx *gorm.DB, row *MarketTopic) error {
+	return tx.Clauses(clause.OnConflict{DoNothing: true}).Create(row).Error
+}
+
+// MarketTopicExists reports whether any source lists the topic id.
+func MarketTopicExists(tx *gorm.DB, id string) (bool, error) {
+	var count int64
+	err := tx.Model(&MarketTopic{}).Where("upstream_id = ?", id).Count(&count).Error
+	return count > 0, err
+}
+
+// MarketPackQuery filters the administrator and public catalogs. An empty
+// Source covers synchronized and uploaded packs alike.
+type MarketPackQuery struct {
+	Source        string
+	Topic         string
+	Keyword       string
+	Status        string // admin filter: "", "imported", "published", or a MarketStatus*
+	PublishedOnly bool
+	Page          int
+	PageSize      int
+}
+
+func (q MarketPackQuery) apply(conn *gorm.DB) *gorm.DB {
+	conn = conn.Model(&MarketPack{})
+	if q.Source != "" {
+		conn = conn.Where("source = ?", q.Source)
+	}
+	if q.PublishedOnly {
+		conn = conn.Where("published = ? AND item_count > ?", true, 0)
+	}
+	if q.Topic != "" {
+		conn = conn.Where("topic = ?", q.Topic)
+	}
+	if keyword := strings.TrimSpace(q.Keyword); keyword != "" {
+		escaped := strings.NewReplacer(`\`, `\\`, `%`, `\%`, `_`, `\_`).Replace(strings.ToLower(keyword))
+		conn = conn.Where(`LOWER(name) LIKE ? ESCAPE '\'`, "%"+escaped+"%")
+	}
+	switch q.Status {
+	case "":
+	case "imported":
+		conn = conn.Where("item_count > ?", 0)
+	case "published":
+		conn = conn.Where("published = ?", true)
+	default:
+		conn = conn.Where("status = ?", q.Status)
+	}
+	return conn
+}
+
+// MarketPacks pages the catalog. Published packs follow administrator order;
+// the remaining catalog keeps the upstream order.
+func MarketPacks(q MarketPackQuery) ([]MarketPack, int64, error) {
+	rows := make([]MarketPack, 0)
+	var total int64
+	if err := q.apply(marketDB()).Count(&total).Error; err != nil {
+		return rows, 0, err
+	}
+	conn := q.apply(marketDB())
+	if q.PublishedOnly {
+		conn = conn.Order("sort_order ASC")
+	}
+	err := conn.Order("upstream_order ASC").Order("id ASC").
+		Offset((q.Page - 1) * q.PageSize).Limit(q.PageSize).Find(&rows).Error
+	return rows, total, err
+}
+
+func MarketPackByID(id uint64) (MarketPack, error) {
+	var row MarketPack
+	err := marketDB().First(&row, id).Error
+	return row, err
+}
+
+func MarketPackByIDTx(tx *gorm.DB, id uint64) (MarketPack, error) {
+	var row MarketPack
+	err := tx.Clauses(clause.Locking{Strength: "UPDATE"}).First(&row, id).Error
+	return row, err
+}
+
+func MarketPacksByIDs(ids []uint64) ([]MarketPack, error) {
+	rows := make([]MarketPack, 0)
+	if len(ids) == 0 {
+		return rows, nil
+	}
+	err := marketDB().Where("id IN ?", ids).Find(&rows).Error
+	return rows, err
+}
+
+func SaveMarketPackTx(tx *gorm.DB, pack *MarketPack) error { return tx.Save(pack).Error }
+
+func CreateMarketPackTx(tx *gorm.DB, pack *MarketPack) error { return tx.Create(pack).Error }
+
+// MarketItemTx returns one item of a pack, if recorded.
+func MarketItemTx(tx *gorm.DB, packID uint64, upstreamID string) (MarketItem, error) {
+	var row MarketItem
+	err := tx.Where("pack_id = ? AND upstream_id = ?", packID, upstreamID).First(&row).Error
+	return row, err
+}
+
+// NextMarketItemOrder is one past the pack's last item, so uploads append.
+func NextMarketItemOrder(tx *gorm.DB, packID uint64) (int, int, error) {
+	var stats struct {
+		Count int
+		Last  *int
+	}
+	err := tx.Model(&MarketItem{}).Select("COUNT(*) AS count, MAX(sort_order) AS last").Where("pack_id = ?", packID).Scan(&stats).Error
+	if err != nil || stats.Last == nil {
+		return 0, stats.Count, err
+	}
+	return *stats.Last + 1, stats.Count, nil
+}
+
+// LastMarketSync is the most recent successful catalog refresh, or zero.
+func LastMarketSync(source string) (time.Time, error) {
+	var pack MarketPack
+	err := marketDB().Where("source = ?", source).Order("synced_at DESC").Limit(1).Find(&pack).Error
+	return pack.SyncedAt, err
+}
+
+// MarketItems lists a pack's upstream items in pack order.
+func MarketItems(packID uint64) ([]MarketItem, error) {
+	rows := make([]MarketItem, 0)
+	err := marketDB().Where("pack_id = ?", packID).Order("sort_order ASC").Order("upstream_id ASC").Find(&rows).Error
+	return rows, err
+}
+
+func UpsertMarketItemTx(tx *gorm.DB, item *MarketItem) error {
+	return tx.Clauses(clause.OnConflict{
+		Columns:   []clause.Column{{Name: "pack_id"}, {Name: "upstream_id"}},
+		DoUpdates: clause.AssignmentColumns([]string{"sticker_id", "sort_order", "error", "updated_at"}),
+	}).Create(item).Error
+}
+
+// InsertMarketStickerTx creates a shared, approved market asset. The legacy
+// is_official=true column default is cleared in the same transaction, before
+// any reader can observe the row in the official directory.
+func InsertMarketStickerTx(tx *gorm.DB, entity *Entity) (bool, error) {
+	entity.Pack = PackMarket
+	inserted, err := InsertIfNameAvailable(tx, entity)
+	if err != nil || !inserted {
+		return inserted, err
+	}
+	entity.IsOfficial = false
+	return true, tx.Model(entity).Update("is_official", false).Error
+}
+
+func SubscriptionsTx(tx *gorm.DB, userID uint64) ([]PackSubscription, error) {
+	rows := make([]PackSubscription, 0)
+	err := tx.Where("user_id = ?", userID).Order("sort_order ASC").Order("pack_id ASC").Find(&rows).Error
+	return rows, err
+}
+
+func Subscriptions(userID uint64) ([]PackSubscription, error) {
+	return SubscriptionsTx(marketDB(), userID)
+}
+
+func SaveSubscriptionTx(tx *gorm.DB, row *PackSubscription) error {
+	return tx.Clauses(clause.OnConflict{DoNothing: true}).Create(row).Error
+}
+
+func RemoveSubscriptionTx(tx *gorm.DB, userID, packID uint64) error {
+	return tx.Where("user_id = ? AND pack_id = ?", userID, packID).Delete(&PackSubscription{}).Error
+}

+import (

+// OfficialPack names and orders one group of official stickers. Stickers join
+// a group through Entity.Pack; a key without a row still groups its stickers
+// and shows a default name, so seeded presets need no data migration.
+type OfficialPack struct {

+}

+func (OfficialPack) TableName() string { return "sticker_packs" }

+// OfficialPackCount is the number of official stickers holding one pack key.

+	Pack    string
+	Total   int
+	Enabled int
+}
+
+func OfficialPacks() ([]OfficialPack, error) {

+}

+func OfficialPacksTx(tx *gorm.DB) ([]OfficialPack, error) {
+	rows := make([]OfficialPack, 0)
+	err := tx.Order("sort_order ASC").Order("pack_key ASC").Find(&rows).Error
+	return rows, err

+func OfficialPackTx(tx *gorm.DB, key string) (OfficialPack, error) {
+	var row OfficialPack
+	err := tx.Clauses(clause.Locking{Strength: "UPDATE"}).Where("pack_key = ?", key).First(&row).Error
+	return row, err
+}
+
+// SaveOfficialPackTx inserts or replaces the metadata of one pack key.
+func SaveOfficialPackTx(tx *gorm.DB, row *OfficialPack) error {
+	err := tx.Clauses(clause.OnConflict{
+		Columns:   []clause.Column{{Name: "pack_key"}},
+		DoUpdates: clause.AssignmentColumns([]string{"name", "sort_order", "cover_sticker_id", "updated_at"}),
+	}).Create(row).Error
+	if err == nil {
+		notifyMutation()
+	}
+	return err
+}
+
+func DeleteOfficialPackTx(tx *gorm.DB, key string) error {
+	err := tx.Where("pack_key = ?", key).Delete(&OfficialPack{}).Error
+	if err == nil {
+		notifyMutation()
+	}
+	return err
+}
+
+// OfficialPackCounts groups official stickers, enabled or not, by pack key.
+func OfficialPackCounts(tx *gorm.DB) ([]OfficialPackCount, error) {
+	rows := make([]OfficialPackCount, 0)
+	err := tx.Model(&Entity{}).
+		Select("pack, COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN is_enabled THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS enabled").
+		Where("is_official = ?", true).Group("pack").Scan(&rows).Error
+	return rows, err
+}
+
+// MaxOfficialSortOrder is the largest sort order in a pack, or -1 when empty.
+func MaxOfficialSortOrder(tx *gorm.DB, pack string) (int, error) {
+	var order *int
+	err := tx.Model(&Entity{}).Select("MAX(sort_order)").Where("is_official = ? AND pack = ?", true, pack).Scan(&order).Error
+	if err != nil || order == nil {
+		return -1, err
+	}
+	return *order, nil
+}
+
+// MoveOfficialStickersTx regroups every official sticker of one pack.
+func MoveOfficialStickersTx(tx *gorm.DB, from, to string) (int64, error) {
+	result := tx.Model(&Entity{}).Where("is_official = ? AND pack = ?", true, from).Update("pack", to)
+	if result.Error == nil && result.RowsAffected > 0 {
+		notifyMutation()
+	}

+// OfficialByIDsTx locks the official stickers among ids, in id order.
+func OfficialByIDsTx(tx *gorm.DB, ids []uint64) ([]Entity, error) {

+	err := tx.Clauses(clause.Locking{Strength: "UPDATE"}).
+		Where("id IN ? AND is_official = ?", ids, true).Order("id ASC").Find(&rows).Error
+	return rows, err
+}

+package taskQueue
+
+import (
+	"errors"
+
+	db "github.com/YourTongji/YourTJ-Hub/apps/gooseforum/app/bundles/connect/dbconnect"
+	"gorm.io/gorm"
+)
+
+// ErrNotEnqueued proves that no commit was attempted. A commit error is an
+// unknown outcome: it must never cause a caller to refund accepted work.
+var ErrNotEnqueued = errors.New("task was not enqueued")
+
+// CreateWithAcceptance gives callers a receipt boundary without changing the
+// task payload or the ordinary Create API. Errors before COMMIT are definite
+// rejection; errors from COMMIT deliberately retain their uncertain outcome.
+func CreateWithAcceptance(entity *Entity) error {
+	return createWithAcceptance(db.Connect(), entity)
+}
+
+func createWithAcceptance(conn *gorm.DB, entity *Entity) error {
+	tx := conn.Begin()
+	if tx.Error != nil {
+		return errors.Join(ErrNotEnqueued, tx.Error)
+	}
+	defer func() { _ = tx.Rollback().Error }()
+	if err := CreateTx(tx, entity); err != nil {
+		return errors.Join(ErrNotEnqueued, err)
+	}
+	return tx.Commit().Error
+}

+// GetUnreadBadgeStyle reads an account preference independently of unread facts
+// and push-delivery consent. Unknown legacy values retain the numeric default.
+func GetUnreadBadgeStyle(userID uint64) (string, error) {
+	var user EntityComplete
+	if err := builder().Select("id", "unread_badge_style").Where("id = ? AND deleted_at IS NULL", userID).Take(&user).Error; err != nil {
+		return "", err
+	}
+	if user.UnreadBadgeStyle == UnreadBadgeDot {
+		return UnreadBadgeDot, nil
+	}
+	return UnreadBadgeNumber, nil
+}
+
+// SetUnreadBadgeStyle updates only the display field; a preference save cannot
+// overwrite a concurrent password/session or push-consent update.
+func SetUnreadBadgeStyle(userID uint64, style string) error {
+	if style != UnreadBadgeNumber && style != UnreadBadgeDot {
+		return ErrUnreadBadgeStyle
+	}
+	result := builder().Model(&EntityComplete{}).Where("id = ? AND deleted_at IS NULL", userID).Update("unread_badge_style", style)
+	if result.Error != nil {
+		return result.Error
+	}
+	if result.RowsAffected == 0 {
+		return gorm.ErrRecordNotFound
+	}
+	return nil
+}

+// Package xp owns the forum-local XP projection, immutable ledger, and
+// versioned reward policy tables. XP is independent from legacy Credit/points.
+package xp
+
+import (
+	"errors"
+	"time"
+
+	"gorm.io/gorm"
+)
+
+var ErrImmutableRecord = errors.New("xp record is append-only")
+
+type Balance struct {
+	UserID    uint64    `gorm:"primaryKey;autoIncrement:false;not null;column:user_id"`
+	CurrentXP int64     `gorm:"type:bigint;not null;default:0;column:current_xp;check:chk_xp_balances_nonnegative,current_xp >= 0"`
+	CreatedAt time.Time `gorm:"not null;autoCreateTime;<-:create"`
+	UpdatedAt time.Time `gorm:"not null;autoUpdateTime"`
+}
+
+func (Balance) TableName() string { return "xp_balances" }
+
+// Entry is an immutable XP ledger row. Corrections and reversals are new rows;
+// the source key is global so one business fact can settle only once.
+type Entry struct {
+	ID              uint64    `gorm:"primaryKey;autoIncrement;not null;column:id"`
+	UserID          uint64    `gorm:"not null;index:idx_xp_entries_user_time,priority:1;column:user_id"`
+	ActorUserID     uint64    `gorm:"not null;default:0;index:idx_xp_entries_actor,priority:1;column:actor_user_id"`
+	SourceKey       string    `gorm:"type:varchar(255);not null;uniqueIndex:idx_xp_entries_source_key;column:source_key"`
+	RuleSetVersion  uint64    `gorm:"not null;default:0;column:rule_set_version"`
+	RuleKey         string    `gorm:"type:varchar(64);not null;default:'';column:rule_key"`
+	Delta           int64     `gorm:"type:bigint;not null;column:delta"`
+	OccurredAt      time.Time `gorm:"not null;index:idx_xp_entries_user_time,priority:2;column:occurred_at"`
+	ReversalOfEntry *uint64   `gorm:"index;column:reversal_of_entry_id"`
+	Reason          string    `gorm:"type:text;not null;default:'';column:reason"`
+	CreatedAt       time.Time `gorm:"not null;autoCreateTime;<-:create"`
+}
+
+func (Entry) TableName() string { return "xp_entries" }
+
+func (*Entry) BeforeUpdate(*gorm.DB) error { return ErrImmutableRecord }
+func (*Entry) BeforeDelete(*gorm.DB) error { return ErrImmutableRecord }
+
+// RuleSet is an immutable, effective-dated reward policy version. A disabled
+// version pauses positive rewards from EffectiveAt until the next version.
+type RuleSet struct {
+	Version              uint64    `gorm:"primaryKey;autoIncrement:false;not null;column:version"`
+	PublishedBy          uint64    `gorm:"not null;default:0;index:idx_xp_rule_sets_publisher;column:published_by"`
+	Enabled              bool      `gorm:"not null;column:enabled"`
+	TimeZone             string    `gorm:"type:varchar(64);not null;default:'Asia/Shanghai';column:time_zone"`
+	DailyPositiveXPLimit *int64    `gorm:"type:bigint;column:daily_positive_xp_limit"`
+	EffectiveAt          time.Time `gorm:"not null;uniqueIndex:idx_xp_rule_sets_effective_at;column:effective_at"`
+	CreatedAt            time.Time `gorm:"not null;autoCreateTime;<-:create"`
+}
+
+func (RuleSet) TableName() string { return "xp_rule_sets" }
+
+func (*RuleSet) BeforeUpdate(*gorm.DB) error { return ErrImmutableRecord }
+func (*RuleSet) BeforeDelete(*gorm.DB) error { return ErrImmutableRecord }
+
+// RulePublicationLock is mutable coordination state, not policy history. A
+// single row is written before rule publication reads the current version so
+// PostgreSQL and SQLite serialize publishers consistently.
+type RulePublicationLock struct {
+	ID          uint64 `gorm:"primaryKey;autoIncrement:false;not null;column:id"`
+	LockVersion uint64 `gorm:"not null;default:0;column:lock_version"`
+}
+
+func (RulePublicationLock) TableName() string { return "xp_rule_publication_locks" }
+
+// RewardRule is one immutable event rule inside a rule-set version. Nil daily
+// limits are unbounded; zero is a deliberate deny-all limit.
+type RewardRule struct {
+	RuleSetVersion  uint64    `gorm:"primaryKey;autoIncrement:false;not null;column:rule_set_version"`
+	RuleKey         string    `gorm:"primaryKey;type:varchar(64);not null;column:rule_key"`
+	Enabled         bool      `gorm:"not null;column:enabled"`
+	RewardXP        int64     `gorm:"type:bigint;not null;column:reward_xp"`
+	MaxPerEventXP   *int64    `gorm:"type:bigint;column:max_per_event_xp"`
+	DailyCountLimit *int64    `gorm:"type:bigint;column:daily_count_limit"`
+	CreatedAt       time.Time `gorm:"not null;autoCreateTime;<-:create"`
+}
+
+func (RewardRule) TableName() string { return "xp_reward_rules" }
+
+func (*RewardRule) BeforeUpdate(*gorm.DB) error { return ErrImmutableRecord }
+func (*RewardRule) BeforeDelete(*gorm.DB) error { return ErrImmutableRecord }
+

+	UserID     uint64    `gorm:"primaryKey;autoIncrement:false;not null;column:user_id"`
+	UsageDate  string    `gorm:"primaryKey;type:varchar(10);not null;column:usage_date"`
+	PositiveXP int64     `gorm:"type:bigint;not null;default:0;column:positive_xp;check:chk_xp_daily_usage_nonnegative,positive_xp >= 0"`
+	CreatedAt  time.Time `gorm:"not null;autoCreateTime;<-:create"`
+	UpdatedAt  time.Time `gorm:"not null;autoUpdateTime"`
+}
+
+func (DailyUsage) TableName() string { return "xp_daily_usage" }
+
+type DailyRuleUsage struct {
+	UserID    uint64    `gorm:"primaryKey;autoIncrement:false;not null;column:user_id"`
+	RuleKey   string    `gorm:"primaryKey;type:varchar(64);not null;column:rule_key"`
+	UsageDate string    `gorm:"primaryKey;type:varchar(10);not null;column:usage_date"`
+	UsedCount int64     `gorm:"type:bigint;not null;default:0;column:used_count;check:chk_xp_daily_rule_usage_nonnegative,used_count >= 0"`
+	CreatedAt time.Time `gorm:"not null;autoCreateTime;<-:create"`
+	UpdatedAt time.Time `gorm:"not null;autoUpdateTime"`
+}
+
+func (DailyRuleUsage) TableName() string { return "xp_daily_rule_usage" }
+
+func Models() []any {
+	return []any{
+		&Balance{},
+		&Entry{},
+		&RuleSet{},
+		&RulePublicationLock{},
+		&RewardRule{},
+		&DailyUsage{},
+		&DailyRuleUsage{},
+	}
+}

@@ -0,0 +1,84 @@
+package emailactivationservice
+
+import (
+	"encoding/json"
+	"errors"
+	"time"
+
+	"github.com/YourTongji/YourTJ-Hub/apps/gooseforum/app/models/forum/users"
+	"github.com/YourTongji/YourTJ-Hub/apps/gooseforum/app/models/hotdataserve"
+	"github.com/YourTongji/YourTJ-Hub/apps/gooseforum/app/service/kvstore"
+	"github.com/YourTongji/YourTJ-Hub/apps/gooseforum/app/service/mailservice"
+)
+
+// ActivationStatus is private owner data. Reading it never reserves quota,
+// generates a token, or enqueues mail. Relative delays avoid client clock skew.
+type ActivationStatus struct {
+	CurrentEmail      string `json:"currentEmail"`
+	PendingEmail      string `json:"pendingEmail"`
+	TargetEmail       string `json:"targetEmail"`
+	TargetKind        string `json:"targetKind"`
+	State             string `json:"state"`
+	RemainingToday    int    `json:"remainingToday"`
+	DailyLimit        int    `json:"dailyLimit"`
+	RetryAfterSeconds int64  `json:"retryAfterSeconds"`
+}
+
+func GetStatus(user users.EntityComplete, now time.Time) (ActivationStatus, error) {
+	status := activationEligibility(user, now, hotdataserve.GetSecuritySettingsConfigCache().EnableEmailVerification, mailservice.IsConfigured())
+	key, _ := resendKey(user.Id, now)
+	data, err := kvstore.GetBytes(key)
+	if errors.Is(err, kvstore.ErrNotFound) {
+		return status, nil
+	}
+	if err != nil {
+		return status, err
+	}
+	var state resendState
+	if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &state); err != nil {
+		return status, err
+	}
+	return statusWithQuota(status, state, now), nil
+}
+
+func activationEligibility(user users.EntityComplete, now time.Time, enabled, mailReady bool) ActivationStatus {
+	status := ActivationStatus{CurrentEmail: user.Email, PendingEmail: user.FreshPendingEmail(now), TargetKind: "none", State: "ready", DailyLimit: resendDailyLimit, RemainingToday: resendDailyLimit}
+	if status.PendingEmail != "" {
+		status.TargetKind = "pending"
+		status.TargetEmail = status.PendingEmail
+	} else if user.IsActivated == users.ActivationPending && user.Email != "" {
+		status.TargetKind = "current"
+		status.TargetEmail = user.Email
+	}
+	switch {
+	case user.IsFrozen == users.StatusFrozen || user.AnonymousGovernanceBlocked:
+		status.State = "frozen"
+	case !enabled:
+		status.State = "disabled"
+	case user.IsActivated != users.ActivationPending && status.PendingEmail == "":
+		status.State = "verified"
+	case status.TargetEmail == "":
+		status.State = "missing_email"
+	case !mailReady:
+		status.State = "mail_unavailable"
+	}
+	return status
+}
+
+func statusWithQuota(status ActivationStatus, state resendState, now time.Time) ActivationStatus {
+	status.RemainingToday = min(max(resendDailyLimit-state.Count, 0), resendDailyLimit)
+	if status.State != "ready" {
+		return status
+	}
+	if status.RemainingToday == 0 {
+		status.State = "daily_limit"
+		tomorrow := time.Date(now.Year(), now.Month(), now.Day()+1, 0, 0, 0, 0, now.Location())
+		status.RetryAfterSeconds = ceilSeconds(tomorrow.Sub(now))
+	} else if delay := time.Unix(state.LastSentAt, 0).Add(resendInterval).Sub(now); state.LastSentAt > 0 && delay > 0 {
+		status.State = "cooldown"
+		status.RetryAfterSeconds = ceilSeconds(delay)
+	}
+	return status
+}
+
+func ceilSeconds(delay time.Duration) int64 { return max(int64((delay+time.Second-1)/time.Second), 0) }

@@ -0,0 +1,65 @@
+package publicationservice
+
+import (
+	"errors"
+	"strings"
+	"time"
+	"unicode/utf8"
+
+	"github.com/YourTongji/YourTJ-Hub/apps/gooseforum/app/models/forum/postRevisions"
+	"github.com/YourTongji/YourTJ-Hub/apps/gooseforum/app/models/forum/posts"
+	"github.com/YourTongji/YourTJ-Hub/apps/gooseforum/app/models/forum/topics"
+	"github.com/YourTongji/YourTJ-Hub/apps/gooseforum/app/service/fileusageservice"
+	"gorm.io/gorm"
+	"gorm.io/gorm/clause"
+)
+
+var ErrReviewReason = errors.New("a rejection explanation of 1 to 512 characters is required")
+
+// NormalizeRejectionReason bounds author-visible plain text. Model evidence and
+// private moderation notes are not copied into this field automatically.
+func NormalizeRejectionReason(reason string) (string, error) {
+	reason = strings.TrimSpace(reason)
+	if reason == "" || utf8.RuneCountInString(reason) > 512 {
+		return "", ErrReviewReason
+	}
+	return reason, nil
+}
+
+// RecordLegacyRejectionTx retains the decision for the compatibility review path
+// using the existing immutable revision and appeal model. The caller updates the
+// blocked status in this same transaction; any later failure rolls back both.
+func RecordLegacyRejectionTx(tx *gorm.DB, postID, actorID uint64, reason string) (uint64, error) {
+	normalized, err := NormalizeRejectionReason(reason)
+	if err != nil {
+		return 0, err
+	}
+	var post posts.Entity
+	if err := tx.Clauses(clause.Locking{Strength: "UPDATE"}).First(&post, postID).Error; err != nil {
+		return 0, err
+	}
+	var topic topics.Entity
+	if err := tx.Clauses(clause.Locking{Strength: "UPDATE"}).First(&topic, post.TopicId).Error; err != nil {
+		return 0, err
+	}
+	if post.LatestRevisionId != 0 || post.ProcessStatus != posts.ProcessStatusPending || !available(topic, post) || (topic.TopicType == topics.TopicTypeWiki && post.PostNo == 1) {
+		return 0, ErrUnavailable
+	}
+	revision := snapshot(&topic, &post)
+	revision.Version = postRevisions.NextVersionTx(tx, post.Id)
+	revision.ProcessStatus = posts.ProcessStatusBlocked
+	revision.ReviewReason = normalized
+	revision.ReviewActorId = actorID
+	now := time.Now()
+	revision.ReviewedAt = &now
+	if err := tx.Create(&revision).Error; err != nil {
+		return 0, err
+	}
+	if err := fileusageservice.RetainLegacyRevisionImagesTx(tx, revision.Id, topic.Id, post.Id, post.UserId, post.PostNo == 1); err != nil {
+		return 0, err
+	}
+	if err := tx.Model(&post).Update("latest_revision_id", revision.Id).Error; err != nil {
+		return 0, err
+	}
+	return revision.Id, nil
+}

+	return Preferences{BadgeStyle: style}, err
+}
+
+func UpdatePreferences(userID uint64, style string) (Preferences, error) {
+	if err := users.SetUnreadBadgeStyle(userID, style); err != nil {
+		return Preferences{}, err
+	}
+	Invalidate(userID)
+	// Existing private invalidation hints refresh other sessions. They contain
+	// neither counts nor content and do not create a notification or push task.
+	realtimeservice.PublishNotificationsChanged(userID, "preferences")
+	return Preferences{BadgeStyle: style}, nil
+}

+package xpservice
+
+// Level is derived from an account's current XP and participation eligibility.
+// It is not persisted as authoritative account state.
+type Level uint8
+
+const (
+	LevelSeedling  Level = iota // Lv0 茶苗：当前不具备参与资格
+	LevelGreenTea               // Lv1 绿茶：0 XP
+	LevelWhiteTea               // Lv2 白茶：250 XP
+	LevelYellowTea              // Lv3 黄茶：1,750 XP
+	LevelBlueTea                // Lv4 青茶：6,250 XP
+	LevelRedTea                 // Lv5 红茶：15,000 XP
+	LevelBlackTea               // Lv6 黑茶：30,000 XP
+)
+
+// LevelForXP computes the current level without consulting account age or
+// storing a level snapshot. Ineligible accounts are always Lv0; eligible
+// accounts at or below zero XP are Lv1.
+func LevelForXP(currentXP int64, eligible bool) Level {
+	if !eligible {
+		return LevelSeedling
+	}
+	switch {
+	case currentXP >= 30_000:
+		return LevelBlackTea
+	case currentXP >= 15_000:
+		return LevelRedTea
+	case currentXP >= 6_250:
+		return LevelBlueTea
+	case currentXP >= 1_750:
+		return LevelYellowTea
+	case currentXP >= 250:
+		return LevelWhiteTea
+	default:
+		return LevelGreenTea
+	}
+}

@@ -0,0 +1,38 @@
+<script setup lang="ts">
+import { ref, watch } from 'vue'
+import { useI18n } from 'vue-i18n'
+import { Dialog, DialogContent, DialogDescription, DialogFooter, DialogHeader, DialogTitle } from '@/admin/components/ui/dialog'
+import { Button } from '@/admin/components/ui/button'
+import { emptyRejectionDraft, rejectionReason, rejectionError } from '@/runtime/review-rejection'
+import RejectionReasonFields from '@/site/components/RejectionReasonFields.vue'
+const props = defineProps<{ open: boolean; busy?: boolean; error?: string }>()
+const emit = defineEmits<{ confirm: [reason: string]; 'update:open': [open: boolean] }>()
+const { t } = useI18n()
+const draft = ref(emptyRejectionDraft())
+const validation = ref('')
+watch(() => props.open, open => { if (open) { draft.value = emptyRejectionDraft(); validation.value = '' } }, { immediate: true })
+function confirm() {
+  if (props.busy || !props.open) return
+  const reason = rejectionReason(t, draft.value)
+  validation.value = rejectionError(t, reason)
+  if (validation.value) { document.getElementById('review-rejection-preset')?.focus(); return }
+  emit('confirm', reason)
+}
+</script>
+<template>
+  <Dialog :open="open" @update:open="value => !busy && emit('update:open', value)">
+    <DialogContent class="max-h-[calc(100dvh_-_2rem)] overflow-y-auto sm:max-w-md" :show-close-button="!busy" @escape-key-down="event => busy && event.preventDefault()" @interact-outside="event => busy && event.preventDefault()">
+      <DialogHeader>
+        <DialogTitle>{{ t('reviewRejection.title') }}</DialogTitle>
+        <DialogDescription>{{ t('reviewRejection.description') }}</DialogDescription>
+      </DialogHeader>
+      <form class="space-y-4" @submit.prevent="confirm">
+        <RejectionReasonFields v-model="draft" id-prefix="review-rejection" :disabled="busy" :error="validation || error" />
+        <DialogFooter>
+          <Button type="button" variant="outline" :disabled="busy" @click="emit('update:open', false)">{{ t('common.cancel') }}</Button>
+          <Button type="submit" data-test="confirm-rejection" variant="destructive" :disabled="busy">{{ busy ? t('common.loading') : t('moderation.review.confirmReject') }}</Button>
+        </DialogFooter>
+      </form>
+    </DialogContent>
+  </Dialog>
+</template>

 ### Channel types
 
 Each callback URL can choose a channel type:
 
 - **Generic webhook (JSON)**: the request format above; any HTTP 2xx counts as success.
-- **Feishu group bot**: add a "custom bot" to a Feishu group and enter its webhook URL. The Feishu channel only delivers approval events, rendered as a card with the target, reason, excerpt, and quick-action buttons. A Feishu webhook URL is a credential: it is stored encrypted, never shown after saving, and saving with an empty value keeps the configured URL. A Feishu response with HTTP 200 but a non-zero `code` counts as a failure.
+- **Feishu group bot**: add a "custom bot" to a Feishu group and enter its webhook URL. The Feishu channel delivers approval events and `user.signup` alerts. Approval cards contain the target, reason, excerpt and quick actions; signup cards show public usernames without email, session data or approval actions. A Feishu webhook URL is a credential: it is stored encrypted, never shown after saving, and saving with an empty value keeps the configured URL. A Feishu response with HTTP 200 but a non-zero `code` counts as a failure.
 
 If "signature verification" is enabled on the Feishu bot, enter its secret as the Secret; the system then adds `timestamp` and `sign` to the request body:
 
 ```text

+  new: 'stickerMarketStatusNew',
+  queued: 'stickerMarketStatusQueued',
+  importing: 'stickerMarketStatusImporting',
+  ready: 'stickerMarketStatusReady',
+  partial: 'stickerMarketStatusPartial',
+  failed: 'stickerMarketStatusFailed',
+}
+
+const statusOptions = computed(() => [
+  { value: '', label: adminText('stickerMarketAllStatuses') },
+  ...(Object.keys(statusTexts) as AdminStickerMarketStatus[]).map((value) => ({ value, label: adminText(statusTexts[value]) })),
+])
+
+const reasonTexts: Record<string, string> = {
+  timeout: 'stickerMarketReasonTimeout',
+  blocked: 'stickerMarketReasonBlocked',
+  tooLarge: 'stickerMarketReasonTooLarge',
+  unsupported: 'stickerMarketReasonUnsupported',
+  invalid: 'stickerMarketReasonInvalid',
+  status: 'stickerMarketReasonStatus',
+  storage: 'stickerMarketReasonStorage',
+  unavailable: 'stickerMarketReasonUnavailable',
+  empty: 'stickerMarketReasonEmpty',
+}
+
+// Market messageCodes are admin-only, so the page localizes them like the sticker library does.
+const marketMessageTexts: Record<string, string> = {
+  'admin.sticker.market.busy': 'stickerMarketBusy',
+  'admin.sticker.market.disabled': 'stickerMarketDisabled',
+  'admin.sticker.market.unavailable': 'stickerMarketUnavailable',
+  'admin.sticker.market.notReady': 'stickerMarketNotReady',
+  'admin.sticker.notFound': 'k00vh1',
+  'admin.sticker.nameRequired': 'stickerPackNameRequired',
+  'common.request.invalidParams': 'stickerMarketTopicInvalid',
+}
+
+// Rename failures stay next to the name field instead of a toast.
+const nameMessageTexts: Record<string, string> = {
+  'admin.sticker.nameInvalid': 'k00vgo',
+  'admin.sticker.nameExists': 'stickerMarketNameExists',
+  'admin.sticker.nameReserved': 'stickerNameReserved',
+}
+
+// Imports name stickers m_ + 40 hex characters until an administrator renames them.
+const GENERATED_NAME = /^m_[0-9a-f]{40}$/
+
+function reasonText(reason: string) {
+  const key = reasonTexts[reason]
+  return key ? adminText(key) : reason
+}
+
+function statusText(value: AdminStickerMarketStatus) {
+  return adminText(statusTexts[value] ?? value)
+}
+
+function statusVariant(value: AdminStickerMarketStatus): 'secondary' | 'destructive' | 'outline' {
+  if (value === 'failed') return 'destructive'
+  if (value === 'ready' || value === 'queued' || value === 'importing') return 'secondary'
+  return 'outline'
+}
+
+// Imported packs show the stored cover members see; before that, a server-made
+// thumbnail of the upstream cover, so the browser never contacts the upstream host.
+function coverSource(pack: AdminStickerMarketPack) {
+  return [pack.coverUrl, pack.iconUrl].find((url) => url && !brokenCovers.value.has(url)) ?? ''
+}
+
+function markCoverBroken(url: string) {
+  brokenCovers.value = new Set(brokenCovers.value).add(url)
+}
+
+function isUploaded(pack: AdminStickerMarketPack) {
+  return pack.source === 'upload'
+}
+
+function isRunning(pack: AdminStickerMarketPack) {
+  return pack.status === 'queued' || pack.status === 'importing'
+}
+
+function importLabel(pack: AdminStickerMarketPack) {
+  if (pack.status === 'failed' || pack.status === 'partial') return adminText('stickerMarketRetryImport')
+  if (pack.status === 'ready') return adminText('stickerMarketImportAgain')
+  return adminText('stickerMarketImport')
+}
+
+function marketToastError(err: unknown, fallbackKey: string) {
+  const messageCode = (err as { messageCode?: string } | null)?.messageCode || ''
+  const key = marketMessageTexts[messageCode]
+  if (key) {
+    adminToast.warning(adminText(key))
+    return
+  }
+  adminToast.error(err, adminText(fallbackKey))
+}
+
+function formatTime(value: string | null | undefined) {
+  if (!value) return ''
+  const date = new Date(value)
+  if (Number.isNaN(date.getTime())) return value
+  const pad = (part: number) => String(part).padStart(2, '0')
+  return `${date.getFullYear()}-${pad(date.getMonth() + 1)}-${pad(date.getDate())} ${pad(date.getHours())}:${pad(date.getMinutes())}`
+}
+
+function schedulePoll() {
+  clearTimeout(pollTimer)
+  pollTimer = undefined
+  if (unmounted) return
+  if (packs.value.some(isRunning) || (detail.value && isRunning(detail.value.pack))) {
+    pollTimer = setTimeout(() => void refresh(true), POLL_INTERVAL_MS)
+  }
+}
+
+async function refresh(quiet = false) {
+  if (unmounted) return
+  if (!quiet) {
+    loading.value = true
+    error.value = ''
+  }
+  try {
+    market.value = await getStickerMarket({
+      topic: topic.value,
+      q: appliedKeyword.value,
+      status: status.value,
+      source: source.value,
+      page: page.value,
+      pageSize: pageSize.value,
+    })
+    if (detail.value) {
+      const current = market.value.packs.find((pack) => pack.id === detail.value?.pack.id)
+      const shown = detail.value.pack
+      // Items arrive one by one during an import; reload the dialog whenever its counts move.
+      if (!current) {
+        detail.value = null
+      } else if (current.status !== shown.status || current.itemCount !== shown.itemCount || current.failedCount !== shown.failedCount) {
+        detail.value = await getStickerMarketPack(current.id)
+      }
+    }
+  } catch (err) {
+    if (!quiet) error.value = err instanceof Error ? err.message : adminText('stickerMarketLoadFailed')
+  } finally {
+    loading.value = false
+    if (!unmounted) schedulePoll()
+  }
+}
+
+function applySearch() {
+  appliedKeyword.value = keyword.value.trim()
+  page.value = 1
+  void refresh()
+}
+
+function clearSearch() {
+  keyword.value = ''
+  applySearch()
+}
+
+watch(detail, (next, previous) => {
+  if (next?.pack.id !== previous?.pack.id) cancelRename()
+})
+
+watch([topic, status, source], () => {
+  page.value = 1
+  void refresh()
+})
+
+function updatePage(value: number) {
+  page.value = value
+  void refresh()
+}
+
+function updatePageSize(value: number) {
+  pageSize.value = value
+  page.value = 1
+  void refresh()
+}
+
+async function syncCatalog() {
+  syncing.value = true
+  try {
+    const result = await syncStickerMarket()
+    adminToast.success(result.missing > 0
+      ? adminText('stickerMarketSyncedWithMissing', { packs: result.packs, missing: result.missing })
+      : adminText('stickerMarketSynced', { packs: result.packs }))
+    await refresh()
+  } catch (err) {
+    marketToastError(err, 'stickerMarketLoadFailed')
+  } finally {
+    syncing.value = false
+  }
+}
+
+function replacePack(next: AdminStickerMarketPack) {
+  if (!market.value) return
+  market.value.packs = market.value.packs.map((pack) => (pack.id === next.id ? next : pack))
+  if (detail.value?.pack.id === next.id) detail.value = { ...detail.value, pack: next }
+}
+
+async function queueImport(pack: AdminStickerMarketPack) {
+  busyPackId.value = pack.id
+  try {
+    replacePack(await importStickerMarketPack(pack.id))
+    adminToast.success(adminText('stickerMarketImportQueued'))
+    schedulePoll()
+  } catch (err) {
+    marketToastError(err, 'stickerMarketSaveFailed')
+  } finally {
+    busyPackId.value = null
+  }
+}
+
+async function savePack(pack: AdminStickerMarketPack, changes: { published?: boolean, sortOrder?: number }) {
+  const published = changes.published ?? pack.published
+  const sortOrder = changes.sortOrder ?? pack.sortOrder
+  if (published === pack.published && sortOrder === pack.sortOrder) return
+  busyPackId.value = pack.id
+  try {
+    replacePack(await saveStickerMarketPack({ id: pack.id, published, sortOrder }))
+    if (changes.published !== undefined) {
+      adminToast.success(adminText(published ? 'stickerMarketPublished' : 'stickerMarketUnpublished', { name: pack.name }))
+    }
+  } catch (err) {
+    marketToastError(err, 'stickerMarketSaveFailed')
+  } finally {
+    busyPackId.value = null
+  }
+}
+
+function saveSortOrder(pack: AdminStickerMarketPack, event: Event) {
+  const value = Number((event.target as HTMLInputElement).value)
+  if (!Number.isInteger(value)) {
+    (event.target as HTMLInputElement).value = String(pack.sortOrder)
+    return
+  }
+  void savePack(pack, { sortOrder: value })
+}
+
+async function openDetail(pack: AdminStickerMarketPack) {
+  detail.value = { pack, items: [] }
+  detailLoading.value = true
+  try {
+    const loaded = await getStickerMarketPack(pack.id)
+    if (unmounted) return
+    detail.value = market.value?.packs.some((item) => item.id === pack.id) ? loaded : null
+  } catch (err) {
+    detail.value = null
+    marketToastError(err, 'stickerMarketLoadFailed')
+  } finally {
+    detailLoading.value = false
+    schedulePoll()
+  }
+}
+
+async function toggleItem(item: AdminStickerMarketItem, isEnabled: boolean) {
+  busyItemId.value = item.stickerId
+  try {
+    await saveStickerMarketItem({ stickerId: item.stickerId, isEnabled })
+    item.isEnabled = isEnabled
+    adminToast.success(adminText(isEnabled ? 'stickerMarketItemRestored' : 'stickerMarketItemWithdrawn'))
+  } catch (err) {
+    marketToastError(err, 'stickerMarketSaveFailed')
+  } finally {
+    busyItemId.value = null
+  }
+}
+
+function renameFieldId(item: AdminStickerMarketItem) {
+  return `sticker-market-name-${item.stickerId}`
+}
+
+async function startRename(item: AdminStickerMarketItem) {
+  renamingId.value = item.stickerId
+  renameDraft.value = GENERATED_NAME.test(item.name) ? '' : item.name
+  renameError.value = ''
+  await nextTick()
+  const field = document.getElementById(renameFieldId(item)) as HTMLInputElement | null
+  field?.focus()
+  field?.select()
+}
+
+function cancelRename() {
+  renamingId.value = null
+  renameError.value = ''
+}
+
+// Escape first leaves an open name field; a second press closes the dialog.
+function onDialogEscape(event: KeyboardEvent) {
+  if (renamingId.value === null) return
+  event.preventDefault()
+  cancelRename()
+}
+
+async function submitRename(item: AdminStickerMarketItem) {
+  if (renamingId.value !== item.stickerId || busyItemId.value === item.stickerId) return
+  const name = renameDraft.value.trim()
+  if (!name || name === item.name) {
+    cancelRename()
+    return
+  }
+  busyItemId.value = item.stickerId
+  renameError.value = ''
+  try {
+    await saveStickerMarketItem({ stickerId: item.stickerId, name, isEnabled: item.isEnabled })
+    item.aliases = item.aliases.includes(name)
+      ? item.aliases.filter((alias) => alias !== name)
+      : [...item.aliases, item.name]
+    item.name = name
+    renamingId.value = null
+    adminToast.success(adminText('stickerMarketRenamed', { name }))
+  } catch (err) {
+    const key = nameMessageTexts[(err as { messageCode?: string } | null)?.messageCode || '']
+    if (key) {
+      renameError.value = adminText(key)
+      void nextTick(() => document.getElementById(renameFieldId(item))?.focus())
+    } else {
+      marketToastError(err, 'stickerMarketSaveFailed')
+    }
+  } finally {
+    busyItemId.value = null
+  }
+}
+
+function topicPayload(form: { topic: string, topicLabel: string }) {
+  return form.topic === NEW_TOPIC ? { topicLabel: form.topicLabel.trim() } : { topic: form.topic }
+}
+
+// Name and category are required; returns the warning to show, or '' when valid.
+function packInfoProblem(form: { name: string, topic: string, topicLabel: string }) {
+  if (!form.name.trim()) return adminText('stickerPackNameRequired')
+  if (form.topic === NEW_TOPIC ? !form.topicLabel.trim() : !form.topic) return adminText('stickerMarketTopicRequired')
+  return ''
+}
+
+function openCreate() {
+  const first = market.value?.topics?.[0]?.id ?? NEW_TOPIC
+  Object.assign(createForm, { name: '', topic: first, topicLabel: '' })
+  createOpen.value = true
+}
+
+async function submitCreate() {
+  const problem = packInfoProblem(createForm)
+  if (problem) {
+    adminToast.warning(problem)
+    return
+  }
+  creating.value = true
+  try {
+    const pack = await createStickerMarketPack({ name: createForm.name.trim(), ...topicPayload(createForm) })
+    createOpen.value = false
+    adminToast.success(adminText('stickerMarketPackCreated', { name: pack.name }))
+    uploadTarget.value = pack
+    await refresh()
+  } catch (err) {
+    marketToastError(err, 'stickerMarketSaveFailed')
+  } finally {
+    creating.value = false
+  }
+}
+
+function openInfoEdit(pack: AdminStickerMarketPack) {
+  Object.assign(infoForm, { name: pack.name, topic: pack.topic || NEW_TOPIC, topicLabel: '' })
+  infoEditing.value = pack
+}
+
+async function submitInfo() {
+  const pack = infoEditing.value
+  if (!pack) return
+  const problem = packInfoProblem(infoForm)
+  if (problem) {
+    adminToast.warning(problem)
+    return
+  }
+  infoSaving.value = true
+  try {
+    replacePack(await saveStickerMarketPack({
+      id: pack.id,
+      published: pack.published,
+      sortOrder: pack.sortOrder,
+      name: infoForm.name.trim(),
+      ...topicPayload(infoForm),
+    }))
+    infoEditing.value = null
+    adminToast.success(adminText('k000e'))
+    if (infoForm.topic === NEW_TOPIC) await refresh(true)
+  } catch (err) {
+    marketToastError(err, 'stickerMarketSaveFailed')
+  } finally {
+    infoSaving.value = false
+  }
+}
+
+function openUpload(pack: AdminStickerMarketPack) {
+  detail.value = null
+  uploadTarget.value = pack
+}
+
+async function uploadToTarget(file: File) {
+  const pack = uploadTarget.value
+  if (!pack) throw new Error(adminText('k00vh1'))
+  const { result, pack: next } = await uploadStickerMarketFile(pack.id, file)
+  replacePack(next)
+  if (uploadTarget.value?.id === next.id) uploadTarget.value = next
+  return result
+}
+
+function closeUpload(open: boolean) {
+  if (open || uploadBusy.value) return
+  uploadTarget.value = null
+  void refresh(true)
+}
+
+async function publishUploaded() {
+  const pack = uploadTarget.value
+  if (!pack) return
+  uploadPublishing.value = true
+  try {
+    replacePack(await saveStickerMarketPack({ id: pack.id, published: true, sortOrder: pack.sortOrder }))
+    adminToast.success(adminText('stickerMarketPublished', { name: pack.name }))
+    uploadTarget.value = null
+    await refresh(true)
+  } catch (err) {
+    marketToastError(err, 'stickerMarketSaveFailed')
+  } finally {
+    uploadPublishing.value = false
+  }
+}
+
+onMounted(() => {
+  void refresh()
+})
+
+onBeforeUnmount(() => {
+  unmounted = true
+  clearTimeout(pollTimer)
+})
+</script>
+
+<template>
+  <BasicPage :title="adminText('stickerMarketTitle')" :description="adminText('stickerMarketDescription')" sticky>
+    <template #actions>
+      <div class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
+        <Button variant="outline" size="icon" type="button" :aria-label="adminText('k004q')" :title="adminText('k004q')" @click="refresh()">
+          <RefreshCw class="size-4" />
+        </Button>
+        <Button variant="outline" type="button" @click="openCreate">
+          <Plus class="size-4" />
+          {{ adminText('stickerMarketUploadPack') }}
+        </Button>
+        <Button type="button" :disabled="syncing || market?.enabled === false" @click="syncCatalog">
+          <Loader2 v-if="syncing" class="size-4 animate-spin" />
+          <RefreshCw v-else class="size-4" />
+          {{ syncing ? adminText('stickerMarketSyncing') : adminText('stickerMarketSync') }}
+        </Button>
+      </div>
+    </template>
+
+    <p v-if="market && !market.enabled" role="status" class="mb-3 rounded-md border bg-muted/30 px-3 py-2 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
+      {{ adminText('stickerMarketDisabledNotice') }}
+    </p>
+
+    <div class="mb-3 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
+      <Badge variant="secondary">{{ adminText('stickerMarketTotal', { total: market?.total ?? 0 }) }}</Badge>
+      <span v-if="market?.lastSyncedAt">{{ adminText('stickerMarketLastSync', { time: formatTime(market.lastSyncedAt) }) }}</span>
+      <span v-else-if="market">{{ adminText('stickerMarketNeverSynced') }}</span>
+    </div>
+
+    <ManagementTable
+      :columns="tableColumns"
+      :loading="loading"
+      :error="error"
+      :total="market?.total ?? 0"
+      :page="page"
+      :page-size="pageSize"
+      @update:page="updatePage"
+      @update:page-size="updatePageSize"
+      @retry="refresh()"
+    >
+      <template #header>
+        <AdminToolbar class="-mx-3 -my-2 border-b-0">
+          <form class="flex min-w-0 flex-1 items-center gap-2" @submit.prevent="applySearch">

+              <Search class="pointer-events-none absolute start-2.5 top-1/2 size-4 -translate-y-1/2 text-muted-foreground" />

+            </div>
+            <Button size="sm" type="submit" variant="outline" class="h-9 px-4">{{ adminText('k00al') }}</Button>
+            <Button v-if="appliedKeyword" variant="ghost" size="sm" type="button" class="h-9" @click="clearSearch">
+              {{ adminText('k00at') }}

evidence.detail:
diff --git a/apps/gooseforum/resource/src/admin/runtime/sticker-upload-retry.ts b/apps/gooseforum/resource/src/admin/runtime/sticker-upload-retry.ts
new file mode 100644
index 000000000..2a87c52ad
--- /dev/null
+++ b/apps/gooseforum/resource/src/admin/runtime/sticker-upload-retry.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,56 @@
+/** Keep only failed ZIP entries, copying compressed bytes without decoding images.
+ * Central-directory offsets are rewritten; the server still validates the archive.
+ * ZIP record layout: https://pkware.cachefly.net/webdocs/casestudies/APPNOTE.TXT (4.3).
+ */
+export async function failedStickerArchive(file: File, names: string[]): Promise<File> {
+  const bytes = new Uint8Array(await file.arrayBuffer())
+  const view = new DataView(bytes.buffer)
+  const invalid = () => new Error('Invalid or ambiguous retry archive')
+  let end = bytes.length - 22
+  while (end >= Math.max(0, bytes.length - 65557)) {
+    if (view.getUint32(end, true) === 0x06054b50 && end + 22 + view.getUint16(end + 20, true) === bytes.length) break
+    end--
+  }
+  if (end < 0 || end < bytes.length - 65557) throw invalid()
+  const count = view.getUint16(end + 10, true)
+  const centralStart = view.getUint32(end + 16, true)
+  if (view.getUint32(end + 4, true) !== 0 || view.getUint16(end + 8, true) !== count || count === 0xffff || centralStart >= end) throw invalid()
+  const records: { name: string, start: number, central: Uint8Array<ArrayBuffer> }[] = []
+  let cursor = centralStart
+  for (let index = 0; index < count; index++) {
+    if (cursor + 46 > end || view.getUint32(cursor, true) !== 0x02014b50) throw invalid()
+    const nameLength = view.getUint16(cursor + 28, true)
+    const length = 46 + nameLength + view.getUint16(cursor + 30, true) + view.getUint16(cursor + 32, true)
+    const start = view.getUint32(cursor + 42, true)
+    if (cursor + length > end || start + 30 > centralStart || view.getUint32(start, true) !== 0x04034b50) throw invalid()
+    records.push({ name: new TextDecoder('utf-8', { fatal: true }).decode(bytes.subarray(cursor + 46, cursor + 46 + nameLength)), start, central: bytes.slice(cursor, cursor + length) })
+    cursor += length
+  }
+  if (cursor !== end || cursor - centralStart !== view.getUint32(end + 12, true)) throw invalid()
+  records.sort((a, b) => a.start - b.start)
+  const wanted = new Set(names)
+  const locals: Uint8Array<ArrayBuffer>[] = []
+  const directory: Uint8Array<ArrayBuffer>[] = []
+  let offset = 0
+  for (const [index, record] of records.entries()) {
+    if (!wanted.has(record.name)) continue
+    if (records.filter(item => item.name === record.name).length !== 1) throw invalid()
+    const next = records[index + 1]?.start ?? centralStart
+    if (next <= record.start) throw invalid()
+    const local = bytes.slice(record.start, next)
+    new DataView(record.central.buffer).setUint32(42, offset, true)
+    locals.push(local)
+    directory.push(record.central)
+    offset += local.length
+    wanted.delete(record.name)
+  }
+  if (wanted.size || !directory.length) throw invalid()
+  const footer = new Uint8Array(22)
+  const footerView = new DataView(footer.buffer)
+  footerView.setUint32(0, 0x06054b50, true)
+  footerView.setUint16(8, directory.length, true)
+  footerView.setUint16(10, directory.length, true)
+  footerView.setUint32(12, directory.reduce((size, record) => size + record.length, 0), true)
+  footerView.setUint32(16, offset, true)
+  return new File([...locals, ...directory, footer], file.name, { type: 'application/zip' })
+}

diff --git a/apps/gooseforum/resource/src/runtime/caret-text.ts b/apps/gooseforum/resource/src/runtime/caret-text.ts new file mode 100644 index 000000000..aba72b3b4 --- /dev/null +++ b/apps/gooseforum/resource/src/runtime/caret-text.ts @@ -0,0 +1,94 @@ +/** + * 折叠光标附近的纯文本窗口（issue #1332 贴纸原子删除用）。 + * + * 只读取光标所在的最近块级元素（段落、列表项、表格单元格、标题、代码块、引用、图注； + * 都找不到时退到编辑器根的直接子节点）内的文本，避免把相邻块的文本拼成假 token； + * 区间映射回 Range 时跨内联文本节点（`[:sticker:hu` 与 `aji:]` 分处不同 span 也能整段选中）。 + * 光标直接落在编辑器根上（不在任何块内）时返回 null，不读取任何块。 + */ +interface CaretTextWindow { + /** 块内以光标为中心的纯文本（前后各至多 limit 字符） */ + text: string + /** 光标在 text 中的下标 */ + caret: number + /** 把 text 内的字符区间映射为 DOM Range；区间无效或为空时 null */ + range(start: number, end: number): Range | null +} + +/** 块级元素：光标在最近的一个处停下，相邻块之间不可能拼出跨块 token。 */ +const BLOCK_ELEMENTS = new Set(['P', 'LI', 'TD', 'TH', 'DT', 'DD', 'H1', 'H2', 'H3', 'H4', 'H5', 'H6', 'PRE', 'BLOCKQUOTE', 'FIGCAPTION']) + +function isBlockElement(node: Node | null): boolean { + return node instanceof Element && BLOCK_ELEMENTS.has(node.tagName) +} + +export function readCaretTextWindow( + container: Node, + offset: number, + limit: number, + element: HTMLElement, +): CaretTextWindow | null { + if (container === element || !element.contains(container)) return null + + let block: Node = container + if (!isBlockElement(container)) { + for (let current = container.parentNode; current; current = current.parentNode) { + // 先判编辑器根：不退化成读取整个编辑器（根下相邻的块会被拼成假 token） + if (current === element) break + block = current + if (isBlockElement(current)) break + } + } + + const nodes: Array<{ node: Text; start: number }> = [] + let content = '' + if (block.nodeType === Node.TEXT_NODE) { + nodes.push({ node: block as Text, start: 0 }) + content = block.textContent ?? '' + } else { + const walker = document.createTreeWalker(block, NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT) + for (let node = walker.nextNode(); node; node = walker.nextNode()) { + nodes.push({ node: node as Text, start: content.length }) + content += node.textContent ?? '' + } + } + + // Range.toString() 给出与文本节点拼接一致的偏移，元素容器（光标落在节点边界）也适用 + const probe = document.createRange() + probe.setStart(block, 0) + probe.setEnd(container, offset) + const caretAt = probe.toString().length + if (caretAt > content.length) return null + + const windowStart = Math.max(0, caretAt - limit) + const windowEnd = Math.min(content.length, caretAt + limit) + + /** + * 文本下标映射为 Range 端点。起点落在后一节点起点（不把前面的内容包进来）， + * 终点落在前一节点末尾（不把紧邻的 `
`/`` 等非文本节点包进来）。 + */ + function pointAt(index: number, edge: 'start' | 'end'): { node: Node; offset: number } | null { + for (const entry of nodes) { + const length = entry.node.textContent?.length ?? 0 + const inside = edge === 'end' ? index <= entry.start + length : index < entry.start + length + if (inside) return { node: entry.node, offset: index - entry.start } + } + const last = nodes[nodes.length - 1] + return last ? { node: last.node, offset: last.node.textContent?.length ?? 0 } : null + } + + return { + text: content.slice(windowStart, windowEnd), + caret: caretAt - windowStart, + range(start, end) { + if (start >= end) return null + const from = pointAt(windowStart + start, 'start') + const to = pointAt(windowStart + end, 'end') + if (!from || !to) return null + const range = document.createRange() + range.setStart(from.node, from.offset) + range.setEnd(to.node, to.offset) + return range + }, + } +}

+export const rejectionPresets = ['rules', 'spam', 'privacy', 'offtopic', 'other'] as const
+export type RejectionPreset = typeof rejectionPresets[number]
+export interface RejectionDraft { preset: RejectionPreset | ''; note: string }
+export const emptyRejectionDraft = (): RejectionDraft => ({ preset: '', note: '' })
+
+/** Existing author-visible plain text; no model evidence or internal notes. */
+export function rejectionReason(t: (key: string) => string, draft: RejectionDraft): string {
+  if (!rejectionPresets.includes(draft.preset as RejectionPreset)) return ''
+  const note = draft.note.trim()
+  if (draft.preset === 'other') return note
+  const standard = t(`reviewRejection.reasons.${draft.preset}`)
+  return note ? `${standard}\n${note}` : standard
+}
+export function rejectionError(t: (key: string) => string, reason: string): string {
+  if (!reason.trim()) return t('reviewRejection.required')
+  return Array.from(reason).length > 512 ? t('reviewRejection.tooLong') : ''
+}

diff --git a/apps/gooseforum/resource/src/runtime/sticker-atomic.ts b/apps/gooseforum/resource/src/runtime/sticker-atomic.ts
new file mode 100644
index 000000000..6150c696d
--- /dev/null
+++ b/apps/gooseforum/resource/src/runtime/sticker-atomic.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,76 @@
+import { readCaretTextWindow } from '@/runtime/caret-text'
+import { STICKER_INLINE_CLASS, stickerInlineAt } from '@/runtime/sticker-inline-editor'
+import { stickerDeleteRangeAt, type StickerDeleteDirection } from '@/site/utils/sticker-token'
+
+/**
+ * 窗口取 200 字符：需要上界是因为块内可能是超长粘贴内容，逐键扫描整块没有意义；
+ * 200 远超最长 token（64 名字字符 + 前缀/闭合符），token 无论落在光标哪一侧都在窗口内。
+ */
+const CARET_WINDOW_LIMIT = 200
+
+/** keydown 是否应交给贴纸原子删除处理：IME 组合中与带 Ctrl/Meta/Alt 的组合键一律不干预。 */
+export function stickerDeleteDirection(event: KeyboardEvent): StickerDeleteDirection | null {
+  if (event.isComposing || event.ctrlKey || event.metaKey || event.altKey) return null
+  if (event.key === 'Backspace') return 'backward'
+  if (event.key === 'Delete') return 'forward'
+  return null
+}
+
+export function stickerBeforeInputDirection(event: InputEvent): StickerDeleteDirection | null {
+  if (event.isComposing) return null
+  if (event.inputType === 'deleteContentBackward') return 'backward'
+  if (event.inputType === 'deleteContentForward') return 'forward'
+  return null
+}
+
+/**
+ * 光标处删除整个贴纸 token/残缺片段（issue #1332）。
+ *
+ * token 在编辑器里是纯文本，逐字符删除会留下 `[:sticker:na:` 这类残缺原文；
+ * 命中时选中整段并走 document.execCommand('delete') 原生 contenteditable 路径：
+ * 触发 input 事件，Vditor 重新渲染并同步 modelValue/撤销栈（同 mention 插入的取舍）。
+ * 已显示为贴纸图的 token（sticker-inline-editor）在不可编辑块里，选区扩到整个块，
+ * 否则浏览器拒绝删除不可编辑节点内的文本。
+ * 返回 false 表示交回浏览器默认删除。
+ */
+export function deleteStickerAtCaret(element: HTMLElement, direction: StickerDeleteDirection): boolean {
+  const selection = window.getSelection()
+  if (!selection || selection.rangeCount === 0) return false
+  const caret = selection.getRangeAt(0)
+  if (!element.contains(caret.startContainer) || !element.contains(caret.endContainer)) return false
+  if (!caret.collapsed) {
+    const touched = [...element.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>(`.${STICKER_INLINE_CLASS}`)]
+      .filter((span) => caret.intersectsNode(span))
+    if (touched.length === 0) return false
+    const target = caret.cloneRange()
+    const firstRange = document.createRange()
+    firstRange.selectNode(touched[0])
+    if (caret.compareBoundaryPoints(Range.START_TO_START, firstRange) > 0) {
+      target.setStartBefore(touched[0])
+    }
+    const last = touched[touched.length - 1]
+    const lastRange = document.createRange()
+    lastRange.selectNode(last)
+    if (caret.compareBoundaryPoints(Range.END_TO_END, lastRange) < 0) {
+      target.setEndAfter(last)
+    }
+    selection.removeAllRanges()
+    selection.addRange(target)
+    return document.execCommand('delete')
+  }
+
+  const textWindow = readCaretTextWindow(caret.startContainer, caret.startOffset, CARET_WINDOW_LIMIT, element)
+  if (!textWindow) return false
+  const span = stickerDeleteRangeAt(textWindow.text, textWindow.caret, direction)
+  if (!span) return false
+  const target = textWindow.range(span.start, span.end)
+  if (!target) return false
+  const startInline = stickerInlineAt(target.startContainer)
+  const endInline = stickerInlineAt(target.endContainer)
+  if (startInline && element.contains(startInline)) target.setStartBefore(startInline)
+  if (endInline && element.contains(endInline)) target.setEndAfter(endInline)
+
+  selection.removeAllRanges()
+  selection.addRange(target)
+  return document.execCommand('delete')
+}

diff --git a/apps/gooseforum/resource/src/runtime/sticker-inline-editor.ts b/apps/gooseforum/resource/src/runtime/sticker-inline-editor.ts
new file mode 100644
index 000000000..3835af2a4
--- /dev/null
+++ b/apps/gooseforum/resource/src/runtime/sticker-inline-editor.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,131 @@
+/**
+ * 编辑器内贴纸所见即所得（MADR 0106 补充）：wysiwyg 编辑区里完整且可解析的
+ * `[:sticker:name:]` 文本包进不可编辑的内联块，显示与正文渲染同尺寸的贴纸图。
+ *
+ * 块内仍保留 token 原文：Lute 的 VditorDOM2Md 只读文本，getValue()/草稿/提交的
+ * Markdown 与未装饰时逐字一致；Vditor 每次输入按块重渲染（SpinVditorDOM）会把块
+ * 还原为纯文本，由宿主的 MutationObserver 在绘制前重新装饰。未知/停用 token 与
+ * 代码、链接、公式里的 token 保持原文，与服务端渲染规则一致。
+ */
+
+export const STICKER_INLINE_CLASS = 'gf-sticker-inline'
+
+const STICKER_TOKEN_RE = /\[:sticker:([^\s:[\]]{1,64}):]/g
+
+/** 服务端只在正文文本节点里展开 token：代码、链接目标/文字、原始 HTML、公式一律跳过。 */
+const SKIP_SELECTOR = [
+  'pre',
+  'code',
+  'a',
+  '.vditor-wysiwyg__block',
+  '.vditor-wysiwyg__preview',
+  '[data-type="html-inline"]',
+  '[data-type="html-entity"]',
+  '[data-type="math-inline"]',
+  '[data-type="backslash"]',
+  '[data-type="link-ref"]',
+  '[data-type="footnotes-ref"]',
+].join(', ')
+
+export interface StickerInlineAsset {
+  url: string
+  label: string
+}
+
+function cssUrl(url: string): string {
+  return `url(${JSON.stringify(url)})`
+}
+
+function wrapToken(text: Text, name: string, asset: StickerInlineAsset): HTMLSpanElement {
+  const span = document.createElement('span')
+  span.className = STICKER_INLINE_CLASS
+  span.contentEditable = 'false'
+  span.draggable = false
+  span.spellcheck = false
+  span.dataset.sticker = name
+  span.setAttribute('role', 'img')
+  span.setAttribute('aria-label', asset.label)
+  span.style.backgroundImage = cssUrl(asset.url)
+
+  // 光标落在 token 文本里（刚输入完闭合的 `]`）时移到图片之后：包裹会把活动 Range
+  // 退回到父节点里 token 原来的位置（图片之前）。
+  const selection = window.getSelection()
+  const range = selection && selection.rangeCount > 0 ? selection.getRangeAt(0) : null
+  const caretInside = Boolean(range?.collapsed && range.startContainer === text && range.startOffset > 0)
+
+  text.parentNode?.insertBefore(span, text)
+  span.appendChild(text)
+  if (caretInside && selection) {
+    const after = document.createRange()
+    after.setStartAfter(span)
+    after.collapse(true)
+    selection.removeAllRanges()
+    selection.addRange(after)
+  }
+  return span
+}
+
+/**
+ * 装饰 root 下所有可解析的完整 token，返回新包裹的个数。
+ * 已装饰但贴纸不再可解析（或图片地址变化）的块就地还原/更新。
+ */
+export function decorateStickerTokens(
+  root: HTMLElement,
+  assetFor: (name: string) => StickerInlineAsset | undefined,
+): number {
+  for (const span of root.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>(`.${STICKER_INLINE_CLASS}`)) {
+    const asset = assetFor(span.dataset.sticker ?? '')
+    if (asset) {
+      const background = cssUrl(asset.url)
+      if (span.style.backgroundImage !== background) span.style.backgroundImage = background
+      continue
+    }
+    span.replaceWith(...span.childNodes)
+  }
+
+  const candidates: Text[] = []
+  const walker = document.createTreeWalker(root, NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT)
+  for (let node = walker.nextNode(); node; node = walker.nextNode()) {
+    const text = node as Text
+    if (!text.data.includes('[:sticker:')) continue
+    const parent = text.parentElement
+    if (!parent || parent.closest(`.${STICKER_INLINE_CLASS}`)) continue
+    const skipped = parent.closest(SKIP_SELECTOR)
+    if (skipped && skipped !== root && root.contains(skipped)) continue
+    candidates.push(text)
+  }
+
+  let wrapped = 0
+  for (const candidate of candidates) {
+    let text: Text | null = candidate
+    while (text) {
+      STICKER_TOKEN_RE.lastIndex = 0
+      let match: RegExpExecArray | null = null
+      let asset: StickerInlineAsset | undefined
+      for (let next = STICKER_TOKEN_RE.exec(text.data); next; next = STICKER_TOKEN_RE.exec(text.data)) {
+        // 与服务端一致：奇数个反斜杠转义的 token 保持原文
+        let slashes = 0
+        for (let i = next.index - 1; i >= 0 && text.data[i] === '\\'; i--) slashes++
+        if (slashes % 2 !== 0) continue
+        asset = assetFor(next[1])
+        if (asset) {
+          match = next
+          break
+        }
+      }
+      if (!match || !asset) break
+      const token: Text = match.index > 0 ? text.splitText(match.index) : text
+      const rest: Text | null = token.data.length > match[0].length ? token.splitText(match[0].length) : null
+      wrapToken(token, match[1], asset)
+      wrapped++
+      text = rest
+    }
+  }
+  return wrapped
+}
+
+/** 光标/选区端点所在的贴纸内联块（端点在块内文本里或正好是块本身）。 */
+export function stickerInlineAt(node: Node): HTMLElement | null {
+  const element = node instanceof Element ? node : node.parentElement
+  return element?.closest<HTMLElement>(`.${STICKER_INLINE_CLASS}`) ?? null
+}

evidence.title: apps/gooseforum/resource/src/site/composables/useMyStickers.ts
evidence.detail:
diff --git a/apps/gooseforum/resource/src/site/composables/useMyStickers.ts b/apps/gooseforum/resource/src/site/composables/useMyStickers.ts
new file mode 100644
index 000000000..951caba62
--- /dev/null
+++ b/apps/gooseforum/resource/src/site/composables/useMyStickers.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,154 @@
+import { computed, ref } from 'vue'
+import type { StickerItem } from '@gooseforum/client'
+import {
+  ApiResponseError,
+  deleteMySticker,
+  getMyStickers,
+  orderMyStickers,
+  saveMyStickerEntry,
+  uploadImageFile,
+} from '@/runtime/api'
+import { rememberStickerUrls } from '@/site/composables/useResolvedStickers'
+
+/**
+ * The viewer's private sticker library ("My stickers"). Every picker and the
+ * settings page share one module-level copy, like useStickerLibrary. Writes wait
+ * for the server, so membership never looks changed before it is saved; a
+ * rejected reorder reloads the list because another device may have changed it.
+ */
+
+/** Server limit (stickerservice.MaxLibraryItems). */
+export const MAX_MY_STICKERS = 200
+
+const items = ref<StickerItem[]>([])
+const ready = ref(false)
+const loading = ref(false)
+const failed = ref(false)
+const signedOut = ref(false)
+const busy = ref(false)
+let request: Promise<void> | null = null
+
+/** Pending, rejected or withdrawn stickers stay listed but cannot be inserted. */
+export function isStickerUsable(item: StickerItem) {
+  return item.isEnabled !== false && (item.reviewStatus ?? 'approved') === 'approved'
+}
+
+function errorText(error: unknown, fallback: string) {
+  return error instanceof Error && error.message ? error.message : fallback
+}
+
+export function useMyStickers() {
+  const usable = computed(() => items.value.filter(isStickerUsable))
+  const names = computed(() => new Set(items.value.map((item) => item.name)))
+
+  function load(refresh = false): Promise<void> {
+    if (request) return request
+    if (ready.value && !refresh) return Promise.resolve()
+    loading.value = true
+    failed.value = false
+    request = getMyStickers()
+      .then((next) => {
+        items.value = next
+        ready.value = true
+        signedOut.value = false
+        rememberStickerUrls(next.filter(isStickerUsable))
+      })
+      .catch((error) => {
+        if (error instanceof ApiResponseError && error.messageCode === 'auth.required') {
+          signedOut.value = true
+          items.value = []
+        } else {
+          failed.value = true
+        }
+      })
+      .finally(() => {
+        loading.value = false
+        request = null
+      })
+    return request
+  }
+
+  async function write<T>(action: () => Promise<T>): Promise<T> {
+    if (busy.value) throw new Error('busy')
+    busy.value = true
+    try {
+      return await action()
+    } finally {
+      busy.value = false
+    }
+  }
+
+  function upsert(item: StickerItem) {
+    const index = items.value.findIndex((entry) => entry.name === item.name)
+    items.value = index < 0
+      ? [...items.value, item]
+      : items.value.map((entry, position) => (position === index ? item : entry))
+  }
+
+  /** Save a sticker someone shared; saving one already collected is a no-op. */
+  function collect(stickerName: string) {
+    return write(async () => {
+      const item = await saveMyStickerEntry({ stickerName })
+      if (ready.value) upsert(item)
+      return item
+    })
+  }
+
+  /** Upload one image as a personal sticker; it waits for review before use. */
+  function upload(file: File, displayName = '') {
+    return write(async () => {
+      const fileName = await uploadImageFile(file, file.name)
+      const item = await saveMyStickerEntry({ fileName, ...(displayName.trim() ? { displayName: displayName.trim() } : {}) })
+      upsert(item)
+      return item
+    })
+  }
+
+  /** The label is private to this account; an empty label shows the sticker's own name. */
+  function rename(item: StickerItem, displayName: string) {
+    return write(async () => {
+      upsert(await saveMyStickerEntry({ stickerName: item.name, displayName: displayName.trim() }))
+    })
+  }
+
+  function remove(item: StickerItem) {
+    return write(async () => {
+      await deleteMySticker(item.name)
+      items.value = items.value.filter((entry) => entry.name !== item.name)
+    })
+  }
+
+  /** Move one sticker to another position and save the complete order. */
+  function move(from: number, to: number) {
+    return write(async () => {
+      if (from === to || to < 0 || to >= items.value.length) return
+      const ordered = [...items.value]
+      ordered.splice(to, 0, ...ordered.splice(from, 1))
+      try {
+        await orderMyStickers(ordered.map((entry) => entry.name))
+        items.value = ordered
+      } catch (error) {
+        void load(true)
+        throw error
+      }
+    })
+  }
+
+  return {
+    items,
+    usable,
+    names,
+    ready,
+    loading,
+    failed,
+    signedOut,
+    busy,
+    load,
+    collect,
+    upload,
+    rename,
+    remove,
+    move,
+    errorText,
+  }
+}
