evidence.detail:
diff --git a/apps/gooseforum/resource/src/site/composables/useStickerMarket.ts b/apps/gooseforum/resource/src/site/composables/useStickerMarket.ts
new file mode 100644
index 000000000..30b6e5243
--- /dev/null
+++ b/apps/gooseforum/resource/src/site/composables/useStickerMarket.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,178 @@
+import { ref } from 'vue'
+import type { StickerItem, StickerMarketPack, StickerMarketTopic } from '@gooseforum/client'
+import {
+  deleteMyStickerPack,
+  getMyStickerPacks,
+  getStickerMarket,
+  getStickerMarketPack,
+  saveMyStickerPack,
+} from '@/runtime/api'
+
+/**
+ * Sticker market state for the editor picker (issue #1429). Like useStickerLibrary,
+ * the cache is module-level: every editor on the page shares one copy of the
+ * subscribed packs and of each pack's stickers, and concurrent requests for the
+ * same pack share one promise. Subscriptions update optimistically and roll back
+ * when the server rejects them.
+ */
+
+const MARKET_PAGE_SIZE = 24
+
+const myPacks = ref<StickerMarketPack[]>([])
+const myPacksReady = ref(false)
+let myPacksRequest: Promise<void> | null = null
+let membershipRevision = 0
+
+async function refreshMyPacks() {
+  const revision = ++membershipRevision
+  try {
+    const packs = await getMyStickerPacks()
+    if (revision !== membershipRevision) return
+    myPacks.value = packs
+    myPacksReady.value = true
+  } catch {
+    // A successful write remains optimistically visible if its confirmation read fails.
+  }
+}
+
+const packStickers = new Map<number, StickerItem[]>()
+const packRequests = new Map<number, Promise<StickerItem[]>>()
+
+const topics = ref<StickerMarketTopic[]>([])
+const marketPacks = ref<StickerMarketPack[]>([])
+const marketTopic = ref('')
+const marketTotal = ref(0)
+let marketPage = 0
+let marketRequest: Promise<void> | null = null
+let failedMarketRequest: { topic: string, page: number, more: boolean } | null = null
+
+export function useStickerMarket() {
+  const marketLoading = ref(false)
+  const marketFailed = ref(false)
+  const actionError = ref('')
+
+  /** Load subscriptions once; signed-out viewers simply see no packs. */
+  function ensureMyPacks(): Promise<void> {
+    if (myPacksReady.value) return Promise.resolve()
+    if (myPacksRequest) return myPacksRequest
+    const revision = membershipRevision
+    let invalidated = false
+    myPacksRequest = getMyStickerPacks()
+      .then((packs) => {
+        if (revision !== membershipRevision) { invalidated = true; return }
+        myPacks.value = packs
+        myPacksReady.value = true
+      })
+      .catch(() => undefined)
+      .finally(() => {
+        myPacksRequest = null
+        if (invalidated) return ensureMyPacks()
+      })
+    return myPacksRequest
+  }
+
+  function loadPackStickers(id: number): Promise<StickerItem[]> {
+    const cached = packStickers.get(id)
+    if (cached) return Promise.resolve(cached)
+    let request = packRequests.get(id)
+    if (!request) {
+      request = getStickerMarketPack(id)
+        .then((detail) => {
+          packStickers.set(id, detail.stickers)
+          return detail.stickers
+        })
+        .finally(() => packRequests.delete(id))
+      packRequests.set(id, request)
+    }
+    return request
+  }
+
+  async function loadMarket(topic = marketTopic.value, more = false) {
+    if (marketRequest) return marketRequest
+    const retry = failedMarketRequest?.topic === topic ? failedMarketRequest : null
+    if (!retry && !more && topic === marketTopic.value && marketPage > 0) return
+    const page = retry?.page ?? (more ? marketPage + 1 : 1)
+    more = retry?.more ?? more
+    marketLoading.value = true
+    marketFailed.value = false
+    marketRequest = getStickerMarket({ topic, page, pageSize: MARKET_PAGE_SIZE })
+      .then((result) => {
+        topics.value = result.topics
+        marketPacks.value = more ? [...marketPacks.value, ...result.packs] : result.packs
+        marketTotal.value = result.total
+        marketTopic.value = topic
+        marketPage = page
+        failedMarketRequest = null
+      })
+      .catch(() => {
+        failedMarketRequest = { topic, page, more }
+        marketFailed.value = true
+      })
+      .finally(() => {
+        marketLoading.value = false
+        marketRequest = null
+      })
+    return marketRequest
+  }
+
+  function isSubscribed(id: number) {
+    return myPacks.value.some((pack) => pack.id === id)
+  }
+
+  async function subscribe(pack: StickerMarketPack) {
+    if (isSubscribed(pack.id)) return true
+    membershipRevision++
+    const previous = myPacks.value
+    myPacks.value = [...previous, pack]
+    actionError.value = ''
+    try {
+      await saveMyStickerPack(pack.id)
+      await refreshMyPacks()
+      return true
+    } catch (err) {
+      membershipRevision++
+      myPacks.value = myPacks.value.filter((item) => item.id !== pack.id)
+      actionError.value = err instanceof Error ? err.message : ''
+      return false
+    }
+  }
+
+  async function unsubscribe(pack: StickerMarketPack) {
+    membershipRevision++
+    const previous = myPacks.value
+    myPacks.value = previous.filter((item) => item.id !== pack.id)
+    actionError.value = ''
+    try {
+      await deleteMyStickerPack(pack.id)
+      await refreshMyPacks()
+      return true
+    } catch (err) {
+      membershipRevision++
+      if (previous.some((item) => item.id === pack.id) && !isSubscribed(pack.id)) {
+        const restored = [...myPacks.value]
+        restored.splice(Math.min(previous.findIndex((item) => item.id === pack.id), restored.length), 0, pack)
+        myPacks.value = restored
+      }
+      actionError.value = err instanceof Error ? err.message : ''
+      return false
+    }
+  }
+
+  return {
+    myPacks,
+    myPacksReady,
+    ensureMyPacks,
+    loadPackStickers,
+    topics,
+    marketPacks,
+    marketTopic,
+    marketTotal,
+    marketLoading,
+    marketFailed,
+    loadMarket,
+    isSubscribed,
+    subscribe,
+    unsubscribe,
+    actionError,
+  }
+}

@@ -0,0 +1,172 @@
+/**
+ * 编辑器内手动输入 `[:sticker:` 时的贴纸候选会话（MADR 0106 补充）。
+ *
+ * 光标前识别到未闭合片段即打开候选，按名字/显示名筛选「我的 → 官方 → 已添加的表情包」；
+ * 选中后用完整 token 整段替换片段，编辑器随即把它显示为贴纸图。片段补齐为完整
+ * token 时会话自然关闭（闭合的 token 不再是片段）。DOM 采集与替换由宿主编辑器桥接。
+ */
+import { computed, ref, watch, type CSSProperties } from 'vue'
+import type { StickerItem } from '@gooseforum/client'
+import { isStickerUsable, useMyStickers } from '@/site/composables/useMyStickers'
+import { rememberStickerUrls } from '@/site/composables/useResolvedStickers'
+import { useStickerLibrary } from '@/site/composables/useStickerLibrary'
+import { useStickerMarket } from '@/site/composables/useStickerMarket'
+import {
+  extractStickerQuery,
+  rankStickerSuggestions,
+  type StickerSuggestion,
+} from '@/site/utils/sticker-token'
+
+export const STICKER_SUGGEST_LISTBOX_ID = 'gf-sticker-suggest-listbox'
+export const STICKER_SUGGEST_OPTION_ID_PREFIX = 'gf-sticker-suggest-option-'
+
+const PANEL_WIDTH = 288
+const ROW_HEIGHT = 44
+const MAX_VISIBLE_ROWS = 6
+const GAP = 6
+const VIEWPORT_MARGIN = 8
+
+export interface StickerSuggestBridge {
+  getMentionContext(): { prefix: string, rect: DOMRect | null, inCode: boolean, element: HTMLElement | null } | null
+  /** 以光标为终点向前删除 length 个字符并插入 token（不补空格） */
+  replaceStickerQuery(length: number, token: string): boolean
+}
+
+export function useStickerSuggest(options: {
+  bridge: () => StickerSuggestBridge | null
+  label: (item: StickerItem) => string
+}) {
+  const library = useStickerLibrary()
+  const mine = useMyStickers()
+  const market = useStickerMarket()
+  const packItems = ref<StickerItem[]>([])
+
+  const open = ref(false)
+  const query = ref('')
+  const queryLength = ref(0)
+  const activeIndex = ref(0)
+  const rect = ref<DOMRect | null>(null)
+  const editorElement = ref<HTMLElement | null>(null)
+  /** Escape 关闭后，同一片段不再自动重开；片段一变（继续输入/删除）即恢复 */
+  let dismissedPrefix: string | null = null
+  let sourcesRequested = false
+
+  const sources = computed<StickerSuggestion[]>(() => {
+    const items = [...mine.usable.value, ...library.stickers.value, ...packItems.value.filter(isStickerUsable)]
+    return items.map((item) => ({ name: item.name, url: item.url, label: options.label(item) }))
+  })
+  const candidates = computed(() => (open.value ? rankStickerSuggestions(sources.value, query.value) : []))
+  const loading = computed(() => library.loading.value || (mine.loading.value && !mine.ready.value))
+
+  function requestSources() {
+    if (sourcesRequested) return
+    sourcesRequested = true
+    void library.ensureStickers()
+    void mine.load()
+    void market.ensureMyPacks().then(async () => {
+      const lists = await Promise.allSettled(market.myPacks.value.map((pack) => market.loadPackStickers(pack.id)))
+      packItems.value = lists.flatMap((list) => (list.status === 'fulfilled' ? list.value : []))
+    })
+  }
+
+  function refresh() {
+    const ctx = options.bridge()?.getMentionContext()
+    const token = ctx && !ctx.inCode ? extractStickerQuery(ctx.prefix) : null
+    if (!ctx || !token) {
+      dismissedPrefix = null
+      close()
+      return
+    }
+    if (dismissedPrefix === ctx.prefix) return
+    dismissedPrefix = null
+    requestSources()
+    if (!open.value || query.value !== token.query) activeIndex.value = 0
+    open.value = true
+    query.value = token.query
+    queryLength.value = token.length
+    rect.value = ctx.rect
+    editorElement.value = ctx.element
+  }
+
+  function close() {
+    open.value = false
+    query.value = ''
+    queryLength.value = 0
+    activeIndex.value = 0
+    rect.value = null
+  }
+
+  function dismiss() {
+    dismissedPrefix = options.bridge()?.getMentionContext()?.prefix ?? null
+    close()
+  }
+
+  function select(item: StickerSuggestion) {
+    if (!open.value) return
+    const length = queryLength.value
+    close()
+    rememberStickerUrls([item])
+    options.bridge()?.replaceStickerQuery(length, `[:sticker:${item.name}:]`)
+  }
+
+  /** 会话打开时接管上下/回车/Tab/Esc；返回 true 表示已处理（宿主阻止默认行为与冒泡） */
+  function handleKeydown(event: KeyboardEvent): boolean {
+    if (!open.value || event.isComposing) return false
+    const count = candidates.value.length
+    switch (event.key) {
+      case 'ArrowDown':
+      case 'ArrowUp':
+        if (!count) return false
+        activeIndex.value = (activeIndex.value + (event.key === 'ArrowDown' ? 1 : -1) + count) % count
+        return true
+      case 'Enter':
+      case 'Tab':
+        if (!count || event.shiftKey) return false
+        select(candidates.value[activeIndex.value])
+        return true
+      case 'Escape':
+        dismiss()
+        return true
+      default:
+        return false
+    }
+  }
+
+  /** 贴近光标的浮层：默认在光标下方，空间不足时翻到上方，水平方向不越出视口 */
+  const panelStyle = computed<CSSProperties>(() => {
+    const caret = rect.value
+    if (!caret || typeof window === 'undefined') return { visibility: 'hidden' }
+    const width = Math.min(PANEL_WIDTH, window.innerWidth - VIEWPORT_MARGIN * 2)
+    const rows = Math.min(Math.max(candidates.value.length, 1), MAX_VISIBLE_ROWS)
+    const height = rows * ROW_HEIGHT + 8
+    const left = Math.min(Math.max(caret.left, VIEWPORT_MARGIN), window.innerWidth - width - VIEWPORT_MARGIN)
+    const below = window.innerHeight - caret.bottom
+    const top = below < height + GAP && caret.top > height + GAP
+      ? caret.top - height - GAP
+      : caret.bottom + GAP
+    return { left: `${left}px`, top: `${top}px`, width: `${width}px` }
+  })
+
+  // 编辑元素即 combobox 触发器（与 mention 会话同一 a11y 约定）
+  watch([open, activeIndex, candidates, editorElement], ([isOpen], [, , , previous]) => {
+    const element = editorElement.value
+    if (previous && previous !== element) clearAria(previous)
+    if (!element) return
+    if (!isOpen) {
+      clearAria(element)
+      return
+    }
+    element.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true')
+    element.setAttribute('aria-controls', STICKER_SUGGEST_LISTBOX_ID)
+    const candidate = candidates.value[activeIndex.value]
+    if (candidate) element.setAttribute('aria-activedescendant', `${STICKER_SUGGEST_OPTION_ID_PREFIX}${activeIndex.value}`)
+    else element.removeAttribute('aria-activedescendant')
+  })
+
+  function clearAria(element: HTMLElement) {
+    if (element.getAttribute('aria-controls') !== STICKER_SUGGEST_LISTBOX_ID) return
+    for (const name of ['aria-expanded', 'aria-controls', 'aria-activedescendant']) element.removeAttribute(name)
+  }
+
+  return { open, query, candidates, activeIndex, loading, panelStyle, refresh, close, select, handleKeydown }
+}

+import { ref, watch, type Ref } from 'vue'
+
+/** Keep recovery attached to the current displayed failure, never a previous one. */
+export function useWriteRecovery(message: Ref<string>) {
+  const code = ref<string>()
+  watch(message, () => { code.value = undefined }, { flush: 'sync' })
+  function capture(error: unknown) {
+    code.value = typeof error === 'object' && error !== null && 'messageCode' in error && typeof error.messageCode === 'string' ? error.messageCode : undefined
+  }
+  return { code, capture }
+}

diff --git a/apps/gooseforum/resource/src/site/utils/sticker-preview-placement.ts b/apps/gooseforum/resource/src/site/utils/sticker-preview-placement.ts
new file mode 100644
index 000000000..8b839895f
--- /dev/null
+++ b/apps/gooseforum/resource/src/site/utils/sticker-preview-placement.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,58 @@
+/**
+ * 贴纸放大预览的落点：预览挂在 body 上（不受面板/编辑器容器裁切），
+ * 只放在面板外侧，绝不盖住网格和正在指向的那格。优先面板的行尾侧、
+ * 再行首侧（随书写方向镜像），横向放不下（窄屏）时放到面板上方或下方，
+ * 都放不下才退到指向格正上方。坐标是视口物理坐标，最终夹在视口内。
+ */
+
+export interface PlacementBox {
+  left: number
+  top: number
+  right: number
+  bottom: number
+}
+
+export interface PreviewPlacement {
+  left: number
+  top: number
+  /** 缩放进场的原点：落在朝向指向格的那条边上 */
+  origin: string
+  side: 'end' | 'start' | 'above' | 'below' | 'cell'
+}
+
+const GAP = 8
+const MARGIN = 8
+
+export function placeStickerPreview(
+  cell: PlacementBox,
+  panel: PlacementBox,
+  size: { width: number, height: number },
+  viewport: { width: number, height: number },
+  rtl = false,
+): PreviewPlacement {
+  const { width, height } = size
+  const clamp = (value: number, max: number) => Math.min(Math.max(value, MARGIN), Math.max(MARGIN, max - MARGIN))
+  const cellX = (cell.left + cell.right) / 2
+  const cellY = (cell.top + cell.bottom) / 2
+  const sideTop = clamp(cellY - height / 2, viewport.height - height)
+  const stackLeft = clamp(cellX - width / 2, viewport.width - width)
+  const originY = `${Math.round(cellY - sideTop)}px`
+  const originX = `${Math.round(cellX - stackLeft)}px`
+
+  const toRight = { left: panel.right + GAP, top: sideTop, origin: `0 ${originY}` }
+  const toLeft = { left: panel.left - GAP - width, top: sideTop, origin: `${width}px ${originY}` }
+  const fitsRight = toRight.left + width <= viewport.width - MARGIN
+  const fitsLeft = toLeft.left >= MARGIN
+  const [end, endFits, start, startFits] = rtl
+    ? [toLeft, fitsLeft, toRight, fitsRight]
+    : [toRight, fitsRight, toLeft, fitsLeft]
+  if (endFits) return { ...end, side: 'end' }
+  if (startFits) return { ...start, side: 'start' }
+
+  const aboveTop = panel.top - GAP - height
+  if (aboveTop >= MARGIN) return { left: stackLeft, top: aboveTop, origin: `${originX} ${height}px`, side: 'above' }
+  const belowTop = panel.bottom + GAP
+  if (belowTop + height <= viewport.height - MARGIN) return { left: stackLeft, top: belowTop, origin: `${originX} 0`, side: 'below' }
+
+  return { left: stackLeft, top: clamp(cell.top - GAP - height, viewport.height - height), origin: `${originX} ${height}px`, side: 'cell' }
+}

+/** 纯文本场景（title/aria-label 等属性）用的 token 剥离。 */
+export function stripStickerTokens(content: string): string {
+  return content.replace(STICKER_TOKEN_RE, '')
+}
+
+/**
+ * 列表/卡片预览的渲染段：未知或停用 token 直接丢弃，不暴露原文
+ * （issue #1304）。文本段剔除残留 token，无内容的段不保留。
+ */
+export function renderableStickerSegments(content: string, urlByName: Map<string, string>): MessageSegment[] {
+  const segments: MessageSegment[] = []
+  for (const segment of parseStickerSegments(content, urlByName)) {
+    if (segment.type === 'sticker') {
+      segments.push(segment)
+      continue
+    }
+    const text = stripStickerTokens(segment.text)
+    if (text) segments.push({ type: 'text', text })
+  }
+  return segments
+}
+
+/**
+ * 小字视图（列表行、置顶条）的纯文本贴纸文案：可解析的贴纸显示 [名字]，
+ * 未知/停用/个人贴纸省略。卡片与预览仍用 renderableStickerSegments 渲染图片。
+ */
+export function stickerLabelText(content: string, urlByName: Map<string, string>): string {
+  const parts = renderableStickerSegments(content, urlByName).map((segment) =>
+    segment.type === 'sticker' ? `[${segment.name}]` : segment.text,
+  )
+  return parts.join('').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim()
+}
+
+/** 预览是否还有可见内容：全部 token 都未解析时不应留下空行。 */
+export function hasRenderableStickerText(content: string, urlByName: Map<string, string>): boolean {
+  return renderableStickerSegments(content, urlByName)
+    .some((segment) => segment.type === 'sticker' || segment.text.trim() !== '')
+}
+
 /**
  * 会话列表预览用的可读标签：不暴露随机 token 名；未知/停用 token
  * 同样显示统一文案（预览层不做启停区分）。
  */
 export function stickerPreviewLabel(content: string, stickerLabel?: string): string {
   return content.replace(STICKER_TOKEN_RE, (_, name: string) => `[${stickerLabel ?? name}]`)
 }
 
+/** 贴纸 token 在纯文本内容里的区间（[start, end)）。 */
+type StickerDeleteRange = { start: number; end: number }
+
+export type StickerDeleteDirection = 'backward' | 'forward'
+
+const STICKER_TOKEN_PREFIX = '[:sticker:'
+const STICKER_NAME_MAX = 64
+
+function isStickerNameChar(char: string | undefined): boolean {
+  return char !== undefined && !/[\s:[\]]/.test(char)
+}
+
+/**
+ * content 中所有贴纸 token 与未闭合片段的区间。片段 = `[:sticker:` + 最多 64 个
+ * 名字字符且不以 `:]` 收尾（粘贴/撤销/逐字输入留下的 `[:sticker:na`）。
+ * 前缀后紧跟空白/`:`/`[`/`]` 说明没有名字在输入中，不算片段。
+ */
+function stickerAtomSpans(content: string): StickerDeleteRange[] {
+  const spans: StickerDeleteRange[] = []
+  for (
+    let start = content.indexOf(STICKER_TOKEN_PREFIX);
+    start !== -1;
+    start = content.indexOf(STICKER_TOKEN_PREFIX, start + 1)
+  ) {
+    const nameStart = start + STICKER_TOKEN_PREFIX.length
+    let end = nameStart
+    while (end - nameStart < STICKER_NAME_MAX && isStickerNameChar(content[end])) end++
+    // 名字超过 64 字符：不是合法 token 也不是片段，交回默认删除
+    if (isStickerNameChar(content[end])) continue
+    const hasName = end > nameStart
+    if (hasName && content.startsWith(':]', end)) {
+      spans.push({ start, end: end + 2 })
+      continue
+    }
+    // 名字后紧跟未闭合的 `:` 也算片段的一部分，否则 `[:sticker:huaji:` 会残留 `[:sticker:huaji`
+    if (hasName && content[end] === ':') {
+      spans.push({ start, end: end + 1 })
+      continue
+    }
+    if (hasName || end === content.length) spans.push({ start, end })
+  }
+  return spans
+}
+
+/**
+ * caret 处应整体删除的贴纸区间（issue #1332）：token 在编辑器里是纯文本，
+ * 逐字符删除会留下 `[:sticker:na:` 这类残缺原文。caret 紧贴 token
+ * （backward 紧跟 token 之后、forward 正好在 token 起点）或落在 token 内部时，
+ * token/片段作为一个原子块整体删除。其余情况返回 null，交回默认删除行为。
+ */
+export function stickerDeleteRangeAt(
+  content: string,
+  caret: number,
+  direction: StickerDeleteDirection,
+): StickerDeleteRange | null {
+  for (const span of stickerAtomSpans(content)) {
+    const hit = direction === 'backward'
+      ? caret > span.start && caret <= span.end
+      : caret >= span.start && caret < span.end
+    if (hit) return span
+  }
+  return null
+}
+
 // 个人上传表情名为 u_ + 48 位小写十六进制（服务端生成规则），可被精确识别。
-const PERSONAL_STICKER_TOKEN_RE = /\[:sticker:u_[0-9a-f]{48}:\]/g
+const PERSONAL_STICKER_NAME_RE = /^u_[0-9a-f]{48}$/
+// 市场表情名为 m_ + 40 位小写十六进制（issue #1429）；单张被停用后同样无法解析。
+const GENERATED_STICKER_TOKEN_RE = /\[:sticker:(?:u_[0-9a-f]{48}|m_[0-9a-f]{40}):\]/g
+
+/** 贴纸名（不含 [:sticker:…:] 包裹）是否为服务端生成的个人贴纸名。 */
+export function isPersonalStickerName(name: string): boolean {
+  return PERSONAL_STICKER_NAME_RE.test(name)
+}
 
 /**
- * 消息正文渲染用的个人表情遮蔽：待审/被拒的个人 token 无法解析，
- * 保持原文会把随机名展示给收件人（issue #1071），统一替换为本地化占位。
- * 官方与可解析 token 不受影响。
+ * 消息正文渲染用的生成名表情遮蔽：待审/被拒的个人 token 与已停用的市场
+ * token 无法解析，保持原文会把随机名展示给收件人（issue #1071），统一替换为
+ * 本地化占位。官方与可解析 token 不受影响。
  */
 export function maskPersonalStickerTokens(content: string, stickerLabel: string): string {
-  return content.replace(PERSONAL_STICKER_TOKEN_RE, `[${stickerLabel}]`)
+  return content.replace(GENERATED_STICKER_TOKEN_RE, `[${stickerLabel}]`)
+}
+
+/** 光标前正在手动输入的贴纸 token：`[:sticker:` + 至多 64 个名字字符，尚未闭合。 */
+export interface StickerQuery {
+  /** 片段长度（含 `[:sticker:` 前缀），选中候选时整段替换 */
+  length: number
+  query: string
+}
+
+const STICKER_QUERY_RE = /\[:sticker:([^\s:[\]]{0,64})$/
+
+/** 从光标前文本识别手动输入中的 token 片段；被奇数个反斜杠转义时不算。 */
+export function extractStickerQuery(prefix: string): StickerQuery | null {
+  const match = STICKER_QUERY_RE.exec(prefix)
+  if (!match) return null
+  let slashes = 0
+  for (let i = match.index - 1; i >= 0 && prefix[i] === '\\'; i--) slashes++
+  if (slashes % 2 !== 0) return null
+  return { length: match[0].length, query: match[1] }
+}
+
+export interface StickerSuggestion {
+  name: string
+  url: string
+  label: string
+}
+
+/**
+ * 候选排序：名字/显示名前缀命中优先，其次包含；同级保持来源顺序（我的 → 官方 → 已添加的表情包）。
+ * 空查询按来源顺序取前 limit 个。名字去重，先出现的来源优先。
+ */
+export function rankStickerSuggestions(
+  items: readonly StickerSuggestion[],
+  query: string,
+  limit = 8,
+): StickerSuggestion[] {
+  const q = query.toLowerCase()
+  const seen = new Set<string>()
+  const scored: Array<{ item: StickerSuggestion, score: number, index: number }> = []
+  items.forEach((item, index) => {
+    if (seen.has(item.name)) return
+    seen.add(item.name)
+    if (!q) {
+      scored.push({ item, score: 0, index })
+      return
+    }
+    const name = item.name.toLowerCase()
+    const label = item.label.toLowerCase()
+    const score = name === q ? 4
+      : name.startsWith(q) || label.startsWith(q) ? 3
+        : name.includes(q) || label.includes(q) ? 2
+          : 0
+    if (score > 0) scored.push({ item, score, index })
+  })
+  return scored
+    .sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score || a.index - b.index)
+    .slice(0, limit)
+    .map((entry) => entry.item)
 }

+import assert from 'node:assert/strict'

+let browser, server, origin, fixtures
+before(async () => {
+ fixtures = await mkdtemp(join(tmpdir(), 'yourtj-activation-continuation-'))
+ execFileSync('go', ['test', './app/http/controllers', '-run', 'TestActivationContinuationBrowserFixtures', '-count=1'], { cwd:fileURLToPath(new URL('../../', import.meta.url)), env:{...process.env,YOURTJ_TEST_HTML_DIR:fixtures}, stdio:'pipe' })

@@ -0,0 +1,61 @@
+// @vitest-environment happy-dom
+import { describe, it, expect, vi, afterEach } from 'vitest'
+import { mount, flushPromises } from '@vue/test-utils'
+import { i18n } from '../src/runtime/i18n'
+import ActivationEmailAction from '../src/site/components/ActivationEmailAction.vue'
+import { getActivationStatus, resendActivationEmail } from '../src/runtime/api'
+vi.mock('../src/runtime/api', () => ({ getActivationStatus: vi.fn(), resendActivationEmail: vi.fn() }))
+const ready = { currentEmail: 'old@example.test', pendingEmail: 'new@example.test', targetEmail: 'new@example.test', targetKind: 'pending', state: 'ready', remainingToday: 3, dailyLimit: 3, retryAfterSeconds: 0 } as const
+const mounted: ReturnType<typeof mount>[] = []
+function render() { const wrapper = mount(ActivationEmailAction, { props: { accountId: 7 }, global: { plugins: [i18n] } }); mounted.push(wrapper); return wrapper }
+afterEach(() => { mounted.splice(0).forEach(w => w.unmount()); vi.clearAllMocks(); vi.restoreAllMocks(); vi.useRealTimers() })
+describe('authoritative activation status', () => {
+  it('shows actual staged target, refreshes after sending and blocks cooldown', async () => {
+    vi.mocked(getActivationStatus).mockResolvedValueOnce(ready).mockResolvedValueOnce({ ...ready, state: 'cooldown', remainingToday: 2, retryAfterSeconds: 60 })
+    vi.mocked(resendActivationEmail).mockResolvedValue('任务已受理')
+    const w = render(); await flushPromises()
+    expect(w.text()).toContain('new@example.test'); expect(w.text()).toContain('3 / 3')
+    await w.findAll('button')[0]!.trigger('click'); await flushPromises()
+    expect(resendActivationEmail).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1); expect(getActivationStatus).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2)
+    expect(w.text()).toContain('2 / 3'); expect(w.findAll('button')[0]!.attributes('disabled')).toBeDefined()
+  })
+  for (const state of ['verified', 'disabled', 'frozen', 'daily_limit', 'mail_unavailable', 'missing_email'] as const) {
+    it(`blocks sending for ${state}`, async () => {
+      vi.mocked(getActivationStatus).mockResolvedValue({ ...ready, state })
+      const w = render(); await flushPromises()
+      expect(w.findAll('button')[0]!.attributes('disabled')).toBeDefined()
+      expect(resendActivationEmail).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
+    })
+  }
+  it('uses elapsed time, rechecks expiry and never automatically sends', async () => {
+    vi.useFakeTimers({ toFake: ['setInterval', 'clearInterval'] })
+    let elapsed = 100
+    vi.spyOn(performance, 'now').mockImplementation(() => elapsed)
+    vi.mocked(getActivationStatus).mockResolvedValueOnce({ ...ready, state: 'cooldown', retryAfterSeconds: 2 }).mockResolvedValueOnce(ready)
+    const w = render(); await flushPromises()
+    vi.spyOn(Date, 'now').mockReturnValue(9999999999999)
+    await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(1000); await flushPromises()
+    expect(getActivationStatus).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1)
+    expect(w.findAll('button')[0]!.attributes('disabled')).toBeDefined()
+    elapsed += 2001
+    await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(1000); await flushPromises()
+    expect(getActivationStatus).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2)
+    expect(w.findAll('button')[0]!.attributes('disabled')).toBeUndefined()
+    expect(resendActivationEmail).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
+  })
+  it('does not accept an old account response', async () => {
+    let finish!: (value: typeof ready) => void
+    vi.mocked(getActivationStatus).mockReturnValueOnce(new Promise(resolve => { finish = resolve })).mockResolvedValueOnce({ ...ready, targetEmail: 'next@example.test' })
+    const w = render(); await w.setProps({ accountId: 8 }); await flushPromises()
+    finish(ready); await flushPromises()
+    expect(w.text()).toContain('next@example.test'); expect(w.text()).not.toContain('new@example.test')
+  })
+  it('fails closed and allows a read-only retry', async () => {
+    vi.mocked(getActivationStatus).mockRejectedValueOnce(new Error('暂不可用')).mockResolvedValueOnce(ready)
+    const w = render(); await flushPromises()
+    expect(w.findAll('button')[0]!.attributes('disabled')).toBeDefined()
+    await w.findAll('button')[1]!.trigger('click'); await flushPromises()
+    expect(w.findAll('button')[0]!.attributes('disabled')).toBeUndefined()
+    expect(resendActivationEmail).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
+  })
+})

+import assert from 'node:assert/strict'
+import { after, before, test } from 'node:test'
+import { mkdir, readFile } from 'node:fs/promises'
+import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url'
+import { chromium } from 'playwright'
+import { createServer } from 'vite'
+let server, browser, origin
+const defaults = JSON.parse(await readFile(new URL('../../app/models/defaultconfig/pageconfig/ratelimit.json', import.meta.url), 'utf8'))
+before(async () => {
+  server = await createServer({ root: fileURLToPath(new URL('../', import.meta.url)), server: { host: '127.0.0.1', port: 0, open: false } })
+  await server.listen()
+  origin = `http://127.0.0.1:${server.httpServer.address().port}`
+  browser = await chromium.launch()
+})
+after(async () => { await browser?.close(); await server?.close() })
+for (const lang of ['zh', 'en', 'ja', 'de']) for (const width of [320, 1280]) {
+ test(`admin stats exception and configurable budget: ${lang} ${width}`, async () => {
+  const page = await browser.newPage({ viewport: { width, height: 900 } })
+  let saved
+  try {
+    await page.route('**/api/admin/rate-limit-settings', route => route.fulfill({ json: { code: 0, result: defaults } }))
+    await page.route('**/api/admin/save-rate-limit-settings', async route => {
+      saved = route.request().postDataJSON()
+      await route.fulfill({ json: { code: 0, result: true } })
+    })
+    await page.goto(`${origin}/assets/test/fixtures/browser/admin-stats-limit.html?lang=${lang}&dark=${width === 320}`)
+    await page.getByText('admin.stats', { exact: true }).waitFor()
+    assert.equal(await page.evaluate(() => getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).colorScheme), width === 320 ? 'dark' : 'light')
+    const hintText = await page.locator('#app').getAttribute('data-limit-hint')
+    const hint = page.getByText(hintText, { exact: true })
+    await hint.waitFor()
+    assert.ok(!hintText.startsWith('statsAdmin.'))
+    const box = await hint.boundingBox()
+    assert.ok(box.width > 100 && box.height > 10 && box.x >= 0 && box.x + box.width <= width)
+    assert.equal(await page.getByRole('switch').nth(1).getAttribute('aria-checked'), 'true')
+    const rule = page.getByText('admin.stats', { exact: true }).locator('..')
+    assert.equal(await rule.getByRole('spinbutton').nth(2).inputValue(), '60')
+    if (process.env.YOURTJ_REVIEW_SCREENSHOTS) {
+      await mkdir(process.env.YOURTJ_REVIEW_SCREENSHOTS, { recursive: true })
+      await hint.locator('..').screenshot({ path: `${process.env.YOURTJ_REVIEW_SCREENSHOTS}/stats-exemption-${lang}-${width}.png` })
+    }
+    await rule.getByRole('spinbutton').nth(2).fill('30')
+    const label = await page.locator('#app').getAttribute('data-save-label')
+    await Promise.all([page.waitForResponse('**/api/admin/save-rate-limit-settings'), page.getByRole('button', { name: label, exact: true }).click()])
+    assert.equal(saved.settings.skipAdmin, true)
+    assert.deepEqual(saved.settings.actions.find(x => x.action === 'admin.stats'), { action: 'admin.stats', windowSeconds: 60, limitPerIp: 0, limitPerUser: 30 })
+  } finally { await page.close() }
+ })
+}

+// @vitest-environment happy-dom
+import { afterEach, describe, expect, test, vi } from 'vitest'
+import { DOMWrapper, flushPromises, mount, type VueWrapper } from '@vue/test-utils'
+import StickerMarketManagementPage from '../src/admin/pages/management/StickerMarketManagementPage.vue'
+import {
+  createStickerMarketPack,
+  getStickerMarket,
+  getStickerMarketPack,
+  importStickerMarketPack,
+  saveStickerMarketItem,
+  saveStickerMarketPack,
+  syncStickerMarket,
+  uploadStickerMarketFile,
+} from '../src/admin/runtime/api'
+import { adminToast } from '../src/admin/runtime/toast'
+import type { AdminPayload, AdminStickerMarketPack, AdminStickerMarketPage } from '../src/admin/types'
+
+vi.mock('../src/admin/runtime/api', () => ({
+  createStickerMarketPack: vi.fn(),
+  getStickerMarket: vi.fn(),
+  getStickerMarketPack: vi.fn(),
+  importStickerMarketPack: vi.fn(),
+  saveStickerMarketItem: vi.fn(),
+  saveStickerMarketPack: vi.fn(),
+  syncStickerMarket: vi.fn(),
+  uploadStickerMarketFile: vi.fn(),
+}))
+vi.mock('../src/admin/runtime/toast', () => ({
+  adminToast: { success: vi.fn(), error: vi.fn(), info: vi.fn(), warning: vi.fn() },
+}))
+vi.mock('../src/admin/runtime/i18n-text', () => ({
+  adminText: (key: string, params?: Record<string, unknown>) => key + (params ? JSON.stringify(params) : ''),
+}))
+
+const pack = (overrides: Partial<AdminStickerMarketPack> = {}): AdminStickerMarketPack => ({
+  id: 9201,
+  upstreamId: 'group-1',
+  source: 'fluxdo',
+  name: 'Pack One',
+  topic: 'anime',
+  upstreamCount: 3,
+  archived: false,
+  missing: false,
+  status: 'partial',
+  published: true,
+  sortOrder: 0,
+  itemCount: 2,
+  failedCount: 1,
+  importTotal: 3,
+  lastError: '',
+  coverUrl: '/file/img/stickers/market/a.png',
+  iconUrl: '',
+  iconText: '',
+  syncedAt: '2026-10-29T08:00:00Z',
+  importedAt: '2026-10-29T08:05:00Z',
+  ...overrides,
+})
+
+const marketPage = (packs: AdminStickerMarketPack[]): AdminStickerMarketPage => ({
+  enabled: true,
+  source: 'fluxdo',
+  lastSyncedAt: '2026-10-29T08:00:00Z',
+  topics: [{ id: 'anime', label: '动画' }],
+  packs,
+  total: packs.length,
+  page: 1,
+  pageSize: 20,
+})
+
+const payload = { component: 'manage-home', props: {}, meta: { title: 'admin' }, layout: {}, url: '/admin/sticker-market', version: 'test' } as unknown as AdminPayload
+
+let wrapper: VueWrapper | undefined
+afterEach(() => {
+  wrapper?.unmount()
+  document.body.innerHTML = ''
+  vi.useRealTimers()
+  vi.resetAllMocks()
+})
+
+function mountPage() {
+  wrapper = mount(StickerMarketManagementPage, { props: { payload }, attachTo: document.body })
+  return { page: wrapper, body: new DOMWrapper(document.body) }
+}
+
+function deferred<T>() {
+  let resolve!: (value: T) => void
+  const promise = new Promise<T>((yes) => { resolve = yes })
+  return { promise, resolve }
+}
+
+function buttonWithText(text: string) {
+  return wrapper!.findAll('button').find(button => button.text().includes(text))!
+}
+
+describe('sticker market management page', () => {
+  test('lists packs with their import state and topic label', async () => {
+    vi.mocked(getStickerMarket).mockResolvedValue(marketPage([pack(), pack({ id: 9202, upstreamId: 'group-2', name: 'Pack Two', status: 'new', published: false, itemCount: 0, failedCount: 0, coverUrl: '', importedAt: null })]))
+    const { page } = mountPage()
+    await flushPromises()
+
+    const rows = page.findAll('tbody tr')
+    expect(rows).toHaveLength(2)
+    expect(rows[0].text()).toContain('Pack One')
+    expect(rows[0].text()).toContain('动画')
+    expect(rows[0].text()).toContain('stickerMarketStatusPartial')
+    expect(rows[0].text()).toContain('stickerMarketFailedCount{"count":1}')
+    // A pack with no imported stickers cannot be published yet.
+    const publish = rows[1].get('[role="switch"]')
+    expect(publish.attributes('disabled')).toBeDefined()
+    expect(rows[1].text()).toContain('stickerMarketImport')
+  })
+
+  test('import queues the pack and shows live progress until the task finishes', async () => {
+    vi.useFakeTimers()
+    const fresh = pack({ id: 9202, status: 'new', published: false, itemCount: 0, failedCount: 0, importTotal: 0 })
+    vi.mocked(getStickerMarket).mockResolvedValueOnce(marketPage([fresh]))
+    vi.mocked(importStickerMarketPack).mockResolvedValue({ ...fresh, status: 'queued' })
+    const { page } = mountPage()
+    await flushPromises()
+
+    await buttonWithText('stickerMarketImport').trigger('click')
+    await flushPromises()
+    expect(importStickerMarketPack).toHaveBeenCalledWith(9202)
+    expect(adminToast.success).toHaveBeenCalledWith('stickerMarketImportQueued')
+    expect(page.text()).toContain('stickerMarketStatusQueued')
+    expect(page.text()).toContain('stickerMarketWaiting')
+
+    vi.mocked(getStickerMarket).mockResolvedValueOnce(marketPage([{ ...fresh, status: 'importing', itemCount: 1, failedCount: 1, importTotal: 4 }]))
+    await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(1500)
+    await flushPromises()
+    const bar = page.get('[role="progressbar"]')
+    expect(bar.attributes('aria-valuenow')).toBe('2')
+    expect(bar.attributes('aria-valuemax')).toBe('4')
+    expect(bar.attributes('aria-label')).toBe('stickerMarketProgressLabel{"name":"Pack One"}')
+    expect(page.text()).toContain('stickerMarketProgress{"done":2,"total":4}')
+
+    vi.mocked(getStickerMarket).mockResolvedValueOnce(marketPage([{ ...fresh, status: 'ready', itemCount: 2, failedCount: 0, importTotal: 2 }]))
+    await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(1500)
+    await flushPromises()
+    expect(getStickerMarket).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(3)
+    expect(page.text()).toContain('stickerMarketStatusReady')
+    expect(page.find('[role="progressbar"]').exists()).toBe(false)
+  })
+
+  test('does not restart polling when an in-flight refresh finishes after unmount', async () => {
+    vi.useFakeTimers()
+    const importing = pack({ status: 'importing' })
+    const refresh = deferred<AdminStickerMarketPage>()
+    vi.mocked(getStickerMarket)
+      .mockResolvedValueOnce(marketPage([importing]))
+      .mockReturnValueOnce(refresh.promise)
+    const { page } = mountPage()
+    await flushPromises()
+
+    await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(1500)
+    expect(getStickerMarket).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2)
+    page.unmount()
+    refresh.resolve(marketPage([importing]))
+    await flushPromises()
+    await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(3000)
+
+    expect(getStickerMarket).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2)
+  })
+
+  test('closes stale details when the pack leaves the current result page', async () => {
+    const importing = pack({ status: 'importing' })
+    vi.mocked(getStickerMarket)
+      .mockResolvedValueOnce(marketPage([importing]))
+      .mockResolvedValueOnce(marketPage([]))
+    vi.mocked(getStickerMarketPack).mockResolvedValue({ pack: importing, items: [] })
+    const { page, body } = mountPage()
+    await flushPromises()
+    await page.get('button[title="stickerMarketViewStickers"]').trigger('click')
+    await flushPromises()
+    expect(body.get('[role="dialog"]').exists()).toBe(true)
+
+    await page.get('button[aria-label="k004q"]').trigger('click')
+    await flushPromises()
+
+    expect(body.find('[role="dialog"]').exists()).toBe(false)
+  })
+
+  test('does not reopen a detail request after its pack leaves the result page', async () => {
+    const importing = pack({ status: 'importing' })
+    const detail = deferred<{ pack: AdminStickerMarketPack, items: [] }>()
+    vi.mocked(getStickerMarket)
+      .mockResolvedValueOnce(marketPage([importing]))
+      .mockResolvedValueOnce(marketPage([]))
+    vi.mocked(getStickerMarketPack).mockReturnValueOnce(detail.promise)
+    const { page, body } = mountPage()
+    await flushPromises()
+    await page.get('button[title="stickerMarketViewStickers"]').trigger('click')
+    await flushPromises()
+
+    await page.get('button[aria-label="k004q"]').trigger('click')
+    await flushPromises()
+    detail.resolve({ pack: importing, items: [] })
+    await flushPromises()
+
+    expect(body.find('[role="dialog"]').exists()).toBe(false)
+  })
+
+  test('shows a server-made cover before import and falls back when it fails', async () => {
+    vi.mocked(getStickerMarket).mockResolvedValue(marketPage([
+      pack({ id: 9203, status: 'new', coverUrl: '', iconUrl: '/api/admin/sticker-market-cover?id=9203' }),
+      pack({ id: 9204, status: 'new', coverUrl: '', iconUrl: '/api/admin/sticker-market-cover?id=9204', iconText: '🌿' }),
+      pack({ id: 9205, coverUrl: '/file/img/stickers/market/b.png', iconUrl: '/file/img/stickers/market/icon.png' }),
+    ]))
+    const { page } = mountPage()
+    await flushPromises()
+    // Emoji text covers render through Twemoji; only the cover images carry the size class.
+    const covers = () => page.findAll('tbody img.size-10').map((image) => image.attributes('src'))
+    expect(covers()).toEqual(['/api/admin/sticker-market-cover?id=9203', '/api/admin/sticker-market-cover?id=9204', '/file/img/stickers/market/b.png'])
+
+    await page.findAll('tbody img.size-10')[1].trigger('error')
+    expect(covers()).toEqual(['/api/admin/sticker-market-cover?id=9203', '/file/img/stickers/market/b.png'])
+    expect(page.find('tbody img[src="/twemoji/72x72/1f33f.png"]').exists()).toBe(true)
+
+    await page.findAll('tbody img.size-10')[0].trigger('error')
+    expect(covers()).toEqual(['/file/img/stickers/market/b.png'])
+  })
+
+  test('publishing saves the pack and confirms the change', async () => {
+    vi.mocked(getStickerMarket).mockResolvedValue(marketPage([pack({ published: false })]))
+    vi.mocked(saveStickerMarketPack).mockResolvedValue(pack({ published: true }))
+    const { page } = mountPage()
+    await flushPromises()
+
+    await page.get('tbody [role="switch"]').trigger('click')
+    await flushPromises()
+    expect(saveStickerMarketPack).toHaveBeenCalledWith({ id: 9201, published: true, sortOrder: 0 })
+    expect(adminToast.success).toHaveBeenCalledWith('stickerMarketPublished{"name":"Pack One"}')
+  })
+
+  test('sync reports packs that left the upstream catalog and localizes failures', async () => {
+    vi.mocked(getStickerMarket).mockResolvedValue(marketPage([]))
+    vi.mocked(syncStickerMarket).mockResolvedValueOnce({ topics: 1, packs: 2, missing: 1 })
+    mountPage()
+    await flushPromises()
+
+    await buttonWithText('stickerMarketSync').trigger('click')
+    await flushPromises()
+    expect(adminToast.success).toHaveBeenCalledWith('stickerMarketSyncedWithMissing{"packs":2,"missing":1}')

+    vi.mocked(syncStickerMarket).mockRejectedValueOnce(Object.assign(new Error('x'), { messageCode: 'admin.sticker.market.unavailable' }))
+    await buttonWithText('stickerMarketSync').trigger('click')
+    await flushPromises()
+    expect(adminToast.warning).toHaveBeenCalledWith('stickerMarketUnavailable')
+  })
+
+  test('withdrawing one sticker from the pack detail', async () => {
+    vi.mocked(getStickerMarket).mockResolvedValue(marketPage([pack()]))
+    vi.mocked(getStickerMarketPack).mockResolvedValue({
+      pack: pack(),
+      items: [
+        { upstreamId: 'e1', stickerId: 9301, name: 'm_a', aliases: [], url: '/a.png', isEnabled: true, error: '' },
+        { upstreamId: 'e3', stickerId: 0, name: '', aliases: [], url: '', isEnabled: false, error: 'blocked' },
+      ],

+    await flushPromises()
+
+    await page.findAll('button').find(button => button.attributes('title') === 'stickerMarketViewStickers')!.trigger('click')
+    await flushPromises()
+    expect(body.text()).toContain('stickerMarketItemNotImported{"reason":"stickerMarketReasonBlocked"}')
+    await body.get('[role="dialog"] [role="switch"]').trigger('click')
+    await flushPromises()
+    expect(saveStickerMarketItem).toHaveBeenCalledWith({ stickerId: 9301, isEnabled: false })
+    expect(adminToast.success).toHaveBeenCalledWith('stickerMarketItemWithdrawn')
+  })
+
+  test('renaming a sticker inline keeps the generated name as a previous name', async () => {
+    const generated = 'm_' + 'a'.repeat(40)
+    vi.mocked(getStickerMarket).mockResolvedValue(marketPage([pack()]))
+    vi.mocked(getStickerMarketPack).mockResolvedValue({
+      pack: pack(),
+      items: [{ upstreamId: 'e1', stickerId: 9301, name: generated, aliases: [], url: '/a.png', isEnabled: true, error: '' }],
+    })
+    vi.mocked(saveStickerMarketItem)
+      .mockRejectedValueOnce(Object.assign(new Error('x'), { messageCode: 'admin.sticker.nameExists' }))
+      .mockResolvedValueOnce(true)
+    const { page, body } = mountPage()
+    await flushPromises()
+    await page.findAll('button').find(button => button.attributes('title') === 'stickerMarketViewStickers')!.trigger('click')
+    await flushPromises()
+
+    await body.get(`[role="dialog"] button[title="${generated}"]`).trigger('click')
+    await flushPromises()
+    const field = body.get<HTMLInputElement>('#sticker-market-name-9301')
+    // A generated token is not a useful starting point; the field starts empty.
+    expect(field.element.value).toBe('')
+    expect(document.activeElement).toBe(field.element)
+
+    await field.setValue('happy_cat')
+    await body.get('[role="dialog"] form').trigger('submit')

@@ -0,0 +1,51 @@
+import assert from 'node:assert/strict'
+import { after, before, test } from 'node:test'
+import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url'
+import { chromium, webkit } from 'playwright'
+import { createServer } from 'vite'
+
+let server, origin
+const browsers = {}
+before(async () => {
+  server = await createServer({ root: fileURLToPath(new URL('../', import.meta.url)), server: { host: '127.0.0.1', port: 0, open: false }, logLevel: 'error' })
+  await server.listen()
+  origin = `http://127.0.0.1:${server.httpServer.address().port}`
+  browsers.chromium = await chromium.launch()
+  browsers.webkit = await webkit.launch()
+})
+after(async () => { await Promise.all(Object.values(browsers).map(browser => browser.close())); await server?.close() })
+
+function fixture(path) {
+  if (/namespaces$|\/tree$|\/runs$|migrate-tasks$|sync-status$/.test(path)) return []
+  if (path.endsWith('/sponsors')) return { sponsors: [] }
+  if (path.includes('feed')) return { enabled: true, rankingReady: true, paramsHash: 'fixture', rows: [], periods: [], health: {} }
+  return {}
+}
+
+for (const engine of ['chromium', 'webkit']) for (const kind of ['feed', 'wiki', 'sponsors', 'security', 'onesystem', 'storage']) for (const lang of ['zh', 'en', 'ja', 'de']) for (const theme of ['gf-light', 'gf-dark']) {
+  test(`${engine}: ${kind} translated controls fit 320px ${lang}/${theme}`, async () => {
+    const page = await browsers[engine].newPage({ viewport: { width: 320, height: 900 } })
+    const errors = []
+    page.on('pageerror', error => errors.push(error.message))
+    try {
+      await page.route('**/api/**', route => route.fulfill({ json: { code: 0, result: fixture(new URL(route.request().url()).pathname) } }))
+      await page.goto(`${origin}/assets/test/fixtures/browser/admin-translated-layout.html?kind=${kind}&lang=${lang}&theme=${theme}`)
+      await page.locator('#app[data-ready="true"] h1').waitFor()
+      await page.waitForFunction(() => !document.querySelector('svg.animate-spin'))
+      await page.evaluate(() => document.fonts.ready)
+      assert.deepEqual(errors, [])
+      const size = await page.evaluate(() => ({ width: innerWidth, scroll: document.documentElement.scrollWidth }))
+      assert.ok(size.scroll <= size.width + 1, JSON.stringify(size))
+      if (kind === 'wiki') {
+        const tabs = page.getByRole('tab')
+        for (let index = 0; index < await tabs.count(); index++) {
+          assert.ok(await tabs.nth(index).isVisible())
+          const box = await tabs.nth(index).boundingBox()
+          assert.ok(box.x >= 0 && box.x + box.width <= 321)
+        }
+        await tabs.first().focus(); await page.keyboard.press('ArrowRight')
+        assert.equal(await tabs.nth(1).getAttribute('data-state'), 'active')
+      }
+    } finally { await page.close() }
+  })
+}

evidence.detail:
diff --git a/apps/gooseforum/resource/test/announcement-collapse.test.ts b/apps/gooseforum/resource/test/announcement-collapse.test.ts

--- /dev/null
+++ b/apps/gooseforum/resource/test/announcement-collapse.test.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,141 @@
+// @vitest-environment happy-dom
+import { afterEach, beforeEach, expect, test, vi } from 'vitest'
+import { flushPromises, mount } from '@vue/test-utils'
+import AdminSettingsPage from '../src/admin/pages/AdminSettingsPage.vue'
+import { i18n, setLocale } from '../src/runtime/i18n'
+import { getAnnouncement } from '@/admin/runtime/api'
+
+vi.mock('@/admin/runtime/api')
+vi.mock('@/admin/runtime/toast', () => ({
+  adminToast: {
+    success: vi.fn(),
+    error: vi.fn(),
+    warning: vi.fn(),
+  },
+}))
+
+let wrapper: ReturnType<typeof mount> | undefined
+
+afterEach(() => {
+  wrapper?.unmount()
+  wrapper = undefined
+  document.body.innerHTML = ''
+  vi.resetAllMocks()
+})
+
+beforeEach(async () => {
+  await setLocale('zh')
+})
+
+// issue #1322：公告卡片进入页面时全部折叠，只留排名/标题/启用/删除，
+// 点标题行展开正文。新增公告默认展开，省一次点击。
+async function mountAnnouncementPage() {
+  vi.mocked(getAnnouncement).mockResolvedValue({
+    enabled: true,
+    content: '',
+    items: [
+      { id: 'ann-1', title: '第一条公告', content: '内容一', enabled: true },
+      { id: 'ann-2', title: '第二条公告', content: '内容二', enabled: false },
+    ],
+  } as never)
+
+  wrapper = mount(AdminSettingsPage, {
+    props: {
+      kind: 'announcement',
+      payload: {
+        layout: {
+          sidebar: { categories: [] },
+          site: { name: 'YourTJHub' },
+          viewer: { username: 'admin', avatarUrl: '' },
+        },
+      } as never,
+    },
+    global: { plugins: [i18n] },
+  })
+  await flushPromises()
+  const form = wrapper.element.querySelector('form')
+  expect(form, 'announcement form should render').not.toBeNull()
+  return form as HTMLElement
+}
+
+function bodies(root: HTMLElement) {
+  return {
+    first: root.querySelector<HTMLElement>('#announcement-ann-1'),
+    second: root.querySelector<HTMLElement>('#announcement-ann-2'),
+  }
+}
+
+function toggles(root: HTMLElement) {
+  return [...root.querySelectorAll<HTMLButtonElement>('button[aria-controls^="announcement-"]')]
+}
+
+test('公告卡片默认全部折叠，只保留头部摘要', async () => {
+  const root = await mountAnnouncementPage()
+  const { first, second } = bodies(root)
+  expect(first, 'collapsed body container must still exist (v-show)').not.toBeNull()
+  expect(second).not.toBeNull()
+  expect(first!.style.display).toBe('none')
+  expect(second!.style.display).toBe('none')
+
+  // 标题输入框随正文一起收起
+  const titleInputs = [...root.querySelectorAll<HTMLInputElement>('input')]
+  expect(titleInputs).toHaveLength(2)
+  for (const input of titleInputs) expect(input.closest<HTMLElement>('[id^="announcement-"]')!.style.display).toBe('none')
+
+  // 折叠开关：button + aria-expanded/aria-controls + 键盘可聚焦（非 tabindex=-1）
+  const buttons = toggles(root)
+  expect(buttons).toHaveLength(2)
+  for (const button of buttons) {
+    expect(button.getAttribute('aria-expanded')).toBe('false')
+    expect(button.getAttribute('tabindex')).not.toBe('-1')
+  }
+  expect(buttons.map(button => button.getAttribute('aria-controls'))).toEqual([
+    'announcement-ann-1',
+    'announcement-ann-2',
+  ])
+
+  // 折叠态头部仍有排名、标题、启用开关、删除按钮和拖拽手柄
+  expect(buttons[0]!.textContent).toContain('#1')
+  expect(buttons[0]!.textContent).toContain('第一条公告')
+  expect(buttons[1]!.textContent).toContain('#2')
+  expect(buttons[1]!.textContent).toContain('第二条公告')
+  const cards = buttons.map(button => button.closest('.rounded-lg') as HTMLElement)
+  for (const card of cards) {
+    expect(card.querySelectorAll('[data-slot="switch"]')).toHaveLength(1)
+    expect(card.querySelector('button .sr-only')?.textContent).toContain('删除公告')
+    expect(card.querySelector('.js-announcement-handle')).not.toBeNull()
+  }
+})
+
+test('点折叠开关展开单条公告，另一条保持折叠', async () => {
+  const root = await mountAnnouncementPage()
+  const buttons = toggles(root)
+  buttons[0]!.click()
+  await flushPromises()
+
+  const { first, second } = bodies(root)
+  expect(first!.style.display).not.toBe('none')
+  expect(second!.style.display).toBe('none')
+  expect(toggles(root)[0]!.getAttribute('aria-expanded')).toBe('true')
+  expect(toggles(root)[1]!.getAttribute('aria-expanded')).toBe('false')
+
+  // 再次点击收起
+  toggles(root)[0]!.click()
+  await flushPromises()
+  expect(bodies(root).first!.style.display).toBe('none')
+})
+
+test('添加公告后新卡片默认展开，已有卡片保持折叠', async () => {
+  const root = await mountAnnouncementPage()
+  const addButton = [...root.querySelectorAll<HTMLButtonElement>('button')]
+    .find(button => button.textContent?.includes('添加公告'))
+  expect(addButton, 'add announcement button should render').toBeDefined()
+  addButton!.click()
+  await flushPromises()
+
+  const buttons = toggles(root)
+  expect(buttons).toHaveLength(3)
+  expect(buttons.map(button => button.getAttribute('aria-expanded'))).toEqual(['false', 'false', 'true'])
+  const added = buttons[2]!.getAttribute('aria-controls')!
+  expect(root.querySelector<HTMLElement>(`#${added}`)!.style.display).not.toBe('none')
+})

+// @vitest-environment happy-dom
+import { afterEach, beforeEach, expect, test, vi } from 'vitest'
+import { flushPromises, mount } from '@vue/test-utils'
+import AdminSettingsPage from '../src/admin/pages/AdminSettingsPage.vue'
+import { i18n, setLocale } from '../src/runtime/i18n'
+import { getAnnouncement } from '@/admin/runtime/api'
+
+vi.mock('@/admin/runtime/api')
+vi.mock('@/admin/runtime/toast', () => ({
+  adminToast: {
+    success: vi.fn(),
+    error: vi.fn(),
+    warning: vi.fn(),
+  },
+}))
+
+let wrapper: ReturnType<typeof mount> | undefined
+
+afterEach(() => {
+  wrapper?.unmount()
+  wrapper = undefined
+  document.body.innerHTML = ''
+  vi.resetAllMocks()
+})
+
+beforeEach(async () => {
+  await setLocale('zh')
+})
+
+// issue #1322 回归：公告卡片曾在整卡（含标题 Input 与正文 Textarea）上挂
+// draggable="true"，在输入框里按下即触发整卡拖拽，无法选中文字/定位光标。
+// 排序改由 vuedraggable + 专用手柄承担，卡片内不得再出现原生 draggable。
+test('公告卡片只允许通过手柄拖拽排序，输入框不参与拖拽', async () => {
+  vi.mocked(getAnnouncement).mockResolvedValue({
+    enabled: true,
+    content: '',
+    items: [
+      { id: 'ann-a', title: '第一条', content: '内容一', enabled: true },
+      { id: 'ann-b', title: '第二条', content: '内容二', enabled: true },
+    ],
+  } as never)
+
+  wrapper = mount(AdminSettingsPage, {
+    props: {
+      kind: 'announcement',
+      payload: {
+        layout: {
+          sidebar: { categories: [] },
+          site: { name: 'YourTJHub' },
+          viewer: { username: 'admin', avatarUrl: '' },
+        },
+      } as never,
+    },
+    global: { plugins: [i18n] },
+  })
+  await flushPromises()
+
+  const form = wrapper.element.querySelector('form')
+  expect(form, 'announcement form should render').not.toBeNull()
+  const scoped = form as HTMLElement
+
+  // AC-1：两条公告的标题输入框与正文文本域都存在
+  const titles = [...scoped.querySelectorAll<HTMLInputElement>('input')]
+  const contents = [...scoped.querySelectorAll<HTMLTextAreaElement>('textarea')]
+  expect(titles).toHaveLength(2)
+  expect(contents).toHaveLength(2)
+  expect(titles.map(input => input.value)).toEqual(['第一条', '第二条'])
+
+  // AC-2：输入框与整卡都不再是原生可拖拽元素
+  for (const control of [...titles, ...contents]) {
+    expect(control.closest('[draggable="true"]'), 'text control must not sit inside a draggable card').toBeNull()
+  }
+  expect(scoped.querySelectorAll('[draggable="true"]')).toHaveLength(0)
+
+  // Draggable 只把手柄当拖拽起点（避免整卡/输入框参与拖拽）
+  expect(wrapper.findComponent({ name: 'draggable' }).vm.$attrs.handle).toBe('.js-announcement-handle')
+
+  // AC-5：每张卡片都有可聚焦的手柄，且带无障碍名称
+  const handles = [...scoped.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('.js-announcement-handle')]
+  expect(handles).toHaveLength(2)
+  for (const handle of handles) {
+    expect(handle.tagName.toLowerCase()).toBe('button')
+    expect(handle.getAttribute('type')).toBe('button')
+    const label = handle.getAttribute('aria-label') || handle.getAttribute('title') || ''
+    expect(label.trim(), 'drag handle needs an accessible name').not.toBe('')
+  }
+})

+import assert from 'node:assert/strict'
+import { after, before, test } from 'node:test'
+import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url'
+import { chromium } from 'playwright'
+import { createServer } from 'vite'
+
+let server, browser, origin
+before(async () => {
+  server = await createServer({ root: fileURLToPath(new URL('../', import.meta.url)), server: { host: '127.0.0.1', port: 0, open: false } })
+  await server.listen()
+  origin = `http://127.0.0.1:${server.httpServer.address().port}`

+})
+after(async () => { await browser?.close(); await server?.close() })
+
+test('搜索后的方向键只遍历可见选项，隐藏选中项仍随 GET 表单提交', async () => {
+  const page = await browser.newPage({ viewport: { width: 375, height: 700 } })

+    await page.goto(`${origin}/assets/test/fixtures/browser/course-catalog-multi-select.html?side=down`)

+    await page.getByLabel('计算机科学与技术', { exact: true }).check()
+    const search = page.getByRole('textbox', { name: '搜索选项' })

+    await search.press('ArrowDown')
+    assert.equal(await page.getByLabel('数学科学学院', { exact: true }).evaluate((el) => el === document.activeElement), true)
+    await page.getByLabel('数学科学学院', { exact: true }).press('ArrowUp')
+    assert.equal(await page.getByLabel('数学科学学院', { exact: true }).evaluate((el) => el === document.activeElement), true)
+    assert.deepEqual(await page.locator('#course-more-filters').evaluate((form) => [...new FormData(form).getAll('department')]), ['CS'])
+    await page.getByLabel('数学科学学院', { exact: true }).press('Escape')
+    assert.equal(await page.getByRole('group').isVisible(), false)
+    assert.equal(await page.getByRole('button', { name: '全部院系' }).evaluate((el) => el === document.activeElement), true)
+  } finally { await page.close() }
+})
+
+test('触发按钮滚出视口时收起外置面板，保留已经选择的筛选值', async () => {
+  const page = await browser.newPage({ viewport: { width: 375, height: 700 } })
+  try {
+    await page.goto(`${origin}/assets/test/fixtures/browser/course-catalog-multi-select.html?side=down`)
+    await page.getByRole('button', { name: '全部院系' }).click()
+    await page.getByLabel('计算机科学与技术', { exact: true }).check()
+    await page.evaluate(() => window.scrollTo(0, 600))
+    await page.waitForFunction(() => document.querySelector('button').getBoundingClientRect().bottom < 0)
+    await page.getByRole('group').waitFor({ state: 'hidden', timeout: 1000 })
+    assert.deepEqual(await page.locator('#course-more-filters').evaluate((form) => [...new FormData(form).getAll('department')]), ['CS'])
+  } finally { await page.close() }
+})
+
+for (const viewport of [{ width: 1280, height: 800 }, { width: 375, height: 700 }, { width: 320, height: 700 }]) for (const side of ['up', 'down']) {
+  test(`课程更多筛选下拉越过卡片边缘仍完整可见且可选 (${viewport.width}px, ${side})`, async () => {
+    const page = await browser.newPage({ viewport })
+    try {
+      await page.goto(`${origin}/assets/test/fixtures/browser/course-catalog-multi-select.html?side=${side}`)
+      await page.waitForFunction(() => document.documentElement.dataset.ready === 'true')
+      const card = page.locator('.gf-card')
+      const radius = await card.evaluate((el) => getComputedStyle(el).borderRadius)
+      assert.notEqual(radius, '0px', '卡片继续保留圆角')
+      assert.equal(await card.evaluate((el) => getComputedStyle(el).overflow), 'hidden')
+
+      const trigger = page.getByRole('button', { name: '全部院系' })
+      await trigger.click()
+      const panel = page.getByRole('group')
+      await panel.waitFor({ state: 'visible' })
+      const geometry = await page.evaluate(() => {
+        const card = document.querySelector('.gf-card').getBoundingClientRect()
+        const panel = document.querySelector('[role="group"]').getBoundingClientRect()
+        const trigger = document.querySelector('button').getBoundingClientRect()
+        const hit = document.elementFromPoint(panel.left + 24, panel.bottom - 16)
+        return {
+          cardTop: card.top,
+          cardBottom: card.bottom,
+          panel: panel.toJSON(),
+          trigger: trigger.toJSON(),
+          portaled: document.querySelector('[role="group"]').parentElement === document.body,
+          hitOption: Boolean(hit?.closest('label')),
+          viewportWidth: innerWidth,
+          viewportHeight: innerHeight,
+        }
+      })
+      assert.ok(side === 'up' ? geometry.panel.top < geometry.cardTop : geometry.panel.bottom > geometry.cardBottom, '下拉应跨出卡片边缘以验证裁切场景')
+      assert.ok(geometry.portaled, '下拉脱离裁切卡片')
+      assert.ok(geometry.panel.left >= 0 && geometry.panel.right <= geometry.viewportWidth, '下拉完整位于视口宽度内')
+      assert.ok(geometry.panel.top >= 0 && geometry.panel.bottom <= geometry.viewportHeight, '下拉完整位于视口高度内')
+      assert.ok(geometry.hitOption, '卡片边缘之外的选项仍可命中')
+
+      const option = page.getByLabel('计算机科学与技术')
+      await option.click()
+      assert.equal(await option.isChecked(), true)
+      assert.deepEqual(await page.locator('#course-more-filters').evaluate((form) => [...new FormData(form).getAll('department')]), ['CS'])
+
+      const beforeScroll = await page.evaluate(() => ({ panel: document.querySelector('[role="group"]').getBoundingClientRect().top, trigger: document.querySelector('button').getBoundingClientRect().top }))
+      await page.evaluate(() => window.scrollBy(0, 24))
+      await page.waitForFunction((before) => {
+        const panel = document.querySelector('[role="group"]').getBoundingClientRect().top
+        const trigger = document.querySelector('button').getBoundingClientRect().top
+        return Math.abs((panel - trigger) - (before.panel - before.trigger)) < 1
+      }, beforeScroll)
+      assert.ok(await panel.evaluate((el) => {
+        const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect()
+        return rect.top >= 0 && rect.bottom <= innerHeight
+      }), '页面滚动后下拉仍完整位于视口内')
+    } finally {
+      await page.close()
+    }
+  })
+}

+import assert from 'node:assert/strict'
+import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url'
+import { after, before, test } from 'node:test'
+import { chromium } from 'playwright'
+import { createServer } from 'vite'
+
+let server, browser, origin
+const layout = { viewer: { id: 12, isAuthenticated: true, requiresEmailVerification: false } }
+
+function topic(id, title = `返回测试话题 ${id}`, feedTrace = `trace-${id}`) {
+  return {
+    id, title,
+    description: '这是用于验证详情返回后分页列表与滚动位置的测试话题。'.repeat(2),
+    url: `/p/post/${id}`,
+    author: { id: id === 51 ? 12 : 1000 + id, username: `作者 ${id}`, avatarUrl: '/assets/test/fixtures/browser/topic-feed-art.svg' },
+    participants: [], categories: [{ id: 7, name: '校园生活', url: '/c/7', color: '#3b82f6' }],
+    replyCount: 3, likeCount: 0, viewCount: 12, activityText: '刚刚', lastUpdateTime: '2026-10-07T00:00:00Z',
+    pinWeight: 0, processStatus: 0, contentType: 0, liked: false, bookmarked: false,
+    feedTrace, feedPosition: id - 1,
+  }
+}
+
+function homePayload(ids, { page, nextCursor, titleUpdates = {}, sort = 'latest', viewerId = 12, tracePrefix = 'trace' } = {}) {
+  return {
+    component: 'home.index', url: `/?sort=${sort}`, version: '1.0', layout: { viewer: { ...layout.viewer, id: viewerId } },
+    props: {
+      sort, actualSort: sort,
+      tabs: [{ key: 'latest', active: sort === 'latest', url: '/?sort=latest' }, { key: 'hot', active: sort === 'hot', url: '/?sort=hot' }],
+      topics: ids.map((id) => topic(id, titleUpdates[id] ?? `返回测试话题 ${id}`, `${tracePrefix}-${id}`)),
+      pagination: { page, nextPage: page + 1, hasNext: nextCursor !== null, nextUrl: nextCursor === null ? '' : `/?sort=${sort}&cursor=next-${nextCursor}` },
+      announcement: { enabled: false, html: '', items: [] },
+    },
+  }
+}
+
+function categoryPayload(ids, { page, nextCursor } = {}) {
+  return {
+    component: 'category.index', url: '/c/7', version: '1.0', layout,
+    props: {
+      category: { id: 7, name: '校园生活', description: '分类返回验证', icon: '#', color: '#3b82f6', url: '/c/7' },
+      sort: 'latest', tabs: [{ key: 'latest', active: true, url: '/c/7' }],
+      topics: ids.map((id) => topic(id)),
+      pagination: { page, nextPage: page + 1, hasNext: nextCursor !== null, nextUrl: nextCursor === null ? '' : `/c/7?cursor=next-${nextCursor}` },
+    },
+  }
+}
+
+before(async () => {
+  server = await createServer({ root: fileURLToPath(new URL('../', import.meta.url)), server: { host: '127.0.0.1', port: 0, open: false } })
+  await server.listen()
+  origin = `http://127.0.0.1:${server.httpServer.address().port}`
+  browser = await chromium.launch()
+})
+after(async () => { await browser?.close(); await server?.close() })
+
+async function openFeed({ resync = false } = {}) {
+  const page = await browser.newPage({ viewport: { width: 1440, height: 900 } })
+  page.setDefaultTimeout(10000)
+  const state = { firstPageRequests: 0, categoryRequests: 0, cursors: [], viewerId: 12, removed: [] }
+  await page.addInitScript(() => {
+    class ControlledIntersectionObserver {
+      observe() {}
+      disconnect() {}
+      unobserve() {}
+      takeRecords() { return [] }
+    }
+    window.IntersectionObserver = ControlledIntersectionObserver
+    class ControlledEventSource extends EventTarget {
+      static current
+      constructor() { super(); ControlledEventSource.current = this }
+      close() {}
+    }
+    window.EventSource = ControlledEventSource
+    window.dispatchFeedHello = () => ControlledEventSource.current?.dispatchEvent(new Event('hello'))
+  })
+  await page.route('**/*', async (route) => {
+    const request = route.request()
+    const url = new URL(request.url())
+    if (url.pathname === '/api/forum/feed/reconcile') {
+      const { topicIds: ids, includeOwn } = request.postDataJSON()
+      return route.fulfill({ json: { code: 0, result: {
+        viewerId: state.viewerId, topics: [],
+        removedIds: ids.filter((id) => state.removed.includes(id) || (id === 51 && !includeOwn)), seenProofs: [], available: true,
+      } } })
+    }
+    if (!request.headers()['x-goose-page']) return route.continue()
+    if (/^\/p\/post\/\d+$/.test(url.pathname)) {
+      return route.fulfill({ json: { component: 'topic.detail', props: {}, layout, url: url.pathname, version: '1.0' } })
+    }
+    if (url.pathname === '/c/7') {
+      const cursor = url.searchParams.get('cursor')
+      if (cursor) {
+        const offset = Number(cursor.replace('next-', ''))
+        state.cursors.push(cursor)
+        return route.fulfill({ json: categoryPayload(Array.from({ length: 20 }, (_, index) => 200 + offset + index + 1), { page: offset / 20 + 1, nextCursor: offset < 40 ? offset + 20 : null }) })
+      }
+      state.categoryRequests++
+      return route.fulfill({ json: categoryPayload(Array.from({ length: 20 }, (_, index) => 201 + index), { page: 1, nextCursor: 20 }) })
+    }
+    if (url.pathname !== '/') return route.fulfill({ status: 404, json: {} })
+    const sort = url.searchParams.get('sort') ?? 'latest'
+    const cursor = url.searchParams.get('cursor')
+    if (cursor) {
+      state.cursors.push(cursor)
+      const offset = Number(cursor.replace('next-', ''))
+      const baseID = sort === 'hot' ? 100 : 0
+      const ids = Array.from({ length: 20 }, (_, index) => baseID + offset + index + 1)
+      return route.fulfill({ json: homePayload(ids, { page: offset / 20 + 1, nextCursor: offset < 60 ? offset + 20 : null, sort, viewerId: state.viewerId }) })
+    }
+    if (sort === 'hot') return route.fulfill({ json: homePayload(Array.from({ length: 20 }, (_, index) => 101 + index), { page: 1, nextCursor: 20, sort, viewerId: state.viewerId }) })
+    state.firstPageRequests++
+    if (resync && state.firstPageRequests === 1) {
+      return route.fulfill({ json: homePayload([100, ...Array.from({ length: 20 }, (_, index) => index + 1)], { page: 1, nextCursor: 20 }) })
+    }
+    if (state.viewerId !== 12) {
+      return route.fulfill({ json: homePayload(Array.from({ length: 20 }, (_, index) => 501 + index), { page: 1, nextCursor: 20, viewerId: state.viewerId }) })
+    }
+    return route.fulfill({ json: homePayload(Array.from({ length: 20 }, (_, index) => index + 1), {
+      page: 1, nextCursor: 20, titleUpdates: state.firstPageRequests > 0 ? { 1: '首页已更新' } : {},
+      tracePrefix: state.firstPageRequests > 0 ? 'return' : 'trace',
+    }) })
+  })
+  await page.goto(`${origin}/assets/test/fixtures/browser/home-return.html`)
+  await page.waitForFunction(() => document.documentElement.dataset.ready === 'true')
+  await page.locator('[data-feed-id="20"]').waitFor()
+  return { page, state }
+}
+
+async function loadThreePages(page) {
+  for (const lastID of [40, 60]) {
+    await page.getByRole('button', { name: '加载更多', exact: true }).click()
+    await page.locator(`[data-feed-id="${lastID}"]`).waitFor()
+  }
+  return page.locator('[data-feed-id]').evaluateAll((rows) => rows.map((row) => Number(row.dataset.feedId)))
+}
+
+test('Web browser back from topic detail preserves three loaded feed pages and scroll position', async () => {
+  const { page, state } = await openFeed()
+  try {
+    const loadedIDs = await loadThreePages(page)
+    await page.locator('[data-feed-id="51"]').evaluate((row) => window.scrollBy(0, row.getBoundingClientRect().top - 100))
+    const before = await page.locator('[data-feed-id="51"]').evaluate((row) => ({ top: row.getBoundingClientRect().top, scrollY: window.scrollY }))
+    const originalTrace = await page.locator('[data-feed-id="1"]').getAttribute('data-feed-trace')
+
+    await page.locator('[data-feed-id="51"] a[href="/p/post/51"]').first().click()
+    await page.getByTestId('detail').waitFor()
+    await page.goBack()
+    await page.locator('[data-feed-id="60"]').waitFor()
+    await page.locator('[data-feed-view="table"] a[href="/p/post/1"]', { hasText: '首页已更新' }).waitFor()
+
+    assert.deepEqual(await page.locator('[data-feed-id]').evaluateAll((rows) => rows.map((row) => Number(row.dataset.feedId))), loadedIDs)
+    assert.equal(await page.locator('[data-feed-id="1"]').getAttribute('data-feed-trace'), originalTrace)
+    const after = await page.locator('[data-feed-id="51"]').evaluate((row) => ({ top: row.getBoundingClientRect().top, scrollY: window.scrollY }))
+    assert.ok(Math.abs(after.top - before.top) < 3, `topic anchor moved from ${before.top}px to ${after.top}px`)
+    assert.ok(Math.abs(after.scrollY - before.scrollY) < 3, `scrollY moved from ${before.scrollY}px to ${after.scrollY}px`)
+    assert.equal(state.firstPageRequests, 1)
+    await page.getByRole('button', { name: '加载更多', exact: true }).click()
+    await page.locator('[data-feed-id="80"]').waitFor()
+    assert.deepEqual(state.cursors, ['next-20', 'next-40', 'next-60'])
+  } finally { await page.close() }
+})
+
+test('SSE hello resync updates the first page without dropping loaded rows or the cursor', async () => {
+  const { page, state } = await openFeed({ resync: true })
+  try {
+    await loadThreePages(page)
+    await page.locator('[data-feed-id="51"]').evaluate((row) => window.scrollBy(0, row.getBoundingClientRect().top - 100))
+    const beforeTop = await page.locator('[data-feed-id="51"]').evaluate((row) => row.getBoundingClientRect().top)
+
+    await page.evaluate(() => window.dispatchFeedHello())
+    await page.locator('[data-feed-id="100"]').waitFor()
+    await page.locator('[data-feed-id="60"]').waitFor()
+    assert.equal(await page.locator('[data-feed-id]').count(), 61)
+    assert.ok(Math.abs((await page.locator('[data-feed-id="51"]').evaluate((row) => row.getBoundingClientRect().top)) - beforeTop) < 3)
+
+    await page.getByRole('button', { name: '加载更多', exact: true }).click()
+    await page.locator('[data-feed-id="80"]').waitFor()
+    assert.deepEqual(state.cursors, ['next-20', 'next-40', 'next-60'])
+  } finally { await page.close() }
+})
+
+test('category detail return keeps its cached pages and scroll position', async () => {
+  const { page, state } = await openFeed()
+  try {
+    await page.locator('[data-feed-view="table"] a[href="/c/7"]').first().click()
+    await page.waitForURL('**/c/7')
+    await page.locator('[data-feed-id="220"]').waitFor()
+    for (const lastID of [240, 260]) {
+      await page.getByRole('button', { name: '加载更多', exact: true }).click()
+      await page.locator(`[data-feed-id="${lastID}"]`).waitFor()
+    }
+    const loadedIDs = await page.locator('[data-feed-id]').evaluateAll((rows) => rows.map((row) => Number(row.dataset.feedId)))
+    await page.locator('[data-feed-id="251"]').evaluate((row) => window.scrollBy(0, row.getBoundingClientRect().top - 100))
+    const before = await page.locator('[data-feed-id="251"]').evaluate((row) => ({ top: row.getBoundingClientRect().top, scrollY: window.scrollY }))
+
+    await page.locator('[data-feed-id="251"] a[href="/p/post/251"]').first().click()
+    await page.getByTestId('detail').waitFor()
+    await page.goBack()
+    await page.locator('[data-feed-id="260"]').waitFor()
+
+    assert.deepEqual(await page.locator('[data-feed-id]').evaluateAll((rows) => rows.map((row) => Number(row.dataset.feedId))), loadedIDs)
+    const after = await page.locator('[data-feed-id="251"]').evaluate((row) => ({ top: row.getBoundingClientRect().top, scrollY: window.scrollY }))
+    assert.ok(Math.abs(after.top - before.top) < 3)
+    assert.ok(Math.abs(after.scrollY - before.scrollY) < 3)
+    assert.equal(state.categoryRequests, 2, 'category payload was requested again on browser back')
+  } finally { await page.close() }
+})
+
+test('changing home sort replaces the old feed instead of carrying its loaded rows', async () => {
+  const { page } = await openFeed()
+  try {
+    await loadThreePages(page)
+    await page.locator('a[href="/?sort=hot"]').first().click()
+    await page.waitForURL('**/?sort=hot')
+    await page.locator('[data-feed-id="120"]').waitFor()
+    assert.equal(await page.locator('[data-feed-id]').count(), 20)
+    assert.equal(await page.locator('[data-feed-id="60"]').count(), 0)
+  } finally { await page.close() }
+})
+
+test('return after account change discards the previous account feed', async () => {
+  const { page, state } = await openFeed()
+  try {
+    await loadThreePages(page)
+    await page.locator('[data-feed-id="51"] a[href="/p/post/51"]').first().click()
+    await page.getByTestId('detail').waitFor()
+    state.viewerId = 13
+    await page.goBack()
+    await page.locator('[data-feed-id="520"]').waitFor()
+    assert.equal(await page.locator('[data-feed-id]').count(), 20)
+    assert.equal(await page.locator('[data-feed-id="60"]').count(), 0)
+  } finally { await page.close() }
+})
+
+test('SSE after an account change replaces rows and resets the old cursor', async () => {
+  const { page, state } = await openFeed()
+  try {
+    await loadThreePages(page)
+    state.viewerId = 13
+    await page.evaluate(() => window.dispatchFeedHello())
+    await page.locator('[data-feed-id="520"]').waitFor()
+    assert.equal(await page.locator('[data-feed-id]').count(), 20)
+    assert.equal(await page.locator('[data-feed-id="60"]').count(), 0)
+    await page.getByRole('button', { name: '加载更多', exact: true }).click()
+    await page.waitForFunction(() => document.querySelectorAll('[data-feed-id]').length > 20)
+    assert.equal(state.cursors.at(-1), 'next-20')
+  } finally { await page.close() }
+})
+
+test('continuation after account change reloads the new account first page', async () => {
+  const { page, state } = await openFeed()
+  try {
+    await loadThreePages(page)
+    state.viewerId = 13
+    await page.getByRole('button', { name: '加载更多', exact: true }).click()
+    await page.locator('[data-feed-id="520"]').waitFor()
+    assert.equal(await page.locator('[data-feed-id]').count(), 20)
+    assert.equal(await page.locator('[data-feed-id="60"]').count(), 0)
+  } finally { await page.close() }
+})
+
+test('an account change observed by a background probe cannot merge old rows on SSE', async () => {
+  const { page, state } = await openFeed()
+  try {
+    await loadThreePages(page)
+    state.viewerId = 13
+    await page.evaluate(async () => {
+      const { fetchPage } = await import('/assets/src/runtime/router.ts')
+      await fetchPage(new URL('/?sort=latest', window.location.origin), true)
+    })
+    await page.evaluate(() => window.dispatchFeedHello())
+    await page.locator('[data-feed-id="520"]').waitFor()
+    assert.equal(await page.locator('[data-feed-id]').count(), 20)
+    assert.equal(await page.locator('[data-feed-id="60"]').count(), 0)
+  } finally { await page.close() }
+})
+
+for (const trigger of ['back', 'SSE']) {
+  test(`a removed cached topic disappears on ${trigger} without discarding later pages`, async () => {
+    const { page, state } = await openFeed()
+    try {
+      await loadThreePages(page)
+      if (trigger === 'back') {
+        await page.locator('[data-feed-id="51"] a[href="/p/post/51"]').first().click()
+        await page.getByTestId('detail').waitFor()
+      }
+      state.removed = [51]
+      if (trigger === 'back') await page.goBack()
+      else await page.evaluate(() => window.dispatchFeedHello())
+      await page.locator('[data-feed-id="60"]').waitFor()
+      await page.waitForFunction(() => !document.querySelector('[data-feed-id="51"]'))
+      assert.equal(await page.locator('[data-feed-id="60"]').count(), 1)
+      assert.equal(await page.locator('[data-feed-id]').count(), 59)
+    } finally { await page.close() }
+  })
+}

+import { defineComponent, h, KeepAlive, shallowRef } from 'vue'
+import HomePage from '../../../src/site/pages/HomePage.vue'
+import CategoryPage from '../../../src/site/pages/CategoryPage.vue'
+import { installNavigation, type PreparedPage } from '../../../src/runtime/router'
+import { i18n, setLocale } from '../../../src/runtime/i18n'
+import type { HomeProps, LayoutPayload, TopicPayload } from '@gooseforum/client'
+import { createBrowserApp } from './create-app'
+import '../../../src/styles/resource.css'
+
+await setLocale('zh')
+document.documentElement.dataset.theme = 'gf-light'
+
+const art = '/assets/test/fixtures/browser/topic-feed-art.svg'
+export const topic = (id: number, title = `返回测试话题 ${id}`): TopicPayload => ({
+  id,
+  title,
+  description: '这是用于验证详情返回后分页列表与滚动位置的测试话题。'.repeat(2),
+  url: `/p/post/${id}`,
+  author: { id: 1000 + id, username: `作者 ${id}`, avatarUrl: art },
+  participants: [],
+  categories: [{ id: 7, name: '校园生活', url: '/c/7', color: '#3b82f6' }],
+  replyCount: 3,
+  likeCount: 0,
+  viewCount: 12,
+  activityText: '刚刚',
+  lastUpdateTime: '2026-10-07T00:00:00Z',
+  pinWeight: 0,
+  processStatus: 0,
+  contentType: 0,
+  liked: false,
+  bookmarked: false,
+  feedTrace: `trace-${id}`,
+  feedPosition: id - 1,
+})
+
+const layout = {
+  viewer: { id: 12, isAuthenticated: true, requiresEmailVerification: false },
+} as LayoutPayload
+const props: HomeProps = {
+  sort: 'latest',
+  actualSort: 'latest',
+  tabs: [
+    { key: 'latest', active: true, url: '/?sort=latest' },
+    { key: 'hot', active: false, url: '/?sort=hot' },
+  ],
+  topics: Array.from({ length: 20 }, (_, index) => topic(index + 1)),
+  pagination: { page: 1, nextPage: 2, hasNext: true, nextUrl: '/?sort=latest&cursor=next-20' },
+  announcement: { enabled: false, html: '', items: [] },
+}
+const initial: PreparedPage = {
+  component: HomePage,
+  payload: { component: 'home.index', props, layout, url: '/?sort=latest', version: '1.0' },
+}
+const current = shallowRef(initial)
+window.history.replaceState(null, '', '/?sort=latest')
+
+// Keep the real HomePage and router lifecycle, while rendering a small detail
+// surface so the test controls only the remote page payload.
+const root = defineComponent({
+  setup: () => () => h('main', [
+    h(KeepAlive, {}, () => {
+      if (current.value.payload.component === 'home.index') return h(HomePage, {
+          key: 'home.index',
+          props: current.value.payload.props as HomeProps,
+          layout: current.value.payload.layout,
+          pageUrl: current.value.payload.url,
+        })
+      if (current.value.payload.component === 'category.index') return h(CategoryPage, {
+        key: 'category.index',
+        props: current.value.payload.props as import('@gooseforum/client').CategoryPageProps,
+        layout: current.value.payload.layout,
+        pageUrl: current.value.payload.url,
+      })
+      return null
+    }),
+    current.value.payload.component === 'topic.detail'
+      ? h('article', { 'data-testid': 'detail' }, [h('h1', `详情 ${current.value.payload.url}`)])
+      : null,
+  ]),
+})
+
+const router = installNavigation(initial, root, (page) => { current.value = page })
+const app = createBrowserApp(root).use(i18n).use(router)
+await router.isReady()
+app.mount('#app')
+document.documentElement.dataset.ready = 'true'
