+import { h, ref } from 'vue'
+import { createBrowserApp as createApp } from './create-app'
+import VditorOfficial from '../../../src/site/components/VditorOfficial.vue'
+import { i18n, setLocale } from '../../../src/runtime/i18n'
+import '../../../src/styles/resource.css'
+
+await setLocale('zh')
+
+const value = ref('')
+const editor = ref<{ insertMarkdown: (markdown: string) => void } | null>(null)
+
+// 测试钩子：宿主设置正文（含既有贴纸 token）走 modelValue，等价于草稿/回填路径
+;(window as unknown as { testSetValue: (next: string) => void }).testSetValue = (next) => {
+  value.value = next
+}
+
+createApp({
+  render: () => h('div', { class: 'p-4' }, [
+    h(VditorOfficial, {
+      ref: editor,
+      modelValue: value.value,
+      'onUpdate:modelValue': (next: string) => { value.value = next },
+      placeholder: '说点什么',
+    }),
+    // 与三个宿主编辑器插入贴纸的调用一致（element.click() 不移焦，光标仍在编辑区）
+    h('button', {
+      id: 'insert-sticker',
+      type: 'button',
+      onClick: () => editor.value?.insertMarkdown('[:sticker:huaji:]'),
+    }, 'insert sticker'),
+    h('pre', { id: 'model-value' }, value.value),
+  ]),
+}).use(i18n).mount('#app')

+import { h } from 'vue'
+import { createMemoryHistory, createRouter } from 'vue-router'
+import type { LayoutPayload, MessagesPageProps, NotificationsPageProps } from '@gooseforum/client'
+import { i18n, setLocale, type Locale } from '../../../src/runtime/i18n'
+import AppShell from '../../../src/site/components/AppShell.vue'
+import UnreadDisplaySettings from '../../../src/site/components/UnreadDisplaySettings.vue'
+import NotificationsPage from '../../../src/site/pages/NotificationsPage.vue'
+import MessagesPage from '../../../src/site/pages/MessagesPage.vue'
+import { createBrowserApp } from './create-app'
+import '../../../src/styles/resource.css'
+
+const params = new URLSearchParams(location.search)
+const language = params.get('lang') || 'en'
+document.documentElement.dataset.theme = params.get('theme') === 'dark' ? 'gf-dark' : 'gf-light'
+await setLocale(language as Locale)
+const initial = (await (await fetch('/api/forum/unread-status')).json()).result
+const layout = {
+  site: { name: 'yourtj', description: '', logo: '', favicon: '', brandType: 'text', brandText: 'yourtj', brandImage: '' },
+  viewer: { id: 1024, username: 'unread-tester', email: '', avatarUrl: '/assets/test/fixtures/browser/anonymous-admin-avatar-1.svg', isAuthenticated: true, canAccessAdmin: false, canManageAgents: false, isModerator: false, requiresEmailVerification: false, adminPermissions: [] },
+  sidebar: { main: [], resources: [], groups: [], categories: [], activeKey: 'notifications' },
+  footer: { links: [], primary: [] }, unread: initial,
+  theme: { enabled: false, current: 'gf-light', themeColor: '#fbfdff' }, umamiEnabled: false,
+} as LayoutPayload
+const notices = {
+  notifications: [1, 2, 3].map(id => ({ id, eventType: 'comment', isRead: false, createdAt: '2026-10-01T12:00:00Z', title: 'Reply', content: 'Fixture notification', actor: { id: 9, username: 'Peer' }, payload: { actorId: 9, actorName: 'Peer' } })),
+  total: 3, unreadCount: 3, pagination: { page: 1, nextPage: 0, hasNext: false, nextUrl: '' },
+} as NotificationsPageProps
+const conversations = {
+  conversations: ['Read peer', 'Unread peer'].map((name, index) => ({ id: index + 1, peerId: index + 8, peerUsername: name, peerAvatar: '', convId: index + 10, lastMsg: 'Hello', lastMsgTime: '', unreadCount: index === 0 ? 0 : 12, peerUrl: `/u/${index + 8}` })),
+} as MessagesPageProps
+const router = createRouter({ history: createMemoryHistory(), routes: [{ path: '/:pathMatch(.*)*', component: { render: () => null } }] })
+await router.push('/settings?tab=notifications')
+await router.isReady()
+createBrowserApp({ render: () => h(AppShell, { layout }, { default: () => h('main', { class: 'mx-auto max-w-3xl space-y-8 p-4' }, [
+  h(UnreadDisplaySettings), h(NotificationsPage, { layout, props: notices }),
+  h('section', { class: 'h-[540px]', id: 'fixture-messages' }, h(MessagesPage, { layout, props: conversations })),
+]) }) }).use(i18n).use(router).mount('#app')
+document.documentElement.dataset.switchLabel = i18n.global.t('notifications.unreadStyleNumbers')
+document.documentElement.dataset.ready = 'true'

+// @vitest-environment happy-dom

+// 后，服务端已放行，但登录/注册/忘记密码仍在前端无条件要求验证码，导致
+// 关闭验证码的站点无法登录。修复后页面按 payload 的 captchaRequired 条件
+// 渲染与校验，验证码未开启时不再请求、不拦截、也不随请求提交字段。
+import { describe, expect, test, vi } from 'vitest'
+import { flushPromises, mount } from '@vue/test-utils'
+import { i18n } from '../src/runtime/i18n'
+import type { LayoutPayload, LoginPageProps } from '@gooseforum/client'
+
+vi.mock('../src/runtime/api', () => ({
+  getCaptcha: vi.fn(async () => ({ captchaId: 'captcha-id', captchaImg: 'data:image/png;base64,x' })),
+  getPasskeyStatus: vi.fn(async () => ({ enabled: false })),

+})
+
+import { forgotPassword, getCaptcha, login } from '../src/runtime/api'
+import LoginPage from '../src/site/pages/LoginPage.vue'
+
+const layout: LayoutPayload = {
+  site: {
+    name: 'yourtj',
+    description: '',
+    logo: '',
+    favicon: '',
+    brandType: 'text',
+    brandText: 'yourtj',
+    brandImage: '',

+  viewer: {

+  umamiEnabled: false,
+}
+
+function buildProps(captchaRequired: boolean | undefined, initialMode: 'login' | 'register' | 'forgot'): LoginPageProps {
+  return {
+    initialMode,
+    redirectUrl: '/',
+    githubUrl: '',
+    githubReady: false,
+    googleUrl: '',
+    googleReady: false,
+    termsOfServiceEnabled: false,
+    privacyPolicyEnabled: false,
+    allowedDomains: [],
+    oauthNotice: false,
+    captchaRequired,
+  }
+}
+
+function mountPage(captchaRequired: boolean | undefined, initialMode: 'login' | 'register' | 'forgot' = 'login') {
+  return mount(LoginPage, {
+    props: { layout, props: buildProps(captchaRequired, initialMode) },
+    global: { plugins: [i18n] },
+  })
+}
+
+describe('LoginPage 验证码开关（issue #1278）', () => {
+  test('captchaRequired=false：登录不再要求验证码，也不拉取验证码', async () => {
+    vi.mocked(getCaptcha).mockClear()
+    vi.mocked(login).mockClear()
+    const wrapper = mountPage(false)
+    await flushPromises()
+    expect(getCaptcha).not.toHaveBeenCalled()

+    await wrapper.find('input[autocomplete="username"]').setValue('alice')
+    await wrapper.find('input[autocomplete="current-password"]').setValue('secret')
+    await wrapper.find('form').trigger('submit')
+    await flushPromises()

+    expect(login).toHaveBeenCalledWith('alice', 'secret', '', '')
+    wrapper.unmount()
+  })

+  test('captchaRequired=true：仍要求验证码（不回归默认配置）', async () => {
+    vi.mocked(getCaptcha).mockClear()

+    const wrapper = mountPage(true)

@@ -0,0 +1,40 @@
+import { constants, generateKeyPairSync, privateDecrypt, webcrypto } from 'node:crypto'
+import { afterEach, expect, test, vi } from 'vitest'
+
+vi.mock('../src/runtime/i18n', () => ({ i18n: { global: { t: (key: string) => key } } }))
+import { login } from '../src/runtime/api'
+
+const { publicKey, privateKey } = generateKeyPairSync('rsa', {
+  modulusLength: 2048,
+  publicKeyEncoding: { type: 'spki', format: 'pem' },
+  privateKeyEncoding: { type: 'pkcs8', format: 'pem' },
+})
+
+afterEach(() => {
+  vi.restoreAllMocks()
+  vi.unstubAllGlobals()
+})
+
+for (const path of ['webcrypto', 'no-subtle', 'subtle-failure'] as const) {
+  test(`password login encrypts RSA-OAEP SHA-256 through ${path}`, async () => {
+    const password = '中文密码A123'
+    const ts = 1793289600000
+    const crypto = path === 'no-subtle' ? {} : webcrypto
+    if (path === 'subtle-failure') vi.spyOn(webcrypto.subtle, 'importKey').mockRejectedValue(new Error('unavailable'))
+    const encrypted = path === 'webcrypto' ? vi.spyOn(webcrypto.subtle, 'encrypt') : undefined
+    vi.stubGlobal('window', { crypto, atob, btoa, location: { origin: 'https://forum.test', href: 'https://forum.test/login' } })
+    const fetchMock = vi.fn(async (url: string, init?: RequestInit) => {
+      if (url === '/api/login-public-key') return Response.json({ code: 0, result: { publicKey, serverTs: ts, algorithm: 'RSA-OAEP-256' } })
+      expect(url).toBe('/api/login')
+      const request = JSON.parse(String(init?.body))
+      const plain = privateDecrypt({ key: privateKey, padding: constants.RSA_PKCS1_OAEP_PADDING, oaepHash: 'sha256' }, Buffer.from(request.encryptedPassword, 'base64'))
+      expect(JSON.parse(plain.toString('utf8'))).toEqual({ password, ts })
+      expect(request.password).toBeUndefined()
+      return Response.json({ code: 0, result: 'signed in' })
+    })
+    vi.stubGlobal('fetch', fetchMock)
+    await expect(login('student', password, '', '')).resolves.toEqual({ twoFactorRequired: false })
+    expect(fetchMock).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2)
+    if (encrypted) expect(encrypted).toHaveBeenCalledOnce()
+  })
+}

+// @vitest-environment happy-dom
+import { beforeEach, describe, expect, test, vi } from 'vitest'
+import { flushPromises, mount } from '@vue/test-utils'
+import { i18n } from '../src/runtime/i18n'
+import type { StickerItem } from '../packages/client/src/contracts/sticker'
+
+const getMyStickers = vi.fn<() => Promise<StickerItem[]>>()
+const saveMyStickerEntry = vi.fn<(request: { stickerName?: string, fileName?: string, displayName?: string }) => Promise<StickerItem>>()
+const deleteMySticker = vi.fn<(name: string) => Promise<void>>()
+const orderMyStickers = vi.fn<(names: string[]) => Promise<void>>()
+const uploadImageFile = vi.fn<(file: Blob, name: string) => Promise<string>>()
+
+vi.mock('@/runtime/api', () => ({
+  ApiResponseError: class ApiResponseError extends Error {},
+  getMyStickers: () => getMyStickers(),
+  saveMyStickerEntry: (request: { stickerName?: string, fileName?: string, displayName?: string }) => saveMyStickerEntry(request),
+  deleteMySticker: (name: string) => deleteMySticker(name),
+  orderMyStickers: (names: string[]) => orderMyStickers(names),
+  uploadImageFile: (file: Blob, name: string) => uploadImageFile(file, name),
+}))
+
+const smile: StickerItem = { name: 'smile', url: '/smile.png', displayName: '微笑' }
+const wave: StickerItem = { name: 'wave', url: '/wave.png' }
+const pending: StickerItem = { name: 'u_' + 'b'.repeat(48), url: '/u.png', isOfficial: false, isEnabled: false, reviewStatus: 'pending' }
+
+// Module-level cache: every case starts from a fresh import.
+async function mountManager() {
+  vi.resetModules()
+  const Manager = (await import('../src/site/components/MyStickersManager.vue')).default
+  const wrapper = mount(Manager, { global: { plugins: [i18n] }, attachTo: document.body })
+  await flushPromises()
+  return wrapper
+}
+
+const t = (key: string, params?: Record<string, unknown>) => i18n.global.t(key, params ?? {})
+
+function labels(wrapper: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof mountManager>>) {
+  return wrapper.findAll('[data-test="my-sticker-list"] li').map((item) => item.find('p').text())
+}
+
+function byLabel(wrapper: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof mountManager>>, label: string) {
+  return wrapper.findAll('button').find((button) => button.attributes('aria-label') === label)!
+}
+
+beforeEach(() => {
+  i18n.global.locale.value = 'zh'
+  vi.clearAllMocks()
+  document.body.innerHTML = ''
+})
+
+describe('MyStickersManager', () => {
+  test('lists the library with review state and an empty state when nothing is saved', async () => {
+    getMyStickers.mockResolvedValueOnce([])
+    const empty = await mountManager()
+    expect(empty.text()).toContain(t('stickers.mine.emptyTitle'))
+    empty.unmount()
+
+    getMyStickers.mockResolvedValueOnce([smile, wave, pending])
+    const wrapper = await mountManager()
+    expect(labels(wrapper)).toEqual(['微笑', 'wave', t('stickers.custom')])
+    expect(wrapper.text()).toContain(t('stickers.mine.pending'))
+    expect(wrapper.text()).toContain(t('stickers.mine.count', { count: 3, limit: 200 }))
+    wrapper.unmount()
+  })
+
+  test('uploads images one by one and reports files it cannot take', async () => {
+    getMyStickers.mockResolvedValue([smile])
+    uploadImageFile.mockResolvedValue('/file/img/owned.png')
+    saveMyStickerEntry.mockResolvedValue(pending)
+    const wrapper = await mountManager()
+
+    const good = new File(['png'], 'happy cat.png', { type: 'image/png' })
+    const text = new File(['hi'], 'notes.txt', { type: 'text/plain' })
+    const big = new File([new Uint8Array((4 << 20) + 1)], 'huge.png', { type: 'image/png' })
+    const input = wrapper.get('[data-test="my-sticker-upload"]')
+    Object.defineProperty(input.element, 'files', { value: [good, text, big], configurable: true })
+    await input.trigger('change')
+    await flushPromises()
+
+    expect(uploadImageFile).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1)
+    expect(uploadImageFile).toHaveBeenCalledWith(good, 'happy cat.png')
+    expect(saveMyStickerEntry).toHaveBeenCalledWith({ fileName: '/file/img/owned.png', displayName: 'happy cat' })
+    expect(labels(wrapper)).toEqual(['微笑', t('stickers.custom')])
+    const alert = wrapper.get('[role="alert"]').text()
+    expect(alert).toContain(t('stickers.mine.notImage', { name: 'notes.txt' }))
+    expect(alert).toContain(t('stickers.mine.tooLarge', { name: 'huge.png' }))
+    wrapper.unmount()
+  })
+
+  test('renames, reorders and removes after confirmation', async () => {
+    getMyStickers.mockResolvedValue([smile, wave])
+    saveMyStickerEntry.mockResolvedValue({ ...wave, displayName: '挥手' })
+    orderMyStickers.mockResolvedValue()
+    deleteMySticker.mockResolvedValue()
+    const wrapper = await mountManager()
+
+    await byLabel(wrapper, t('stickers.mine.rename', { name: 'wave' })).trigger('click')
+    const field = wrapper.get<HTMLInputElement>('input[maxlength="64"]')
+    expect(document.activeElement).toBe(field.element)
+    await field.setValue('  挥手 ')
+    await wrapper.get('form').trigger('submit')
+    await flushPromises()
+    expect(saveMyStickerEntry).toHaveBeenCalledWith({ stickerName: 'wave', displayName: '挥手' })
+    expect(labels(wrapper)).toEqual(['微笑', '挥手'])
+
+    await byLabel(wrapper, t('stickers.mine.moveEarlier', { name: '挥手' })).trigger('click')
+    await flushPromises()
+    expect(orderMyStickers).toHaveBeenCalledWith(['wave', 'smile'])
+    expect(labels(wrapper)).toEqual(['挥手', '微笑'])
+
+    await byLabel(wrapper, t('stickers.mine.remove', { name: '微笑' })).trigger('click')
+    expect(deleteMySticker).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
+    await wrapper.findAll('button').find((button) => button.text() === t('stickers.mine.removeConfirm'))!.trigger('click')
+    await flushPromises()
+    expect(deleteMySticker).toHaveBeenCalledWith('smile')
+    expect(labels(wrapper)).toEqual(['挥手'])
+    wrapper.unmount()
+  })

+    getMyStickers.mockResolvedValueOnce([smile, wave]).mockResolvedValueOnce([wave, smile])
+    orderMyStickers.mockRejectedValue(new Error(''))
+    const wrapper = await mountManager()
+
+    await byLabel(wrapper, t('stickers.mine.moveLater', { name: '微笑' })).trigger('click')
+    await flushPromises()
+    expect(getMyStickers).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2)
+    expect(labels(wrapper)).toEqual(['wave', '微笑'])
+    expect(wrapper.get('[role="alert"]').text()).toBe(t('stickers.mine.orderFailed'))
+    wrapper.unmount()
+  })
+})

@@ -0,0 +1,54 @@
+import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs'
+import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest'
+
+// 正文链接的呈现只在 CSS 里：服务端 markdown2html 负责把绝对 http(s) 链接
+// 标成 target="_blank"，样式侧据此区分外链与站内链接。
+const css = readFileSync(
+  new URL('../src/styles/prose.css', import.meta.url),
+  'utf8',
+)
+
+function rule(pattern: RegExp): { selector: string; body: string } {
+  const match = css.match(pattern)
+  expect(match, `missing rule ${pattern}`).not.toBeNull()
+  return { selector: match![1], body: match![2] }
+}
+
+describe('post body link styling', () => {
+  it('keeps links on the theme color without an underline', () => {
+    const base = rule(/\.gf-prose-post (a) \{([^}]*)\}/)
+    const apply = base.body.match(/@apply ([^;]*);/)
+    expect(apply, 'base rule must style links through @apply').not.toBeNull()
+    // 逐个 token 断言：`hover:text-primary` 不能满足 `text-primary`。
+    const utilities = apply![1].split(/\s+/)
+    expect(utilities).toContain('text-primary')
+    expect(utilities).toContain('no-underline')
+  })
+
+  it('prefixes the external-link icon only on server-marked links', () => {
+    const icon = rule(/\.gf-prose-post (a\[target='_blank'\][^{]*) \{([^}]*)\}/)
+    expect(icon.selector).toContain("a[target='_blank']")
+    expect(icon.selector).toContain(':not(:has(> img))')
+    for (const declaration of [
+      "content: ''",
+      'display: inline-block',
+      'width: 0.85em',
+      'height: 0.85em',
+      'background-color: currentColor',
+      '-webkit-mask-image',
+    ]) {
+      expect(icon.body).toContain(declaration)
+    }
+    // 标准属性带边界匹配：`-webkit-mask-image` / `-webkit-mask-size` 是不同属性，
+    // 不能作为子串满足标准属性的断言。
+    expect(icon.body).toMatch(
+      /(^|[;\s])mask-image:\s*url\("data:image\/svg\+xml,/,
+    )
+    expect(icon.body).toMatch(/(^|[;\s])mask-size:\s*contain/)
+  })
+
+  it('gives a visible press feedback', () => {
+    const active = rule(/\.gf-prose-post (a:active) \{([^}]*)\}/)
+    expect(active.body).toContain('opacity: 0.65')
+  })
+})

@@ -0,0 +1,50 @@
+import assert from 'node:assert/strict'
+import { after, before, test } from 'node:test'
+import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url'
+import { chromium } from 'playwright'
+import { createServer } from 'vite'
+let server, browser, origin
+before(async () => {
+  server = await createServer({ root: fileURLToPath(new URL('../', import.meta.url)), server: { host: '127.0.0.1', port: 0, open: false } })
+  await server.listen()
+  origin = `http://127.0.0.1:${server.httpServer.address().port}`
+  browser = await chromium.launch()
+})
+after(async () => { await browser?.close(); await server?.close() })
+
+for (const width of [320,1280]) for (const scenario of ['first-input','last-tail','ime-commit','clear']) {
+ test(`local draft captures committed editor content before unload: ${scenario} ${width}`,async()=>{
+  const page=await browser.newPage({viewport:{width,height:950}})
+  try {
+   await page.route('**/api/forum/anonymous/state',r=>r.fulfill({status:503,json:{code:1,messageCode:'anonymous.unavailable'}}))
+   await page.goto(`${origin}/assets/test/fixtures/browser/quick-publish.html`)
+   const editor=page.locator('.vditor [contenteditable="true"]:visible').first();await editor.waitFor();await editor.focus()
+   if(scenario!=='first-input'){
+    await editor.fill('之前已保存的正文')
+    await page.waitForFunction(()=>JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('gf:quick-publish-draft:v2:1:2')||'null')?.content?.includes('之前已保存的正文'))
+   }
+   const result=await editor.evaluate((element,scenario)=>{
+    element.focus()
+    const selection=getSelection();const range=document.createRange();range.selectNodeContents(element)
+    if(scenario!=='clear')range.collapse(false)
+    selection.removeAllRanges();selection.addRange(range)
+    if(scenario==='ime-commit')element.dispatchEvent(new CompositionEvent('compositionstart',{bubbles:true}))
+    document.execCommand(scenario==='clear'?'delete':'insertText',false,scenario==='clear'?null:'最后确认的几个字')
+    if(scenario==='ime-commit')element.dispatchEvent(new CompositionEvent('compositionend',{bubbles:true,data:'最后确认的几个字'}))
+    // The editor's real delayed input callback cannot run between this committed
+    // input and the synchronous page-exit handler.
+    const exit=new Event('beforeunload',{cancelable:true})
+    window.dispatchEvent(exit)
+    return {draft:JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('gf:quick-publish-draft:v2:1:2')||'null'),prevented:exit.defaultPrevented}
+   },scenario)
+   assert.equal(result.prevented,scenario!=='clear')
+   if(scenario==='clear')assert.equal(result.draft,null,'clearing the body must not resurrect the saved draft')
+   else assert.ok(result.draft?.content?.includes('最后确认的几个字'),JSON.stringify(result))
+   page.on('dialog',dialog=>dialog.accept())
+   await page.reload()
+   await page.locator('.vditor [contenteditable="true"]:visible').first().waitFor()
+   if(scenario==='clear')assert.ok(!(await page.locator('.vditor [contenteditable="true"]:visible').first().textContent()).includes('之前已保存'))
+   else await page.waitForFunction(()=>document.querySelector('.vditor [contenteditable="true"]')?.textContent?.includes('最后确认的几个字'))
+  }finally{await page.close()}
+ })
+}

evidence.detail:
diff --git a/apps/gooseforum/resource/test/review-rejection.browser.mjs b/apps/gooseforum/resource/test/review-rejection.browser.mjs

index 000000000..79d4ae738
--- /dev/null
+++ b/apps/gooseforum/resource/test/review-rejection.browser.mjs
@@ -0,0 +1,128 @@
+import assert from 'node:assert/strict'
+import { before, after, test } from 'node:test'
+import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url'
+import { mkdir } from 'node:fs/promises'
+import { chromium } from 'playwright'
+import { createServer } from 'vite'
+let server, browser, origin
+before(async () => {
+  server = await createServer({ root: fileURLToPath(new URL('../', import.meta.url)), optimizeDeps: { entries: ['test/fixtures/browser/review-rejection.html'] }, server: { host: '127.0.0.1', port: 0, open: false } })
+  await server.listen()
+  origin = `http://127.0.0.1:${server.httpServer.address().port}`
+  browser = await chromium.launch()
+})
+after(async () => { await browser?.close(); await server?.close() })
+for (const mode of ['moderator', 'admin', 'quick', 'owner']) for (const lang of ['zh', 'en', 'ja', 'de']) for (const theme of ['light', 'dark']) for (const width of [320, 1280]) for (const scale of mode !== 'owner' && lang === 'de' && theme === 'dark' && width === 320 ? [1, 2] : [1]) {
+  test(`${mode} rejection recovery ${lang}/${theme}/${width}/${scale}x`, async () => {
+    const page = await browser.newPage({ viewport: { width, height: 900 } })
+    page.setDefaultTimeout(10000)
+    const errors = [], unexpected = []
+    page.on('pageerror', error => errors.push(error.message))
+    let writes = 0, previews = 0, fail = true, decided = false
+    const item = { id: 7, revisionId: 19, title: 'Candidate', content: 'Private candidate', excerpt: 'Candidate excerpt', userId: 9, username: 'author', processStatus: 2, createdAt: '2026-10-30T00:00:00Z', images: ['/fixture/preview.svg'] }
+    const reason = 'Please remove the private address. <script>window.reasonExecuted=true</script>'
+    const ready = { state: 'ready', subject: 'review.topic', action: 'reject', targetType: 'topic', targetId: 7, title: 'Candidate', excerpt: 'Private candidate', workbenchUrl: '/moderation' }
+    try {
+      await page.route('**/fixture/preview.svg', route => route.fulfill({ contentType: 'image/svg+xml', body: '<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="40" height="40"><rect width="40" height="40" fill="blue"/></svg>' }))
+      await page.route('**/api/**', async route => {
+        const request = route.request(), path = new URL(request.url()).pathname
+        if (path.endsWith('/review-queue')) return route.fulfill({ json: { code: 0, result: { items: decided ? [] : [item], total: decided ? 0 : 1, page: 1, pageSize: 10 } } })
+        if (path.endsWith('/approval-action/preview')) { previews++; return route.fulfill({ json: { code: 0, result: ready } }) }
+        if (path.endsWith('/content/appeals')) return route.fulfill({ json: { code: 0, result: { items: [] } } })
+        if (path.endsWith('/review-action') || path.endsWith('/approval-action/execute')) {
+          writes++
+          const body = request.postDataJSON()
+          assert.deepEqual(body, mode === 'quick' ? { token: 'synthetic-action', reason } : { kind: 'topic', id: 7, revisionId: 19, approve: false, reason })
+          if (fail) { fail = false; return mode === 'quick' ? route.fulfill({json:{code:0,result:{...ready,state:'failed'}}}) : route.fulfill({ status: 500, json: { code: 1, messageCode: 'common.operation.failed', result: null } }) }
+          decided = true
+          return route.fulfill({ json: { code: 0, result: mode === 'quick' ? { ...ready, state: 'done' } : 'success' } })
+        }
+        unexpected.push(`${request.method()} ${path}`)
+        return route.abort()
+      })
+      await page.goto(`${origin}/assets/test/fixtures/browser/review-rejection.html?mode=${mode}&lang=${lang}&theme=${theme}&token=synthetic-action&scale=${scale}`)
+      await page.waitForFunction(() => Boolean(window.reviewLabels) || Boolean(document.querySelector('vite-error-overlay')))
+      assert.equal(await page.locator('vite-error-overlay').count(), 0, errors.join('\n'))
+      const labels = await page.evaluate(() => window.reviewLabels)
+      const baselineWidth = await page.evaluate(() => document.documentElement.scrollWidth)
+      if (mode === 'owner') {
+        await page.getByText(reason, { exact: true }).waitFor()
+        assert.equal(await page.evaluate(() => window.reasonExecuted), undefined)
+        assert.equal(writes, 0)
+        if (process.env.YOURTJ_TEST_ARTIFACTS) {
+          await mkdir(process.env.YOURTJ_TEST_ARTIFACTS, { recursive: true })
+          await page.screenshot({ path: `${process.env.YOURTJ_TEST_ARTIFACTS}/rejection-${mode}-${lang}-${theme}-${width}-${scale}x.png`, fullPage: true })
+        }
+      } else {
+        if (mode !== 'quick') await page.getByRole('button', { name: mode === 'admin' ? labels.adminReject : labels.reject, exact: true }).first().click()
+        const select = page.locator('select').last(), note = page.locator('textarea').last()
+        await select.waitFor()
+        const confirm = () => page.getByRole('button', { name: mode === 'quick' ? labels.quickConfirm : labels.confirm, exact: true })
+        await confirm().click()
+        assert.equal(writes, 0)
+        await select.selectOption('other')
+        await note.fill('x'.repeat(513))
+        await confirm().click()
+        assert.equal(writes, 0)
+        await note.fill(reason)
+        if (mode === 'moderator') {
+          await page.locator('button').filter({ has: page.locator('img') }).click()
+          await page.getByRole('dialog').waitFor()
+          await page.keyboard.press('Escape')
+          await page.getByRole('dialog').waitFor({ state: 'hidden' })
+          assert.equal(await note.inputValue(), reason)
+          assert.equal(await select.inputValue(), 'other')
+        }
+        if (mode !== 'quick') {
+          await page.getByRole('button', { name: labels.cancel, exact: true }).click()
+          assert.equal(writes, 0)
+          await page.getByRole('button', { name: mode === 'admin' ? labels.adminReject : labels.reject, exact: true }).first().click()
+          assert.equal(await note.inputValue(), '')
+          await select.selectOption('other')
+          await note.fill(reason)
+        }
+        await confirm().click()
+        await page.waitForFunction(() => [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].every(button => !button.disabled || button.type !== 'submit'))
+        await page.waitForTimeout(50)
+        assert.equal(writes, 1)
+        assert.equal(await note.inputValue(), reason)
+        assert.equal(await select.inputValue(), 'other')
+        if (mode === 'quick') {
+          const recheck = page.getByTestId('moderation-recheck')
+          await recheck.waitFor()
+          assert.ok(await recheck.evaluate(el => el.scrollHeight <= el.clientHeight + 1), 'recheck label fits at large text')
+          assert.equal(await note.isDisabled(), true)
+          assert.equal(previews, 1)
+          if (process.env.YOURTJ_TEST_ARTIFACTS) {
+            await mkdir(process.env.YOURTJ_TEST_ARTIFACTS, { recursive: true })
+            await page.screenshot({ path: `${process.env.YOURTJ_TEST_ARTIFACTS}/failed-quick-${lang}-${theme}-${width}-${scale}x.png`, fullPage: true })
+          }
+          await page.getByTestId('moderation-recheck').click()
+          await confirm().waitFor()
+          assert.equal(previews, 2)
+          assert.equal(writes, 1, 'rechecking never executes a decision')
+          assert.equal(await note.inputValue(), reason)
+        }
+        assert.equal(await page.evaluate(() => window.reasonExecuted), undefined)
+        if (mode === 'admin') {
+          const bg = await page.getByRole('dialog').evaluate(el => getComputedStyle(el).backgroundColor)
+          assert.notEqual(bg, 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)', 'admin uses its own opaque dialog theme')
+        }
+        assert.ok(await page.evaluate(base => document.documentElement.scrollWidth <= Math.max(innerWidth, base), baselineWidth), 'the form does not increase horizontal overflow')
+        assert.ok(await confirm().evaluate(el => el.scrollWidth <= el.clientWidth), 'confirmation label stays inside its button')
+        assert.ok(await confirm().evaluate(el => el.scrollHeight <= el.clientHeight + 1), 'confirmation text does not overflow the button height')
+        if (mode === 'quick') assert.ok(await page.locator('a[href="/moderation"]').last().evaluate(el => el.scrollHeight <= el.clientHeight + 1), 'workbench link text stays inside its action')
+        assert.ok(await page.locator('textarea').evaluate(el => { const fields = el.closest('[data-test="rejection-reason-fields"]'); return fields.scrollWidth <= fields.clientWidth }), 'reason labels and hints stay inside the form')
+        if (process.env.YOURTJ_TEST_ARTIFACTS) {
+          await mkdir(process.env.YOURTJ_TEST_ARTIFACTS, { recursive: true })
+          await page.screenshot({ path: `${process.env.YOURTJ_TEST_ARTIFACTS}/rejection-${mode}-${lang}-${theme}-${width}-${scale}x.png`, fullPage: true })
+        }
+        await confirm().click()
+        await page.waitForFunction(() => !document.querySelector('textarea'))
+        assert.equal(writes, 2)
+      }
+      assert.deepEqual(unexpected, [])
+      assert.deepEqual(errors, [])
+    } finally { await page.close() }
+  })
+}

+// @vitest-environment happy-dom
+import { afterEach, expect, test, vi } from 'vitest'
+import { DOMWrapper, flushPromises, mount, type VueWrapper } from '@vue/test-utils'
+import { i18n } from '../src/runtime/i18n'
+import * as api from '../src/runtime/api'
+import { twemojiVuePlugin } from '../src/runtime/twemoji'
+import ModerationReviewQueue from '../src/site/components/ModerationReviewQueue.vue'
+import RejectionReasonFields from '../src/site/components/RejectionReasonFields.vue'
+import RejectionReasonDialog from '../src/admin/components/RejectionReasonDialog.vue'
+import ReviewQueueManagementPage from '../src/admin/pages/management/ReviewQueueManagementPage.vue'
+import ModerationActionPage from '../src/site/pages/ModerationActionPage.vue'
+import * as adminApi from '../src/admin/runtime/api'
+import { adminText } from '../src/admin/runtime/i18n-text'
+let wrapper: VueWrapper | undefined
+afterEach(() => { wrapper?.unmount(); wrapper = undefined; vi.restoreAllMocks(); window.history.replaceState({}, '', '/') })
+test('moderator must explain rejection and can retry without losing the explanation', async () => {
+  i18n.global.locale.value = 'en'
+  vi.spyOn(api, 'fetchModerationReviewQueue').mockResolvedValue({ items: [{ id: 7, revisionId: 19, title: 'Candidate', excerpt: 'Draft', userId: 9, username: 'author', processStatus: 2, createdAt: '', images: [] }], total: 1, page: 1, pageSize: 20 })
+  const action = vi.spyOn(api, 'moderationReviewAction').mockRejectedValueOnce(new Error('Try again')).mockResolvedValue('success')
+  wrapper = mount(ModerationReviewQueue, { global: { plugins: [i18n, twemojiVuePlugin] }, attachTo: document.body })
+  await flushPromises()
+  await wrapper.findAll('button').find(b => b.text() === i18n.global.t('moderation.review.reject'))!.trigger('click')
+  expect(wrapper.find('select').exists()).toBe(true)
+  expect(action).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
+  await wrapper.find('select').setValue('other')
+  await wrapper.findAll('button').find(b => b.text() === i18n.global.t('moderation.review.confirmReject'))!.trigger('click')
+  expect(action).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
+  expect(wrapper.find('[role="alert"]').exists()).toBe(true)
+  await wrapper.find('textarea').setValue('  Please remove the private address.  ')
+  await wrapper.findAll('button').find(b => b.text() === i18n.global.t('moderation.review.confirmReject'))!.trigger('click')
+  await flushPromises()
+  expect(action).toHaveBeenLastCalledWith('topic', 7, false, 19, 'Please remove the private address.')
+  expect((wrapper.find('textarea').element as HTMLTextAreaElement).value).toContain('private address')
+  await wrapper.findAll('button').find(b => b.text() === i18n.global.t('moderation.review.confirmReject'))!.trigger('click')
+  await flushPromises()
+  expect(action).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2)
+  expect(wrapper.text()).not.toContain('Candidate')
+})
+
+test('shared rejection dialog validates Unicode totals and disables pending controls', async () => {
+  i18n.global.locale.value = 'en'
+  wrapper = mount(RejectionReasonDialog, { props: { open: true }, global: { plugins: [i18n] }, attachTo: document.body })

+import assert from 'node:assert/strict'
+import { after, before, test } from 'node:test'
+import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url'
+import { chromium } from 'playwright'
+import { createServer } from 'vite'
+
+let server, browser, origin
+before(async () => {
+  server = await createServer({ root: fileURLToPath(new URL('../', import.meta.url)), server: { host: '127.0.0.1', port: 0, open: false } })
+  await server.listen()
+  origin = `http://127.0.0.1:${server.httpServer.address().port}`
+  browser = await chromium.launch()
+})
+after(async () => { await browser?.close(); await server?.close() })
+
+for (const width of [375, 1280]) {
+  test(`选课弹窗保留四角圆角且学院/校区浮层可点选 (${width}px)`, async () => {
+    const page = await browser.newPage({ viewport: { width, height: 800 }, reducedMotion: 'reduce' })
+    try {
+      await page.route('**/api/pk/**', (route) => {
+        const pathname = new URL(route.request().url()).pathname
+        const data = pathname.endsWith('/campuses')
+          ? [{ campusId: 'siping', campusName: '四平路校区' }]
+          : pathname.endsWith('/faculties') ? [{ facultyId: 'math', facultyName: '数学科学学院' }] : []
+        return route.fulfill({ json: { code: 0, data } })
+      })
+      await page.goto(`${origin}/assets/test/fixtures/browser/schedule-course-picker.html`)
+      const dialog = page.getByRole('dialog')
+      await dialog.waitFor({ state: 'visible' })
+      const corners = await dialog.evaluate((element) => {
+        const header = element.firstElementChild
+        const footer = element.lastElementChild
+        const headerRect = header.getBoundingClientRect()
+        const footerRect = footer.getBoundingClientRect()
+        return [
+          [header, headerRect.left + 1, headerRect.top + 1],
+          [header, headerRect.right - 1, headerRect.top + 1],
+          [footer, footerRect.left + 1, footerRect.bottom - 1],
+          [footer, footerRect.right - 1, footerRect.bottom - 1],
+        ].map(([surface, horizontal, vertical]) => surface.contains(document.elementFromPoint(horizontal, vertical)))
+      })
+      assert.deepEqual(corners, [false, false, false, false], '顶栏和底栏背景不应覆盖弹窗圆角外区域')
+      assert.equal(await dialog.locator('.overflow-y-auto').count(), 1)
+      await dialog.getByRole('tab').nth(2).click()
+      for (const [index, label] of [[0, '四平路校区'], [1, '数学科学学院']]) {
+        const trigger = dialog.getByRole('combobox').nth(index)
+        await trigger.click()
+        const listbox = page.getByRole('listbox')
+        await listbox.waitFor({ state: 'visible' })
+        assert.ok(await listbox.evaluate((element) => {
+          const rect = element.getBoundingClientRect()
+          return rect.left >= 0 && rect.top >= 0 && rect.right <= innerWidth && rect.bottom <= innerHeight
+        }), '学院/校区浮层完整位于视口内')
+        await page.getByRole('option', { name: label }).click()
+        await listbox.waitFor({ state: 'hidden' })
+        assert.equal(await dialog.count(), 1, '选择选项后选课弹窗保持打开')
+        assert.ok((await trigger.innerText()).includes(label))
+      }
+    } finally {
+      await page.close()
+    }
+  })
+}

+// @vitest-environment happy-dom
+import { beforeEach, describe, expect, test, vi } from 'vitest'
+import { flushPromises, mount } from '@vue/test-utils'
+import { i18n } from '../src/runtime/i18n'
+import type { StickerItem } from '../packages/client/src/contracts/sticker'
+
+const getForumStickers = vi.fn<() => Promise<StickerItem[]>>()
+const saveMySticker = vi.fn<(name: string) => Promise<StickerItem>>()
+
+vi.mock('@/runtime/api', () => {
+  class ApiResponseError extends Error {}
+  return {
+    ApiResponseError,
+    getForumStickers: () => getForumStickers(),
+    getForumStickerPacks: async () => [],
+    saveMySticker: (name: string) => saveMySticker(name),
+  }
+})
+
+async function mountCard(userId: number | null = 1) {
+  vi.resetModules()
+  const StickerCard = (await import('../src/site/components/StickerCard.vue')).default
+  const wrapper = mount(StickerCard, {
+    props: { userId },
+    global: { plugins: [i18n] },
+    attachTo: document.body,
+  })
+  return wrapper
+}
+
+function card() {
+  return document.querySelector<HTMLElement>('[data-test="sticker-card"]')
+}
+
+function saveButton() {
+  return document.querySelector<HTMLButtonElement>('[data-test="sticker-card-save"]')!
+}
+
+beforeEach(() => {
+  i18n.global.locale.value = 'zh'
+  vi.clearAllMocks()
+  document.body.innerHTML = ''
+  getForumStickers.mockResolvedValue([{ name: 'smile', displayName: '微笑', url: '/smile.png' }])
+})
+
+describe('StickerCard 正文贴纸小窗', () => {
+  test('放大显示贴纸与名称，收藏后原地确认', async () => {
+    saveMySticker.mockResolvedValue({ name: 'smile', url: '/smile.png' })
+    const wrapper = await mountCard()
+    ;(wrapper.vm as unknown as { open: (s: { name: string, src: string }) => void }).open({ name: 'smile', src: '/smile.png' })
+    await flushPromises()
+
+    expect(card()).not.toBeNull()
+    expect(card()!.querySelector('img')!.getAttribute('src')).toBe('/smile.png')
+    expect(card()!.textContent).toContain('微笑')
+    expect(saveButton().textContent).toContain('收藏到我的表情')
+
+    saveButton().click()
+    await flushPromises()
+    expect(saveMySticker).toHaveBeenCalledWith('smile')
+    expect(saveButton().textContent).toContain('已在我的表情')
+    expect(saveButton().getAttribute('aria-disabled')).toBe('true')
+
+    saveButton().click()
+    await flushPromises()
+    expect(saveMySticker).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1)
+    wrapper.unmount()
+  })
+
+  test('个人贴纸显示通用名称，失败时保留小窗并可重试', async () => {
+    saveMySticker.mockRejectedValueOnce(new Error('offline')).mockResolvedValue({ name: 'u_x', url: '/u.png' })
+    const wrapper = await mountCard()
+    const name = `u_${'a'.repeat(48)}`
+    ;(wrapper.vm as unknown as { open: (s: { name: string, src: string }) => void }).open({ name, src: '/u.png' })
+    await flushPromises()
+    expect(card()!.textContent).toContain('自定义表情')
+
+    saveButton().click()
+    await flushPromises()
+    expect(document.querySelector('[data-test="sticker-card-error"]')!.textContent).toContain('收藏未完成，请重试')
+
+    saveButton().click()
+    await flushPromises()
+    expect(document.querySelector('[data-test="sticker-card-error"]')).toBeNull()
+    expect(saveButton().textContent).toContain('已在我的表情')
+    wrapper.unmount()
+  })
+
+  test('未登录时引导登录而不发请求', async () => {
+    const wrapper = await mountCard(null)
+    ;(wrapper.vm as unknown as { open: (s: { name: string, src: string }) => void }).open({ name: 'smile', src: '/smile.png' })
+    await flushPromises()
+    expect(saveButton().textContent).toContain('登录后收藏')
+    saveButton().click()
+    await flushPromises()
+    expect(saveMySticker).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
+    expect(wrapper.emitted('signIn')).toHaveLength(1)
+    wrapper.unmount()
+  })
+
+  test('登出后不再沿用旧账号的已收藏状态', async () => {
+    saveMySticker.mockResolvedValue({ name: 'smile', url: '/smile.png' })
+    const wrapper = await mountCard()
+    const open = (wrapper.vm as unknown as { open: (s: { name: string, src: string }) => void }).open
+    open({ name: 'smile', src: '/smile.png' })
+    await flushPromises()
+    saveButton().click()
+    await flushPromises()
+    expect(saveButton().textContent).toContain('已在我的表情')
+
+    // 同一浏览会话中登出：开着的小窗与重新打开都不能再显示已收藏。
+    await wrapper.setProps({ userId: null })
+    expect(saveButton().textContent).toContain('登录后收藏')
+    expect(saveButton().getAttribute('aria-disabled')).not.toBe('true')
+    open({ name: 'smile', src: '/smile.png' })
+    await flushPromises()
+    expect(saveButton().textContent).toContain('登录后收藏')
+    wrapper.unmount()
+  })
+
+  test('已收藏状态按账号隔离，切回后保留各自记忆', async () => {
+    saveMySticker.mockResolvedValue({ name: 'smile', url: '/smile.png' })
+    const wrapper = await mountCard(1)
+    const open = (wrapper.vm as unknown as { open: (s: { name: string, src: string }) => void }).open
+    open({ name: 'smile', src: '/smile.png' })
+    await flushPromises()
+    saveButton().click()
+    await flushPromises()
+    expect(saveButton().textContent).toContain('已在我的表情')
+
+    // 切到账号 B：同一贴纸不再显示已收藏，可以再次发起收藏。
+    await wrapper.setProps({ userId: 2 })
+    open({ name: 'smile', src: '/smile.png' })
+    await flushPromises()
+    expect(saveButton().textContent).toContain('收藏到我的表情')
+    saveButton().click()
+    await flushPromises()
+    expect(saveMySticker).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2)
+    expect(saveButton().textContent).toContain('已在我的表情')
+
+    // 切回账号 A：分区记忆仍在，且不再发请求。
+    await wrapper.setProps({ userId: 1 })
+    open({ name: 'smile', src: '/smile.png' })
+    await flushPromises()
+    expect(saveButton().textContent).toContain('已在我的表情')
+    saveButton().click()
+    await flushPromises()
+    expect(saveMySticker).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2)
+    wrapper.unmount()
+  })
+})

+import assert from 'node:assert/strict'
+import { after, before, test } from 'node:test'
+import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url'
+import { chromium } from 'playwright'
+import { createServer } from 'vite'
+
+let server, browser, origin
+before(async () => {
+  server = await createServer({ root: fileURLToPath(new URL('../', import.meta.url)), server: { host: '127.0.0.1', port: 0, open: false } })
+  await server.listen()
+  origin = `http://127.0.0.1:${server.httpServer.address().port}`
+  browser = await chromium.launch()
+})
+after(async () => { await browser?.close(); await server?.close() })
+
+const editorSelector = '.vditor [contenteditable="true"]:visible'
+const square = '<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="128" height="128"><circle cx="64" cy="64" r="60" fill="#f5b400"/></svg>'
+const library = [
+  { name: 'huaji', url: '/sticker/huaji.png', pack: 'official' },
+  { name: 'hug', url: '/sticker/hug.png', pack: 'official' },
+  { name: 'doge', url: '/sticker/doge.png', pack: 'official' },
+]
+
+async function openEditor(query = '') {
+  const page = await browser.newPage({ viewport: { width: 720, height: 720 } })
+  const errors = []
+  page.on('pageerror', (err) => errors.push(err.message))
+  await page.route('**/sticker/*.png', (route) => route.fulfill({ contentType: 'image/svg+xml', body: square }))
+  await page.route('**/api/forum/stickers', (route) => route.fulfill({ json: { code: 0, result: library } }))
+  await page.route('**/api/forum/sticker-packs', (route) => route.fulfill({ json: { code: 0, result: [] } }))
+  await page.route('**/api/forum/my-stickers', (route) => route.fulfill({ json: { code: 0, result: [] } }))
+  await page.route('**/api/forum/my-sticker-packs', (route) => route.fulfill({ json: { code: 0, result: [] } }))
+  await page.route('**/api/forum/stickers/resolve', async (route) => {
+    const { names } = route.request().postDataJSON()
+    await route.fulfill({ json: { code: 0, result: library.filter((item) => names.includes(item.name)) } })
+  })
+  await page.goto(`${origin}/assets/test/fixtures/browser/sticker-editor.html${query}`)
+  const editor = page.locator(editorSelector).first()
+  await editor.waitFor()
+  await editor.click()
+  return { page, editor, errors }
+}
+
+const modelValue = (page) => page.locator('#model-value').innerText()
+const waitModel = (page, expected) => page.waitForFunction((text) => document.querySelector('#model-value').textContent.trim() === text, expected)
+const inlineStickers = (page) => page.locator(`${editorSelector} .gf-sticker-inline`)
+const assertNoPageErrors = (errors) => assert.deepEqual(errors, [], `page errors: ${errors.join('; ')}`)
+
+test('an inserted sticker shows as a 2.5em image and typing continues after it', async () => {
+  const { page, errors } = await openEditor()
+  try {
+    await page.keyboard.type('你好')
+    await page.evaluate(() => document.querySelector('#insert-sticker').click())
+    const sticker = inlineStickers(page).first()
+    await sticker.waitFor()
+    assert.equal(await sticker.getAttribute('data-sticker'), 'huaji')
+    assert.equal(await sticker.getAttribute('contenteditable'), 'false')
+    const metrics = await sticker.evaluate((element) => {
+      const style = getComputedStyle(element.parentElement)
+      const box = element.getBoundingClientRect()
+      return { fontSize: parseFloat(style.fontSize), width: box.width, height: box.height, background: getComputedStyle(element).backgroundImage }
+    })
+    assert.ok(Math.abs(metrics.height - metrics.fontSize * 2.5) < 0.5, `height ${metrics.height}`)
+    assert.ok(Math.abs(metrics.width - metrics.fontSize * 2.5) < 0.5, `width ${metrics.width}`)
+    assert.match(metrics.background, /sticker\/huaji\.png/)
+
+    await page.keyboard.type('！')

+import assert from 'node:assert/strict'
+import { after, before, test } from 'node:test'
+import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url'
+import { chromium } from 'playwright'
+import { createServer } from 'vite'
+
+let server, browser, origin
+before(async () => {
+  server = await createServer({ root: fileURLToPath(new URL('../', import.meta.url)), server: { host: '127.0.0.1', port: 0, open: false } })
+  await server.listen()
+  origin = `http://127.0.0.1:${server.httpServer.address().port}`
+  browser = await chromium.launch()
+})
+after(async () => { await browser?.close(); await server?.close() })
+
+const square = '<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="128" height="128"><circle cx="64" cy="64" r="60" fill="#f5b400"/></svg>'
+
+for (const theme of ['gf-light', 'gf-dark']) {
+  test(`post stickers sit inline at 2.5em and open their own card (${theme})`, async () => {
+    const page = await browser.newPage({ viewport: { width: 390, height: 760 } })
+    const errors = []
+    page.on('pageerror', (err) => errors.push(err.message))
+    try {
+      await page.route('**/sticker.png', (route) => route.fulfill({ contentType: 'image/svg+xml', body: square }))
+      await page.route('**/photo.png', (route) => route.fulfill({ contentType: 'image/svg+xml', body: square }))
+      await page.goto(`${origin}/assets/test/fixtures/browser/sticker-inline.html?theme=${theme}`)
+      await page.locator('#sticker').waitFor()
+      await page.waitForFunction(() => [...document.images].every((img) => img.complete))
+
+      const metrics = await page.evaluate(() => {
+        const rect = (id) => document.getElementById(id).getBoundingClientRect()
+        const style = (id) => getComputedStyle(document.getElementById(id))
+        const range = document.createRange()
+        const text = document.getElementById('mixed').firstChild
+        range.setStart(text, 0)
+        range.setEnd(text, 2)
+        const glyph = range.getBoundingClientRect()
+        return {
+          fontSize: parseFloat(style('mixed').fontSize),
+          headingFontSize: parseFloat(style('heading').fontSize),
+          plainHeight: rect('plain').height,
+          mixedHeight: rect('mixed').height,
+          sticker: rect('sticker').toJSON(),
+          sticker2: rect('sticker-2').toJSON(),
+          heading: rect('sticker-heading').toJSON(),
+          glyphCenter: (glyph.top + glyph.bottom) / 2,
+          mixedAlign: style('mixed').textAlign,
+          aloneAlign: style('alone').textAlign,
+          border: style('sticker').borderTopWidth,
+          photoDisplay: style('photo').display,
+        }
+      })
+      assert.ok(Math.abs(metrics.sticker.height - metrics.fontSize * 2.5) < 0.5, `sticker height ${metrics.sticker.height}`)
+      assert.ok(Math.abs(metrics.heading.height - metrics.headingFontSize * 2.5) < 0.5, 'heading sticker follows heading size')
+      assert.equal(metrics.sticker.top, metrics.sticker2.top, 'stickers share the text line')
+      assert.ok(Math.abs(metrics.sticker.top + metrics.sticker.height / 2 - metrics.glyphCenter) < 2.5, 'sticker centred on the glyphs')
+      assert.notEqual(metrics.mixedAlign, 'center')
+      assert.notEqual(metrics.aloneAlign, 'center')
+      assert.equal(metrics.border, '0px')
+      assert.equal(metrics.photoDisplay, 'block', 'ordinary photos keep the block layout')
+
+      await page.locator('#sticker').click()
+      const card = page.locator('[data-test="sticker-card"]')
+      await card.waitFor()
+      assert.equal(await page.locator('.gf-lightbox, [data-test="markdown-image-viewer"]').count(), 0)
+      // Measure after the short zoom-in entrance settles.
+      await page.waitForTimeout(250)
+      const stage = await card.locator('img').boundingBox()
+      assert.equal(Math.round(stage.width), 160)
+      assert.match(await card.innerText(), /smile/)
+      assert.match(await card.locator('[data-test="sticker-card-save"]').innerText(), /登录后收藏/)
+      await page.keyboard.press('Escape')
+      await card.waitFor({ state: 'detached' })
+      assert.deepEqual(errors, [])
+    } finally {
+      await page.close()
+    }
+  })
+}

@@ -0,0 +1,124 @@
+import { beforeEach, expect, test, vi } from 'vitest'
+import type { StickerMarketPack } from '@gooseforum/client'
+
+const api = vi.hoisted(() => ({
+  getMyStickerPacks: vi.fn(),
+  getStickerMarket: vi.fn(),
+  getStickerMarketPack: vi.fn(),
+  saveMyStickerPack: vi.fn(),
+  deleteMyStickerPack: vi.fn(),
+}))
+vi.mock('@/runtime/api', () => api)
+
+beforeEach(() => {
+  vi.resetModules()
+  vi.resetAllMocks()
+})
+
+const pack = (id: number) => ({ id, name: `Pack ${id}` }) as StickerMarketPack
+
+function deferred() {
+  let resolve!: () => void
+  let reject!: (error: Error) => void
+  const promise = new Promise<void>((yes, no) => { resolve = yes; reject = no })
+  return { promise, resolve, reject }
+}
+
+for (const adding of [true, false]) {
+  test(`failed ${adding ? 'add' : 'remove'} preserves another successful operation`, async () => {
+    const { useStickerMarket } = await import('../src/site/composables/useStickerMarket')
+    const state = useStickerMarket()
+    const a = deferred()
+    if (!adding) state.myPacks.value = [pack(1), pack(2)]
+    api.getMyStickerPacks.mockResolvedValue(adding ? [pack(2)] : [pack(1)])
+    const request = adding ? api.saveMyStickerPack : api.deleteMyStickerPack
+    request.mockReturnValueOnce(a.promise).mockResolvedValueOnce(undefined)
+    const action = adding ? state.subscribe : state.unsubscribe
+
+    const pending = action(pack(1))
+    await action(pack(2))
+    a.reject(new Error('offline'))
+    await pending
+
+    expect(state.myPacks.value.map(p => p.id)).toEqual(adding ? [2] : [1])
+  })
+}
+
+test('retry requests the failed second page and keeps the first page', async () => {
+  const { useStickerMarket } = await import('../src/site/composables/useStickerMarket')
+  const state = useStickerMarket()
+  api.getStickerMarket
+    .mockResolvedValueOnce({ topics: [], packs: [pack(1)], total: 25 })
+    .mockRejectedValueOnce(new Error('offline'))
+    .mockResolvedValueOnce({ topics: [], packs: [pack(2)], total: 25 })
+
+  await state.loadMarket('anime')
+  await state.loadMarket('anime', true)
+  expect(state.marketFailed.value).toBe(true)
+  await state.loadMarket('anime')
+
+  expect(api.getStickerMarket).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(3)
+  expect(api.getStickerMarket).toHaveBeenLastCalledWith({ topic: 'anime', page: 2, pageSize: 24 })
+  expect(state.marketPacks.value.map(p => p.id)).toEqual([1, 2])
+  expect(state.marketFailed.value).toBe(false)
+})
+
+for (const adding of [true, false]) {
+ test(`late initial membership read cannot undo a successful ${adding ? 'add' : 'remove'}`, async () => {
+  const { useStickerMarket } = await import('../src/site/composables/useStickerMarket')
+  const state=useStickerMarket()
+  let finish!: (items: StickerMarketPack[]) => void
+  api.getMyStickerPacks.mockReturnValueOnce(new Promise(resolve=>{finish=resolve}))
+   .mockResolvedValueOnce(adding ? [pack(2),pack(1)] : [pack(2)])
+  if(!adding)state.myPacks.value=[pack(1)]
+  const reading=state.ensureMyPacks()
+  await (adding ? state.subscribe(pack(1)) : state.unsubscribe(pack(1)))
+  finish(adding ? [pack(2)] : [pack(1),pack(2)])
+  await reading
+  expect(state.myPacks.value.map(p=>p.id)).toEqual(adding ? [2,1] : [2])
+  expect(state.myPacksReady.value).toBe(true)
+ })
+}
+
+for (const adding of [true, false]) {
+ test(`membership read finishing during pending ${adding ? 'add' : 'remove'} retains the confirmed result`, async () => {
+  const { useStickerMarket } = await import('../src/site/composables/useStickerMarket')
+  const state=useStickerMarket()
+  const operation=deferred()
+  let finish!: (items: StickerMarketPack[]) => void
+  const old=adding ? [pack(2)] : [pack(1),pack(2)]
+  api.getMyStickerPacks
+   .mockReturnValueOnce(new Promise(resolve=>{finish=resolve}))
+   .mockResolvedValueOnce(old)
+   .mockResolvedValue(adding ? [pack(2), pack(1)] : [pack(2)])
+  if(!adding)state.myPacks.value=[pack(1)]
+  const reading=state.ensureMyPacks()
+  const request=adding ? api.saveMyStickerPack : api.deleteMyStickerPack
+  request.mockReturnValueOnce(operation.promise)
+  const writing=adding ? state.subscribe(pack(1)) : state.unsubscribe(pack(1))
+  finish(old)
+  await reading
+  operation.resolve()
+  await writing
+  expect(state.myPacks.value.map(p=>p.id)).toEqual(adding ? [2,1] : [2])
+ })
+}
+
+test('late successful subscribe cannot restore a pack after a successful unsubscribe', async () => {
+  const { useStickerMarket } = await import('../src/site/composables/useStickerMarket')
+  const state = useStickerMarket()
+  const adding = deferred()
+  const removing = deferred()
+  api.getMyStickerPacks.mockResolvedValue([])
+  api.saveMyStickerPack.mockReturnValueOnce(adding.promise)
+  api.deleteMyStickerPack.mockReturnValueOnce(removing.promise)
+
+  const subscribe = state.subscribe(pack(1))
+  const unsubscribe = state.unsubscribe(pack(1))
+  removing.resolve()
+  await unsubscribe
+  adding.resolve()
+  await subscribe
+
+  expect(state.myPacks.value).toEqual([])
+})

+}

+const strip = (page, selector) => page.locator('.gf-scroll-strip').filter({ has: page.locator(selector) }).first()

+    assert.deepEqual(await edges(tabs), { back: false, forward: true, scrollLeft: 0 })
+    const box = await tabs.boundingBox()
+    await page.mouse.move(box.x + box.width / 2, box.y + box.height / 2)
+    await page.mouse.wheel(0, 240)
+    await page.waitForFunction(() => document.querySelector('.gf-sticker-tabs').scrollLeft > 0)
+    const state = await edges(tabs)
+    assert.equal(state.back, true)
+    assert.equal(await page.evaluate(() => window.scrollY), 0, 'the page must not scroll while the strip can')
+    const mask = await tabs.locator('.gf-scroll-strip-track').evaluate((element) => getComputedStyle(element).maskImage || getComputedStyle(element).webkitMaskImage)
+    assert.match(mask, /linear-gradient/)
+
+    // At the far end the wheel goes back to the page instead of being swallowed.
+    await page.locator('.gf-sticker-tabs').evaluate((element) => { element.scrollLeft = element.scrollWidth })
+    await page.waitForFunction(() => !document.querySelector('.gf-scroll-strip:has(> .gf-sticker-tabs)').hasAttribute('data-forward'))
+    await page.mouse.wheel(0, 240)

+    await tabs.locator('.gf-scroll-strip-arrow-back').click()

+
+    // The market tab is the last one: choosing it scrolls it fully into view.
+    await page.locator('.gf-sticker-tabs .gf-sticker-tab').last().evaluate((element) => element.click())
+    await page.waitForFunction(() => {
+      const track = document.querySelector('.gf-sticker-tabs').getBoundingClientRect()
+      const tab = document.querySelector('.gf-sticker-tabs [aria-pressed="true"]').getBoundingClientRect()

+    assert.deepEqual(errors, [])
+  } finally { await page.close() }

+    const panelHeight = () => page.locator('.gf-sticker-picker').evaluate((element) => element.getBoundingClientRect().height)

+    const expected = Math.min(288, 640 * 0.44)

+    await page.locator('.gf-sticker-body > p').first().waitFor()
+    assert.ok(Math.abs(await panelHeight() - expected) < 0.5)
+    const body = await page.locator('.gf-sticker-body').evaluate((element) => ({ content: element.querySelector(':scope > p').getBoundingClientRect().height, box: element.clientHeight }))

+  } finally { await page.close() }

+    await page.getByText('Market page 2', { exact: true }).waitFor()

+    assert.deepEqual(requested, [1, 2, 2])
+    assert.deepEqual(errors, [])
+  } finally { await page.close() }
+})

+import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest'
+import { extractStickerQuery, rankStickerSuggestions } from '@/site/utils/sticker-token'
+
+describe('extractStickerQuery', () => {
+  it('recognises an open fragment before the caret', () => {
+    expect(extractStickerQuery('看 [:sticker:')).toEqual({ length: 10, query: '' })
+    expect(extractStickerQuery('看 [:sticker:hu')).toEqual({ length: 12, query: 'hu' })
+  })
+
+  it('ignores closed tokens, broken names and escaped fragments', () => {
+    expect(extractStickerQuery('[:sticker:huaji:]')).toBeNull()
+    expect(extractStickerQuery('[:sticker:huaji:')).toBeNull()
+    expect(extractStickerQuery('[:sticker:hu aji')).toBeNull()
+    expect(extractStickerQuery('\\[:sticker:hu')).toBeNull()
+    expect(extractStickerQuery('\\\\[:sticker:hu')).toEqual({ length: 12, query: 'hu' })
+    expect(extractStickerQuery(`[:sticker:${'a'.repeat(65)}`)).toBeNull()
+  })
+})
+
+describe('rankStickerSuggestions', () => {
+  const items = [
+    { name: 'u_1', url: '/1.png', label: '我的滑稽' },
+    { name: 'huaji', url: '/h.png', label: 'huaji' },
+    { name: 'shuai', url: '/s.png', label: 'shuai' },
+    { name: 'hug', url: '/g.png', label: 'hug' },
+    { name: 'huaji', url: '/dup.png', label: 'huaji' },
+  ]
+
+  it('keeps source order for an empty query and drops duplicate names', () => {
+    expect(rankStickerSuggestions(items, '').map((item) => item.url)).toEqual(['/1.png', '/h.png', '/s.png', '/g.png'])
+    expect(rankStickerSuggestions(items, '', 2)).toHaveLength(2)
+  })
+
+  it('ranks exact, then prefix (name or label), then substring matches', () => {
+    expect(rankStickerSuggestions(items, 'hu').map((item) => item.name)).toEqual(['huaji', 'hug', 'shuai'])
+    expect(rankStickerSuggestions(items, 'hug').map((item) => item.name)).toEqual(['hug'])
+    expect(rankStickerSuggestions(items, '我的').map((item) => item.name)).toEqual(['u_1'])
+    expect(rankStickerSuggestions(items, 'HU').map((item) => item.name)).toEqual(['huaji', 'hug', 'shuai'])
+    expect(rankStickerSuggestions(items, 'zzz')).toEqual([])
+  })
+})

+    expect(stickerDeleteRangeAt(content, tokenStart, 'forward')).toEqual({ start: tokenStart, end: tokenEnd })
+    expect(stickerDeleteRangeAt(content, tokenStart, 'backward')).toBeNull()
+  })
+
+  it('光标落在 token 内部两方向都整段删除', () => {
+    const inside = tokenStart + '[:sticker:'.length
+    expect(stickerDeleteRangeAt(content, inside, 'backward')).toEqual({ start: tokenStart, end: tokenEnd })
+    expect(stickerDeleteRangeAt(content, inside, 'forward')).toEqual({ start: tokenStart, end: tokenEnd })
+  })
+
+  it('相邻 token 各删各的', () => {
+    const pair = '[:sticker:a:][:sticker:b:]'
+    expect(stickerDeleteRangeAt(pair, 13, 'backward')).toEqual({ start: 0, end: 13 })
+    expect(stickerDeleteRangeAt(pair, 13, 'forward')).toEqual({ start: 13, end: 26 })
+  })
+
+  it('未闭合片段：两端都可整段删除', () => {
+    const fragment = '看 [:sticker:na'
+    const start = fragment.indexOf('[:sticker:')
+    expect(stickerDeleteRangeAt(fragment, fragment.length, 'backward')).toEqual({ start, end: fragment.length })
+    expect(stickerDeleteRangeAt(fragment, start, 'forward')).toEqual({ start, end: fragment.length })
+  })
+
+  it('片段后已有空白时只删除片段本身', () => {
+    expect(stickerDeleteRangeAt('[:sticker:na 后文', 12, 'backward')).toEqual({ start: 0, end: 12 })
+  })
+
+  it('单独前缀（后面再无字符）视为片段', () => {
+    expect(stickerDeleteRangeAt('[:sticker:', 10, 'backward')).toEqual({ start: 0, end: 10 })
+    expect(stickerDeleteRangeAt('[:sticker:', 0, 'forward')).toEqual({ start: 0, end: 10 })
+  })
+
+  it('前缀后紧跟终止字符不算片段', () => {
+    expect(stickerDeleteRangeAt('[:sticker: 好', 10, 'backward')).toBeNull()
+    expect(stickerDeleteRangeAt('[:sticker:]', 11, 'backward')).toBeNull()
+    expect(stickerDeleteRangeAt('[:sticker:[:sticker:a:]', 10, 'backward')).toBeNull()
+  })
+
+  it('普通文本与相邻标点不干预', () => {
+    expect(stickerDeleteRangeAt('hello world', 5, 'backward')).toBeNull()
+    expect(stickerDeleteRangeAt('hello world', 5, 'forward')).toBeNull()
+    expect(stickerDeleteRangeAt('(:sticker', 9, 'backward')).toBeNull()
+  })
+
+  it('名字超过 64 字符不算合法 token 也不成片段', () => {
+    const overlong = `[:sticker:${'a'.repeat(65)}]`
+    expect(stickerDeleteRangeAt(overlong, overlong.length - 1, 'backward')).toBeNull()
+  })
+
+  it('恰好 64 个名字字符的 token 整个命中', () => {
+    const token = `[:sticker:${'a'.repeat(64)}:]`
+    expect(stickerDeleteRangeAt(token, token.length, 'backward')).toEqual({ start: 0, end: token.length })
+    expect(stickerDeleteRangeAt(token, 0, 'forward')).toEqual({ start: 0, end: token.length })
+  })
+
+  it('名字后紧跟冒号但未闭合时，末尾冒号也在片段内', () => {
+    const fragment = '[:sticker:huaji:'
+    expect(stickerDeleteRangeAt(fragment, fragment.length, 'backward')).toEqual({ start: 0, end: fragment.length })
+  })
+
+  it('前缀后紧跟冒号时回落默认删除', () => {
+    expect(stickerDeleteRangeAt('[:sticker::x', 10, 'backward')).toBeNull()
+    expect(stickerDeleteRangeAt('[:sticker::x', 10, 'forward')).toBeNull()
+  })
+
+  it('光标落在片段内部（非两端）两方向都整段删除', () => {
+    const fragment = '看 [:sticker:na 后文'
+    expect(stickerDeleteRangeAt(fragment, 8, 'backward')).toEqual({ start: 2, end: 14 })
+    expect(stickerDeleteRangeAt(fragment, 8, 'forward')).toEqual({ start: 2, end: 14 })
+  })
+
+  it('渲染端可识别的 token 都被删除区间完整覆盖（防名字字符集漂移）', () => {

+    }
+  })

+import assert from 'node:assert/strict'
+import { after, before, test } from 'node:test'
+import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url'
+import { chromium } from 'playwright'
+import { createServer } from 'vite'
+
+let server, browser, origin
+before(async () => {
+  server = await createServer({ root: fileURLToPath(new URL('../', import.meta.url)), server: { host: '127.0.0.1', port: 0, open: false } })
+  await server.listen()
+  origin = `http://127.0.0.1:${server.httpServer.address().port}`
+  browser = await chromium.launch()
+})
+after(async () => { await browser?.close(); await server?.close() })
+
+for (const lang of ['zh', 'en', 'ja', 'de']) for (const width of [320, 1280]) for (const theme of ['gf-light', 'gf-dark']) {
+ test(`created school account recovery ${lang} ${width} ${theme}`, async () => {
+  const page = await browser.newPage({ viewport: { width, height: 950 } })
+  const errors = []; let submissions = 0
+  page.on('pageerror', e => errors.push(e.message))
+  try {
+   await page.route('**/api/auth/tongji/registration', async route => {
+    if (route.request().method() === 'GET') await route.fulfill({ json: { code: 0, result: { csrfToken:'synthetic-proof', email:'1234567@tongji.edu.cn', expiresAt:'2030-01-01T00:00:00Z' } } })
+    else {
+     submissions++
+     assert.equal(route.request().postDataJSON().csrfToken, 'synthetic-proof')
+     await route.fulfill({ status:500, json: { code:1, result:null, messageCode:'auth.tongji.retryLogin', params:{ restartUrl:'/api/auth/tongji?redirect=%2Fcampus' } } })

+   await page.locator('input[autocomplete=username]').fill('new_student')
+   const passwords = page.locator('input[autocomplete=new-password]')

+   await page.locator('input[type=checkbox]').check()
+   await page.locator('button[type=submit]').click()
+   const alert = page.locator('[role=alert]'); await alert.waitFor()
+   assert.equal(await page.locator('form').count(), 0)
+   assert.equal(submissions, 1)

+   await restart.focus()

+   const box = await restart.boundingBox()
+   assert.ok(box && box.height >= 40 && box.x >= 0 && box.x + box.width <= width + 1)
+   assert.ok((await alert.textContent()).length > 20)

+ })

diff --git a/apps/gooseforum/resource/test/unread-display.browser.mjs b/apps/gooseforum/resource/test/unread-display.browser.mjs

@@ -0,0 +1,88 @@
+import assert from 'node:assert/strict'
+import { after, before, test } from 'node:test'
+import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url'
+import { mkdir } from 'node:fs/promises'
+import { join } from 'node:path'
+import { chromium } from 'playwright'
+import { createServer } from 'vite'
+
+let server, browser, origin
+before(async () => {
+  server = await createServer({ root: fileURLToPath(new URL('../', import.meta.url)), optimizeDeps: { entries: ['test/fixtures/browser/unread-display.html'] }, server: { host: '127.0.0.1', port: 0, open: false }, logLevel: 'error' })
+  await server.listen()
+  origin = `http://127.0.0.1:${server.httpServer.address().port}`
+  browser = await chromium.launch()
+  if (process.env.YOURTJ_TEST_ARTIFACTS) await mkdir(process.env.YOURTJ_TEST_ARTIFACTS, { recursive: true })
+})
+after(async () => { await browser?.close(); await server?.close() })
+
+for (const language of ['zh', 'en', 'ja', 'de']) for (const theme of ['light', 'dark']) for (const width of [320, 1280]) {
+  test(`unread preference propagates to every indicator: ${language}/${theme}/${width}`, async () => {
+    const page = await browser.newPage({ viewport: { width, height: 900 }, colorScheme: theme })
+    let style = 'number', failNext = true, writes = 0, countReads = 0, markedRead = 0
+    const unexpected = [], errors = []
+    page.on('pageerror', error => errors.push(error.message))
+    await page.route('**/api/**', async route => {
+      const request = route.request(), path = new URL(request.url()).pathname
+      if (path === '/api/forum/unread-status') {
+        countReads++
+        return route.fulfill({ json: { code: 0, result: { notifications: true, messages: true, notificationCount: 3, messageCount: 12, badgeStyle: style } } })
+      }
+      if (path === '/api/forum/notification-preferences' && request.method() === 'PUT') {
+        writes++
+        const body = request.postDataJSON()
+        assert.deepEqual(Object.keys(body), ['badgeStyle'])
+        assert.ok(['dot', 'number'].includes(body.badgeStyle))
+        if (failNext) { failNext = false; return route.fulfill({ status: 500, json: { code: 1, result: null, messageCode: 'common.operation.failed' } }) }
+        style = body.badgeStyle
+        return route.fulfill({ json: { code: 0, result: { badgeStyle: style } } })
+      }
+      if (path === '/api/forum/events') return route.fulfill({ status: 200, contentType: 'text/event-stream', body: 'retry: 60000\n\n' })
+      if (path === '/api/forum/stickers') return route.fulfill({ json: { code: 0, result: [] } })
+      if (path === '/api/forum/anonymous/state') return route.fulfill({ json: { code: 0, result: { persona: null } } })
+      if (path === '/api/forum/chat/messages') return route.fulfill({ json: { code: 0, result: { list: [], hasMoreBefore: false, hasMoreAfter: false, nextBeforeId: 0, latestId: 0 } } })
+      if (path === '/api/forum/chat/mark-read') { markedRead++; return route.fulfill({ json: { code: 0, result: true } }) }
+      unexpected.push(`${request.method()} ${path}`)
+      return route.fulfill({ status: 404, json: { code: 1 } })
+    })
+    const url = `${origin}/assets/test/fixtures/browser/unread-display.html?lang=${language}&theme=${theme}`
+    await page.goto(url)
+    await page.waitForFunction(() => document.documentElement.dataset.ready === 'true')
+    const label = await page.evaluate(() => document.documentElement.dataset.switchLabel)
+    const control = page.getByRole('switch', { name: label })
+    await control.scrollIntoViewIfNeeded()
+    assert.equal(await control.getAttribute('aria-checked'), 'true')
+    assert.match(await page.locator('[data-unread-summary]').innerText(), /3/)
+    const readsBefore = countReads, markedBefore = markedRead
+    await control.click()
+    await page.waitForFunction(() => !!document.querySelector('[role="alert"]'))
+    assert.equal(await control.getAttribute('aria-checked'), 'true')
+    await control.click()
+    await page.waitForFunction(() => document.querySelector('[role="switch"]')?.getAttribute('aria-checked') === 'false' && !document.querySelector('[role="alert"]'))
+    assert.equal(await page.locator('[data-unread-summary]').count(), 0)
+    const badges = await page.locator('[data-unread-indicator]').evaluateAll(nodes => nodes.map(node => ({ style: node.dataset.unreadStyle, text: node.textContent, label: node.getAttribute('aria-label') })))
+    assert.ok(badges.length >= 3)
+    for (const badge of badges) { assert.equal(badge.style, 'dot'); assert.equal(badge.text.trim(), ''); assert.doesNotMatch(badge.label, /\d/) }
+    assert.equal(countReads, readsBefore, 'changing display style does not fetch counts again')
+    assert.equal(markedRead, markedBefore, 'changing style does not mark a message read')
+    assert.equal(await page.evaluate(() => document.documentElement.scrollWidth <= innerWidth), true)
+    // Capture the settled switch, not a frame during its color/thumb transition.
+    await page.evaluate(async () => {
+      await Promise.all(document.getAnimations()
+        .filter(animation => Number.isFinite(animation.effect?.getComputedTiming().endTime))
+        .map(animation => animation.finished.catch(() => {})))
+    })
+    if (process.env.YOURTJ_TEST_ARTIFACTS) await page.screenshot({ path: join(process.env.YOURTJ_TEST_ARTIFACTS, `unread-dot-${language}-${theme}-${width}.png`) })
+    await page.reload()
+    await page.waitForFunction(() => document.documentElement.dataset.ready === 'true')
+    assert.equal(await control.getAttribute('aria-checked'), 'false', 'account preference survives a fresh read')
+    await control.scrollIntoViewIfNeeded()
+    await control.click()
+    await page.waitForFunction(() => document.querySelector('[role="switch"]')?.getAttribute('aria-checked') === 'true' && !document.querySelector('[role="status"]'))
+    assert.match(await page.locator('[data-unread-summary]').innerText(), /3/)
+    assert.equal(writes, 3)
+    assert.deepEqual(unexpected, [])
+    assert.deepEqual(errors, [])
+    await page.close()
+  })
+}

+test('a slow poll cannot revert a confirmed local style and another save is excluded', async () => {
+  let finishPoll!: (value: unknown) => void
+  let finishSave!: (value: unknown) => void
+  const fetch = vi.fn((_path: string, init?: RequestInit) => new Promise(resolve => {
+    if (init?.method === 'PUT') finishSave = resolve
+    else finishPoll = resolve
+  }))
+  vi.stubGlobal('fetch', fetch)
+  status.startPolling(initial, 1024)
+  const poll = status.refresh(true)
+  const save = status.updateBadgeStyle('dot')
+  expect(status.badgeStyle.value).toBe('dot')
+  expect(await status.updateBadgeStyle('number')).toBe(false)
+  finishSave(response({ badgeStyle: 'dot' }))
+  expect(await save).toBe(true)
+  finishPoll(response(initial))
+  await poll
+  expect(status.badgeStyle.value).toBe('dot')
+  expect(fetch).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2)
+})
+
+test('save failure rolls back without changing unread facts and can retry', async () => {
+  const fetch = vi.fn().mockRejectedValueOnce(new TypeError('offline')).mockResolvedValue(response({ badgeStyle: 'dot' }))
+  vi.stubGlobal('fetch', fetch)
+  status.startPolling(initial, 1024)
+  expect(await status.updateBadgeStyle('dot')).toBe(false)
+  expect(status.badgeStyle.value).toBe('number')
+  expect(status.badgeStyleError.value).not.toBe('')
+  expect(status.notificationCount.value).toBe(3)
+  expect(status.messages.value).toBe(true)
+  expect(await status.updateBadgeStyle('dot')).toBe(true)
+  expect(status.badgeStyle.value).toBe('dot')
+})
+
+test('same-account shell navigation does not strand a pending preference save', async () => {
+  let finish!: (value: unknown) => void
+  vi.stubGlobal('fetch', vi.fn(() => new Promise(resolve => { finish = resolve })))
+  status.startPolling(initial, 1024)
+  const save = status.updateBadgeStyle('dot')
+  status.stopPolling()
+  status.startPolling(initial, 1024)
+  finish(response({ badgeStyle: 'dot' }))
+  expect(await save).toBe(true)
+  expect(status.badgeStyleSaving.value).toBe(false)
+  expect(status.badgeStyle.value).toBe('dot')
+})
+
+test('an old account response and cache cannot replace the next account snapshot', async () => {
+  let finish!: (value: unknown) => void
+  vi.stubGlobal('fetch', vi.fn(() => new Promise(resolve => { finish = resolve })))
+  status.startPolling(initial, 1024)
+  const old = status.refresh(true)
+  status.startPolling({ notifications: false, messages: false, badgeStyle: 'dot' }, 2048)
+  finish(response({ ...initial, notificationCount: 99 }))
+  await old
+  await flushPromises()
+  expect(status.badgeStyle.value).toBe('dot')
+  expect(status.notifications.value).toBe(false)
+  expect(status.notificationCount.value).toBeUndefined()

+// @vitest-environment happy-dom

+const unread = useUnreadStatus()

+  unread.startPolling({ notifications: true, messages: false, notificationCount: 7, badgeStyle: 'number' }, 1024)

+  vi.stubGlobal('fetch', fetch)

+  finish({ ok: false, json: async () => ({ code: 1, messageCode: 'common.operation.failed' }) })
+  await flushPromises()
+  expect(control.attributes('aria-checked')).toBe('true')
+  expect(wrapper.find('[role="alert"]').exists()).toBe(true)
+  expect(unread.notificationCount.value).toBe(7)

+  await flushPromises()
+  expect(control.attributes('aria-checked')).toBe('false')
+  expect(wrapper.find('[role="alert"]').exists()).toBe(false)
+  expect(fetch).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2)
+  for (const [path, init] of fetch.mock.calls as unknown as [string, RequestInit][]) {
+    expect(path).toBe('/api/forum/notification-preferences')
+    expect(init.method).toBe('PUT')

+  }
+})

+// @vitest-environment happy-dom
+// issue #1320: 个人主页区分「已关注」与「已互关」。主页按钮与关注列表条目
+// 都只渲染服务端给出的 isMutualFollowing，取关后回落为「关注」。
+import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, test, vi } from 'vitest'
+import { flushPromises, mount } from '@vue/test-utils'
+import type { UserConnectionPayload, UserProfileProps } from '@gooseforum/client'
+import { i18n } from '../src/runtime/i18n'
+import { followUser } from '../src/runtime/api'
+import UserPage from '../src/site/pages/UserPage.vue'
+import { layout, memberProfile } from './fixtures/profile'
+
+vi.mock('../src/runtime/api', async importOriginal => ({
+  ...await importOriginal<typeof import('../src/runtime/api')>(),
+  followUser: vi.fn(),
+}))
+vi.mock('../src/runtime/router', () => ({ fetchPage: vi.fn() }))
+vi.mock('../src/runtime/content-updates', () => ({ useContentUpdates: vi.fn() }))
+
+const t = (key: string) => i18n.global.t(key)
+
+function connection(overrides: Partial<UserConnectionPayload> & Pick<UserConnectionPayload, 'id' | 'username'>): UserConnectionPayload {
+  return {
+    nickname: overrides.username,
+    avatarUrl: '',
+    bio: '',
+    url: `/u/${overrides.id}`,
+    isFollowing: true,
+    isMutualFollowing: false,
+    isSelf: false,
+    ...overrides,
+  }
+}
+
+function mutualProfile(): UserProfileProps {
+  // 条目必须每次新建：连接行取关会原地改写 connection 对象，共享常量会被后续用例污染。
+  const mutualEntry = connection({ id: 7, username: 'mutual_peer', isFollowing: true, isMutualFollowing: true })
+  const oneWayEntry = connection({ id: 8, username: 'oneway_peer', isFollowing: true, isMutualFollowing: false })
+  return {
+    ...memberProfile,
+    isOwnProfile: false,
+    canFollow: true,
+    section: 'following',
+    user: { ...memberProfile.user, isSelf: false, isFollowing: true, isMutualFollowing: true },
+    following: [mutualEntry, oneWayEntry],
+    followers: [],
+  }
+}
+
+let wrapper: ReturnType<typeof mount> | undefined
+
+beforeEach(() => {
+  vi.mocked(followUser).mockReset()
+  history.replaceState({}, '', '/u/1024/following')
+})
+
+afterEach(() => {
+  wrapper?.unmount()
+  wrapper = undefined
+})
+
+// header（含主页关注按钮）只在非独立关注列表分区渲染；列表条目在 section=following。
+function mountPage(overrides: Partial<UserProfileProps> = {}) {
+  wrapper = mount(UserPage, {
+    props: { layout, props: { ...mutualProfile(), ...overrides } },
+    global: { plugins: [i18n], stubs: { PrivateNoteEditor: true } },
+  })
+  return wrapper
+}
+
+// 主页关注按钮是 gf-button-md；列表条目按钮是 gf-button-sm。
+function pageFollowButton() {
+  return wrapper!.findAll('button').find((button) => button.classes().includes('gf-button-md'))!
+}
+
+function connectionRow(username: string) {
+  return wrapper!.findAll('div.divide-y > div').find((row) => row.text().includes(`@${username}`))!
+}
+
+describe('UserPage 互关状态（issue #1320）', () => {
+  test('互关用户的主页按钮显示已互关并换成 UserRoundCheck 图标', () => {
+    mountPage({ section: 'summary' })
+
+    const button = pageFollowButton()
+    expect(button.text()).toBe(t('user.mutualFollowing'))
+    expect(button.get('svg').attributes('class')).toContain('user-round-check')
+  })
+
+  test('关注列表条目按服务端互关位分别显示已互关与已关注', () => {
+    mountPage()
+
+    const mutualButton = connectionRow('mutual_peer').get('button')
+    expect(mutualButton.text()).toBe(t('user.mutualFollowing'))
+    expect(mutualButton.get('svg').attributes('class')).toContain('user-round-check')
+
+    const oneWayButton = connectionRow('oneway_peer').get('button')
+    expect(oneWayButton.text()).toBe(t('user.following'))
+    expect(oneWayButton.get('svg').attributes('class')).toContain('user-plus')
+  })
+
+  test('取消关注后主页按钮回到关注', async () => {
+    vi.mocked(followUser).mockResolvedValue({ isFollowing: false, isMutualFollowing: false })
+    mountPage({ section: 'summary' })
+
+    await pageFollowButton().trigger('click')
+    await flushPromises()
+
+    expect(followUser).toHaveBeenCalledWith(1024, true)
+    expect(pageFollowButton().text()).toBe(t('user.follow'))
+    expect(pageFollowButton().get('svg').attributes('class')).toContain('user-plus')
+  })
+
+  test('互关的连接行取关后回落为关注并撤销互关图标', async () => {
+    vi.mocked(followUser).mockResolvedValue({ isFollowing: false, isMutualFollowing: false })
+    mountPage()
+
+    await connectionRow('mutual_peer').get('button').trigger('click')
+    await flushPromises()
+
+    expect(followUser).toHaveBeenCalledWith(7, true)
+    const button = connectionRow('mutual_peer').get('button')
+    expect(button.text()).toBe(t('user.follow'))
+    expect(button.get('svg').attributes('class')).toContain('user-plus')
+  })
+})

diff --git a/apps/gooseforum/resource/test/write-recovery.test.ts b/apps/gooseforum/resource/test/write-recovery.test.ts
new file mode 100644
